rows.title: Senior Customer Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Welcome to KFC. Home of the real ones.We sell the world’s best chicken. Seriously. And we’ve done it since 1939, when the idea of crispy, original recipe chicken took Kentucky by storm. Now, we’re proud to serve 1000+ communities across the UK and Ireland, bringing the grit, pride and iconic reputation that we started with, all those years ago.
Across the Restaurant Support Centre (RSC), we come to work to be ourselves, and to make something of ourselves. We want to see our potential go that little bit further, as part of one of the world’s most iconic brands.
What’s the gig? Well, you support our restaurants - and we’ll support you every step of the way. Simple. Our doors are open - and they can take you anywhere.
All we ask is that you be you. Because that makes us, us. Sound good? Great. Let’s find out about that job.
THE TEAMOur Tech team is a 60+ strong team of curious minds, building the digital experiences that power KFC – from app to kiosk, delivery to checkout. We work cross-functionally, move fast, and stay focused on what matters: creating smart solutions that make things better for our customers and our teams.
ABOUT THE ROLEAt KFC, we have millions of customers choosing us every week, across restaurants, drive-thrus, kiosks, delivery and digital. That creates a lot of data. The exciting bit is what we do with it.We’re looking for a Data Analyst, Loyalty & CRM to help us better understand our customers, how they behave and what keeps them coming back for more.
Sitting within our Data & Analytics team and partnering closely with Loyalty, CRM and Marketing, you’ll dig into customer, transactional and marketing data to uncover insights that can genuinely influence what we do next.
You might be exploring why certain customers visit more frequently, identifying opportunities to increase loyalty and retention, understanding which campaigns actually changed behaviour, or spotting a commercial opportunity hidden within millions of transactions.
Yes, you’ll build brilliant reporting. But this role goes much further than telling us what happened. We want someone curious enough to ask why it happened, why it matters and what we should do about it.
If you love solving problems with data, understand customers and can turn complex analysis into a story that gets people to act, this could be for you.
WHAT YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME DOING
Customer Analytics & Insight
You’ll help us understand our customers better and turn that understanding into commercial opportunities.You’ll:Analyse customer, transactional, loyalty and marketing data to identify trends, behaviours, risks and opportunities.Measure how our Loyalty programme is performing and identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention and customer value.Build customer segmentation and behavioural analysis to support more relevant, personalised experiences.Understand customer acquisition, frequency, spend, retention and lifetime value.Evaluate campaigns, promotions and loyalty activity to understand what’s working and where we can improve.Turn complex datasets into simple, actionable recommendations.Proactively look for opportunities where insight can improve customer experience and commercial performance.
Reporting & Visualisation
Great decisions need data people can trust and understand.You’ll:Build, automate and maintain dashboards using Power BI and other reporting tools.Create clear reporting across customer behaviour, loyalty, campaign effectiveness and commercial performance.Establish consistent KPIs and reporting standards across Loyalty and Marketing analytics.Make sure reporting is accurate, scalable and easy to understand, whether the audience is technical or not.Continuously improve how we work through better automation, data quality and simpler reporting.
Business Partnering
This isn’t an analyst role where you disappear into the data and send someone a spreadsheet.You’ll:Partner closely with Loyalty, CRM and Marketing to understand the business problem before jumping into the analysis.Act as the dedicated Data & Analytics partner for Loyalty, helping turn questions and opportunities into clear analytical approaches.Work across Commercial Finance, Digital, Operations, Technology and the wider Data & Analytics team.Partner with Data Engineering to make sure the data you need is available, trusted and fit for purpose.Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders across the business.Help us build a culture where data and evidence genuinely influence the decisions we make.
WHAT WE’D LOVE FROM YOUWe’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical capability with real commercial curiosity.
You’ll ideally bring:Strong SQL skills and confidence interrogating large datasets independently.Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualisation tools.Experience working with customer, transactional or commercial data.Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a great eye for detail.An understanding of data quality, validation and governance.Strong Excel capability.Experience delivering analytics within Customer, Marketing, CRM, Loyalty or another commercially focused environment.Examples of using data and insight to influence a commercial or strategic decision.Confidence working cross-functionally and explaining analysis to people who don’t live and breathe data.
A degree in a relevant discipline is useful, but equivalent professional experience is just as valuable.Even better if you have...CRM, loyalty or customer engagement analytics experience.Customer segmentation or behavioural analytics experience.Experience measuring marketing and campaign effectiveness.GA4 or other digital analytics experience.Knowledge of customer lifetime value, attribution or incrementality.Experience with experimentation, A/B testing or statistical analysis.Exposure to platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Adobe Campaign.
 ABOUT YOUYou’re naturally curious. Finding the answer is great, but you’ll probably have another three questions once you get there.You’re commercially minded and want your analysis to lead somewhere, whether that’s a better customer experience, smarter campaign or stronger commercial result.You can take something complicated and make it simple.You’re comfortable challenging assumptions and following the data rather than looking for the answer someone wants to hear.You enjoy partnering with different teams and building relationships, rather than working in a silo.You’re proactive, organised and comfortable juggling priorities in a fast-moving environment.You’re always looking for a smarter, simpler way of doing things.And, of course... a true KFC believer.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:We offer benefits that make your life that little bit easier, because we know the juggle is real.From flexible, hybrid working to Fri-Yay early finishes and Live Well Days, we’ve created a package that supports the real you, in and out of work.
You’ll get:Hybrid working from our Woking RSC (just 24 mins from London). The tech team come into the office 2 days per week.Up to 11% company pension contributionsFri-Yay finishes at 1pm every Friday25 days’ holiday (plus bank hols) a5 Live Well Days a year, just for youBonus scheme linked to company & personal performancePrivate healthcare, Digital GP access & mental health coachingEnhanced parental leave and flexible return optionsStudy support, income protection, life cover & moreAnd yes—25% off the chicken
Because real ones deserve real rewards.
THE ROAD TO BECOMING A REAL ONE...Apply (Go on... do it) – send us your CV and answer a couple of app questions.Intro call with our Talent TeamVirtual call with Hiring Manager + another team memberVirtual call with Stakeholers F2F interview & Task at our HQ, Home of The Real Ones in Woking
KFC FOR EVERYONE:Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, KFC is a place where you can bring the real you to work.
Our promise is this: every person who applies to a role at KFC, regardless of age, background, ethnicity, gender, ability, religion or sexual orientation, will have an equal opportunity to work here. We don’t just welcome, we encourage applications from underrepresented groups from all industries.
If you’d like any additional support with your application, have a disability or condition that may affect your performance during the recruitment process, or have any other requirements - just let us know. We’ll be there to help you be the real you.
Ready?We hope so, if you’re ready to be part of our community, now’s the time to apply.
Worried you aren’t ticking all the boxes? Don’t - we’d still love to hear from you.
Beware of fake job postings using Yum! and/or our brand logos -- KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and Habit Burger & Grill -- on fraudulent sites. Yum! Brands only posts jobs on official careers pages and never asks for money during onboarding. Avoid unsolicited contacts via Telegram, WhatsApp or similar social apps.

Reporting & Analysis: Deliver reporting, dashboards and ad hoc analysis for internal and external stakeholders as part of the Analyst team's regular workload, and maintain the data roadmap dashboards and associated tracking.Data Science Cover: Provide cover for the Lead Data Scientist during absence or periods of high demand, reducing the single point of failure risk in the consolidated Data Science function.Overflow Capacity: Absorb overflow capacity when multiple B2B Data Science projects are running concurrently, supporting delivery without disrupting core Analyst-team output.Production Support: Support ad hoc manual runs and production tasks tied to the SiQ platform (Group Racing Platform, Python scripts, Sports Data Platform).Model Testing: Assist with testing and validation of new or updated Data Science models under the Lead Data Scientist's direction.Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a day-to-day point of contact for Racing, Sports and B2B stakeholders on data requests, keeping practices consistent with wider Data function standards.
RequirementsStrong analytical skillset, with hands-on experience querying and manipulating data (SQL essential).Confident working in Excel for reporting, tracking and ad hoc analysis.Working knowledge of Python, or a clear ability to pick it up quickly.Comfortable moving between structured, day-to-day analyst work and more exploratory data science problem-solving.Clear, confident communicator, able to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
DesirablePrior exposure to statistical modelling or data science techniques.Experience with AWS (CloudWatch, Batch Jobs, Step Functions) or similar cloud data infrastructure.Interest in or experience with sports or racing data.
Benefits
We offer a range of well-being initiatives, including private medical insurance, excellent parental leave, a working globally policy, mental health support, assistance programs, and social gatherings. We also provide a pension scheme and various other benefit schemes. Plus, we all get our birthdays off work and enjoy 25 days of holiday per year.
We've also got you covered with life assurance and exclusive perks like the Star card and our Step Further Awards (our employee recognition program) to recognise your dedication. For those working via the hybrid model (in the office and at home) we've made commuting easier with our Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme.
You can also take advantage of complimentary access to our Racing Post Members Club, complete with an Ultimate Membership. We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace, and you'll have the chance to volunteer two days per year with our charity partner.

rows.title: Analyst, Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

We are seeking a Business Operations Analyst to support and improve critical business operations across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, and Data teams. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Salesforce order and merchant data, supporting downstream billing processes, improving operational workflows, and driving scalable business process improvements. The role may also support broader business operations, governance, reporting, and priority initiatives across Visa Direct, as required.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in working with cross-functional teams to improve sales processes, pricing controls, data quality, and revenue operations. This individual will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and operational teams to ensure accurate order management, efficient processes, and strong alignment across systems. This role offers broad exposure across business operations, governance, reporting, analytics, process improvement, and priority initiatives within Visa Direct.

Key Responsibilities

Manage Salesforce order maintenance activities, ensuring that client merchant records, sales order items, pricing structures, and related data are accurate and complete for downstream billing and revenue processes.Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, Data, and other operational teams to validate deal structures, pricing accuracy, and system controls.Support the Global Visa Direct BPO Head and designated team members with the timely preparation of required materials, coordination of key deliverables, execution of assigned business priorities, follow-through on agreed actions and effective response to time-sensitive business requests. Maintain visibility into decisions, owners, milestones, risks, and dependencies and proactively raise issues that may impact delivery. Provide analytical, operational, reporting, co-ordination, and project support across evolving business priorities as required.Monitor sales and marketing data to identify trends, reporting gaps, process breakdowns, and data quality issues that may impact business performance or operational efficiency.Identify opportunities to improve existing business processes and partner with management to scope, prioritize, and execute operational improvement projects.Create, document, and drive adoption of new business and system processes that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual work, and enhance data integrity.Serve as a cross-functional liaison across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, operational teams and other business stakeholders to drive alignment and collaboration.Support the development and implementation of scalable controls across business systems to ensure pricing validity, order accuracy, and billing readiness.Analyze operational workflows and recommend forward-thinking solutions that improve sales processes, support accurate revenue recognition, and reduce operational risk.Partner with stakeholders to define business requirements, assess process impacts, and support change management for new tools, workflows, and system enhancements.Prepare insights, reporting, and recommendations for leadership to support business decisions and operational improvements.Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement through process simplification, automation, AI-enabled productivity, and reporting modernization.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Previous experience in business operations, sales operations, revenue operations, order management, billing operations, or a related analytical role.Hands-on experience working with Salesforce, particularly in order management, account records, sales order items, pricing, or opportunity/order workflows.Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, AI tools, including data analysis, reconciliation, structured reporting, and preparation of leadership-ready materials. A good understanding of sales operations processes, deal structures, pricing validation, and downstream billing or revenue recognition impacts.Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support implementation of scalable operational solutions.Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Billing, Data and other business or operational teams.Ability to translate business needs into concise and clear process requirements, controls, actionable recommendations and practical operational workflows.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new processes. Ability to explain complex business concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

rows.title: Digital Surveyor
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

GHD Advisory Data & Insights Team – Digital Surveyor

Join a global profession services leader, committed to solving the world’s biggest challenges across energy, transport, utilities and urbanisation.

We are seeking curious minds with a passion for data-driven problem solving to join and shape our growing Data & Insights team. You will support the delivery of innovative solutions across sectors such as rail, highways, telecoms, water, and future energy, delivering tangible impacts for generations to come.

You’ll have the freedom to explore your interests across diverse projects and sectors, with support and encouragement to develop your skills and experience. We embrace a start-up mentality within a global corporate framework, encouraging autonomous decision making, fresh ideas and agile thinking. Our team structure fosters collaboration and ensures every member feels supported, empowering you to meaningfully contribute to our continuously growing and improving team.

What We Do

We help our clients unlock the full potential of their data and assets by combining cutting-edge technology solutions with our data and analytical expertise. A core part of our offering focuses on creating intelligent digital environments through virtual site modelling, technical engineering automation, and location intelligence.Virtual Site Modelling: We deliver immersive digital representations of physical environments through virtual inspections, advanced surveying techniques, and high-definition 3D visualisation. These models enable clients to explore, assess, and plan with precision, reducing the need for physical site visits and accelerating decision-making.Technical Engineering Automation: Our fully automated suite of engineering design tools transforms traditional workflows. By embedding automation into technical processes, we help clients streamline design, reduce errors, and improve consistency across engineering disciplines.Location Intelligence: We develop world-class solutions in mobility, logistics and GIS using high-volume data sources such as mobile network data. For example, analysing visitor behaviour at major venues and identifying changes in national travel patterns .Digital Asset Management: We combine our knowledge of the infrastructure lifecycle across industries like water, power, rail, and highways, and our expertise in data-driven insights to help our clients make decisions about the stewardship of their assets .

Your Responsibilities

In this dynamic role, you will contribute to the planning and execution of drone-based site surveys, capturing high-resolution spatial and laser scan data to support innovative digital solutions. You’ll transform and integrate raw data into our propriety digital twin platform, implementing cutting-edge technologies such as augmented and virtual reality. Collaborating closely with clients and multidisciplinary teams, you’ll tailor survey methods to unique challenges, communicate findings effectively, and contribute to business growth through technical excellence and strategic insight.

Drone Surveys & Data Capture

Planning and conducting drone-based site surveys across diverse industries and environments.Capturing high-resolution spatial data using unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), and GNSS-enabled equipment.Capturing terrestrial laser scan data.Developing innovative survey methods to meet unique client challenges and improve data quality.

Digital Twin Development & Technology Integration

Post-processing survey data to generate photogrammetry models, point clouds, and spatial reference systems.Integrating processed data into our proprietary digital twin platform to create accurate, interactive representations of real-world sites.Exploring and implementing virtual and augmented reality solutions to enrich client engagement and design workflows.

Client Collaboration & Communication

Working closely with clients to understand site-specific requirements and deliver tailored digital solutions.Communicating survey findings and digital twin outputs clearly, using visual and technical formats suited to varied audiences.Building trust through collaborative site work and transparent reporting, ensuring client expectations are met and exceeded.

Team Contribution & Business Development

Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams to provide precise and actionable site intelligence.Contributing to business growth by identifying new opportunities, supporting bids, and enhancing team capabilities.Innovating and refining survey techniques to meet evolving client needs and improve data quality.

About You

We would love to hear from you if you bring a strong foundation in surveying, data capture, and digital innovation. This role suits someone who is curious, collaborative, and eager to apply cutting-edge technologies to solve real-world challenges.

Personal Characteristics

You are a proactive team player who thrives in both remote and in-person environments.You are willing to visit client sites across the UK when required and can spend nights away from home. We expect this to comprise around 25-50% of your working hoursA full, valid driving license and the ability to travel between sites is required.You are confident and professional when interacting with others, representing the company with integrity and respect during site visits.You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, ensuring clear communication and a positive presence while working in varied environments.You are comfortable working in a dynamic, growing team and contributing to the development of new capabilities.You are an independent thinker who can confidently share ideas and challenge conventional approaches.You have a collaborative working style and understand the importance of diversity and inclusion in the workplace.You must be able to attend remote sites and able to walk over varying terrain.

Previous Experience

Due to the varied nature of our projects, a broad range of experience is beneficial. We’re particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate technical capabilities in surveying, data processing, and digital modelling.

Technical Capabilities

An honours degree or equivalent workplace experience in a relevant field.Experience with GIS, CAD, or BIM systems.Familiarity with spatial data capture equipment such as total stations, GNSS rovers, and laser scanners and the production of topographical datasets.Experience operating drones or other unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) for surveying purposes. Holding a GVC is highly desirable.Experience in post-processing spatial data and integrating it into digital twin platforms is highly desirable.An interest in learning or a beginner skill level in programming languages is desirable.

Management Capabilities

Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to clients and stakeholders.A consulting mindset, with an interest in understanding client needs and delivering tailored solutions.You understand the importance of public perception and client engagement, and act as a trusted representative of the company during fieldwork.You are capable of managing on-site interactions, addressing questions or concerns from stakeholders and the public in a calm and informed manner.Ability to contribute to project planning, delivery, and continuous improvement.Commercial awareness and a willingness to support business development activities.

About GHD

Being the best that we can be is in our culture.

We are a team of smart, innovative, and creative problem solvers. In our employee-owned company, everything feels like it matters more. Challenge us and help us come up with new solutions to ensure water, energy and urbanisation are made sustainable for generations to come.

Our Commitment to you

Commitment is a powerful word that defines how we do business, how we serve our clients and how we care for one another. We will support your needs by giving you the tools, training and support to do your best work and then recognise your achievements. We will set your curiosity free to allow brilliant minds to do their best work. We will invest in new ideas, removing barriers where we can. Finally, we will encourage you to collaborate with thousands of diverse people across our global business.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion lies at the heart of our team culture. We operate a flat intellectual hierarchy meaning every voice is heard and has genuine influence. We believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, and experience, and we recognise the value this brings our collective team approach to solving challenging client problems. Our internal working groups, such as GHD Young Professionals, Pride Alliance and Women in GHD (WING), enable every employee to shape the conversation and help implement initiatives to make GHD a better place to work for all.

Inclusion is hugely important to us, and we want to ensure every team member can balance work around their unique personal circumstances. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a wider variety of benefits to support you, including 25 days paid leave with opportunity to purchase additional leave, matched pension contributions and family-friendly flexible working. As an employee-owned business, you will have the opportunity to obtain shares in GHD, empowering you to shape and share the company’s long-term success. We will advocate for your professional development and provide you with technical development opportunities and mentoring programmes to help you grow and improve your abilities. We actively promote inclusion and equity focussed initiatives, with the example of our STEMAZING partnership, which offers STEM outreach programmes for women. We are always looking to improve the way we collaborate, communicate and operate as a team through regular socials, team strategy days and internal initiatives.

Working Location

This role is based in our London or Guildford office, with the expectation of attending client sites as required.

What next?

If shortlisted, our interview approach is a two-way learning experience. We will give you access to the leadership team and technical leads throughout the application process.

For more information about GHD’s Data & Insights offering, case studies and bios of selected team members, visit our page at:

https://www.ghd.com/en-gb/expertise/advisory/strategic-insights

rows.title: Associate
rows.descriptionText:
ABOUT COMPANYSTRAT7 is a data, analytics, and strategy consultancy that helps clients solve complex business challenges. We combine cutting-edge technology with deep industry expertise to deliver actionable insights that drive growth and transformation. As a group, we bring together experts in data science, AI, consumer insight, commercial strategy, and research methods to provide clients with a complete solution to their business challenges. We embrace agile methodologies across our organization, allowing us to respond quickly to changing market conditions and client needs while delivering high-quality solutions efficiently.

POSITION OVERVIEWYou'd be joining Incite's Atlantic Practice, working with major US and global businesses. This isn't a role where you simply keep projects on track. It is genuinely consultative and needs a true problem solver. You'll shape the thinking, advise clients directly, and influence the strategic direction of the work.One of our biggest clients is MetLife – a major US-based financial services company that offer group benefits, insurance, retirement products and other financial services. Every year, MetLife asks a big question: what do working people need to do their best work, and what are employers getting wrong? The answer becomes the Employee Benefit Trends Study (EBTS), one of the most widely cited pieces of thought leadership in the benefits world.The EBTS programme sits at the centre of the role. It's research of the best kind: big questions about how the workplace is changing, genuine involvement in shaping the themes before any fieldwork begins, and findings that get published and quoted rather than filed away. It is about much more than insurance; it is about understanding how human needs are evolving, what businesses need to succeed, and where the world of work is going next.Beyond MetLife, you'll work across other clients as well, spending approximately 70% of your time on MetLife projects and the other 30% on other clients – with many opportunities to solve interesting strategic challenges and make meaningful impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESShape Research Questions - co-lead brainstorming sessions to define annual research themes. Design research approach, from questionnaires and discussion guides to innovative methods, ensuring the right question gets asked in the right wayTurn data into Insight - work across quantitative and qualitative evidence to uncover the "so what" in the data. Conduct complex analysis, ensure data reliability, and synthesise large datasets into insights worth publishing. Collaborate with analytics specialists when deeper expertise is neededCraft Compelling Narratives - moving beyond data presentation to narrative impact, ensuring findings are matched by strong storytellingBuild Trusted Client Relationships - manage day-to-day relationships with senior stakeholders, positioning as a solutions-focused trusted advisor. See projects through from kickoff to completion, prepare and run client sessions, and begin developing the longer-term partnership relationshipsContribute to Business Development & Capability - support Principals with content creation for pitches and proposal preparation, help shape how STRAT7 Incite present capabilities and win new work

SKILLS & ATTRIBUTESSolid track record in ad-hoc research or consultancy experience, ideally acquired through an agencyGenuine fluency in both qualitative and quantitative methodologies: comfortable designing questionnaires and discussion guides, and clear-eyed about which approach a problem actually needsAble to run core project elements independently and manage timelinesExcels into uncover insights and clearly communicate their strategic implicationsDemonstrates client relationship management, delivering commercially framed research findings that strengthen trust advisory-led relationshipsPossess a problem‑solving mindset, with the confidence to independently resolve day‑to‑day issues while recognising when to seek supportHas a collaborative approach that supports teamwork and best practiceStrong analytical skills, with hands-on experience of SPSS and multivariate techniques

BENEFITSThe role comes with a competitive salary and clear paths to promotion and to new opportunities. Benefits include:
25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays (Christmas closure – 3 days additional to entitlement – discretionary and non-contractual leave)Flexible, hybrid working options – we expect you to be at the office 3 days a weekA contributory group personal pension scheme, to which we contribute 4% of Qualified Banded earnings to each team member’s gross salary after an initial 3 months service4-week sabbatical after 4 years continuous service on top of 25 days holiday2 volunteering paid days per year (under a formal program for a registered charity)A Health cash planLife assurance scheme at 4 x salaryCycle to work scheme following successful completion of probation

RECRUITMENTRecruitment for this role will involves three interviews
DISCLOSURESTRAT7 is an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds, who share a passion for research. Our commitment to inclusivity is not just about race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one's identity. All of our employee's points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

rows.title: Corporate Responsibility Level 4 Data Analyst Apprentice
rows.descriptionText:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

We transform together | Turner & Townsend



Job Description

As a Data Analyst Apprentice within Corporate Responsibility, you will contribute to major corporate initiatives, Annual reports and ESG disclosures across Turner & Townsend’s drive to low carbon future, operating with ethics and integrity and thriving workplaces and communities workstreams. 

We have committed to major ambitions, such as being net zero by 2040, and you will have a vital role managing and interpreting data to support our strategies. Turner & Townsend continue to invest in, and develop, our data and digital transformation initiatives and will support you to develop the skills, knowledge and behaviours required for a successful career in Corporate Responsibility or data analytics. 

You will work alongside a team of Corporate Responsibility experts to handle a growing set of data required to inform decision-making and enable rigorous and transparent data-sharing. You will also work with stakeholders across the business to collect the relevant data sets. This is a critical role as the business grows and our data is increasingly audited and assured as part of mandatory and voluntary requirements that support work-winning and critical business expansion. You will complete the Level 4 Data Analyst Apprenticeship while gaining practical workplace experience in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 

You’ll receive a structured development plan. This plan introduces you to the key business, technical, and commercial competencies that we believe are essential for our apprentices to thrive at Turner & Townsend. It equips you with the necessary tools to manage and monitor your personal and professional development and progress. Rest assured, your line manager and apprentice development manager will be there to guide you throughout your apprenticeship journey 

Key Responsibilities 

Support business process mapping and documentation.  Assist with requirements gathering and stakeholder workshops: stakeholder engagement and communication skills. Identify, collate, quality assure and process appropriate data across Corporate Responsibility topics Collect, compile and manage data inputs and outputs Produce performance dashboards and share analytic insights Support with testing and implementation of new data collection systems Identify and analyse trends, business challenges and identify improvement opportunities. Support with report drafting and other summaries for governance processes (e.g. Steering Group and Board reporting) Draw conclusions and promote recommendations or next actions Summarise and present data Follow appropriate quality assurance, control and accuracy processes Practice continuous self-learning to keep up to date with technological developments to enhance relevant skills and professional development Business analysis techniques and methodologies. Problem-solving and analytical thinking. Professional working practices and teamwork. What We’re Looking For 

Analytical, curious, collaborative individuals passionate about environmental, social, ethical and responsible ways of working Self-motivated to understand how organisations work and the role of data supporting rigorous decision-making Strong communicators with an interest in data, transformation and analysis Collaborative and proactive problem‑solvers Passionate about developing a career in sustainability, corporate responsibility and/or data analytics and process managementCareer Progression 

Successful completion may lead to direct hire opportunities and/or opportunities to progress into higher-level digital, data, technology or business analysis roles. 

The Corporate Responsibility department within Central Services is responsible for an expanding remit across Environmental, Social, and Governance themes, with increasing need to evidence high-quality data that supports all activity we promote across the business. Therefore, the opportunities for progression are likely to continue expanding. The skills learned during this Apprenticeship will also be highly-valuable as transferable skills to many other roles, not limited to Corporate Responsibility or Data Analytics/Science career paths. 



Qualifications

You will be enrolled on the Level 4 Business Analyst Apprenticeship, typically lasting 18 months. Training will be delivered through a blend of workplace learning, online study and workshops. Turner & Towsend will support you in the process and will also enrol you in appropriate and, in some cases, mandatory training that will further enhance your qualification and learning experience. 

Entry Requirements 

Right to live and work in the UK and apprenticeship eligibility requirements. Minimum of five GCSEs at grades 4-9 including English Language and Mathematics. Strong interest in data analytics, process and responsible, social, and environmental business practices. 

Additional Information

Benefits

25 Days annual leaveBuy and Sell annual leaveCorporate Gym MembershipCycle schemePension 

Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects: 

Twitter

Instagram

LinkedIn

rows.descriptionText:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilitiesDesign and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.

What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Agency

RAPP

Job Description

Critical Mass is looking for a bright, curious and detail-focused Data Selections Analyst to join our growing team in London.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with experience in data selection, processing or direct marketing who wants to develop their career within an agency environment. You’ll work as part of a specialist Data Selections team, sitting at the intersection of Marketing, Data Planning, Analytics and Operations and supporting campaigns for a large, high-profile client.

The role offers exposure to complex datasets, campaign targeting and selection, data quality and analysis, as well as opportunities to get involved in new tools, technologies and project work.

What you'll be doing

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Working with Client Leadership and delivery teams to understand project briefs and translate requirements into clear data specifications.Creating data briefs and working with Data Planners to implement campaign targeting and test plans.Selecting and processing data for multi-channel campaigns, including direct mail, email, SMS and other customer communications.Working with large and complex datasets while maintaining a high level of data accuracy and integrity.Carrying out data quality checks, campaign counts and queries throughout the production process.Performing quality assurance checks on your own work and reviewing selections produced by colleagues.Supporting campaign development through ad hoc analysis and data queries.Producing regular reports and completing day-to-day data administration.Using data and analytical tools to respond to customer queries and information requests.Getting involved in project work, process improvements and opportunities to introduce new tools and technologies.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about data, enjoys solving problems and takes pride in getting the detail right.

Experience with Siebel would be beneficial, but full training will be provided.SQL experience would be useful, but isn't essential.Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work.The ability to interpret data, identify issues and explain findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage deadlines in a busy environment.A collaborative approach and the confidence to work with colleagues across different teams.A willingness to learn new systems, tools and ways of working.

Locations: Gurgaon | London

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.

Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.

We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.

Key Activities And Responsibilities Include

In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formatsWork with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation

What You'll Bring

University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subjectExperience working in a multi-national or large scale environmentData Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectivelyCuriosity and focus on continuous development, learningCreativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologiesProject and Program Management a plus

Who You'll Work With

The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.

Additional info

You’re Good At

Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholdersWorking in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirementsData Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizationsStructuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detailCulture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statementsLearning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Salary up to: Competitive

Data Analyst

Overall Ambition

Nando’s is on a journey to Create Lasting Happiness, making a difference to the lives of our people, our customers, and the communities we work in. Originally started in Johannesburg, South Africa, we pride ourselves on creating memorable experiences for everyone involved in Nando’s: from our employees, communities, founders, and suppliers, but most importantly, our customers.

Whilst we always look back on our history and story with pride, the story is still evolving. We have recently been growing our digital capabilities to ensure the Nando’s experience remains relevant to modern-day customers.

You will be joining a tech team that has grown rapidly in the past five years and is determined to enable change within the restaurant industry by bringing innovative thinking and the latest technology tools and practices to solve some of its most complex problems.

The Data and Analysis Team

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data and Analysis team. Our remit is to ensure everyone has access to the right information, at the right time, and that Nando’s gets the best value out of our data to achieve our business goals.

Our current focus is extracting insights from the data and creating a single source of accurate, timely data as we continue to increase our data maturity and advance our predictive analytic capability and explore the role of AI in the business.

You will be part of our work to support our strategic goals and build a data-informed attitude for addressing our opportunities and challenges.

Our Values

At Nando’s, our values guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for each other every day:

Pride – We take pride in everything we do, from the quality of our food to the impact of our work.Passion – We bring energy, enthusiasm, and a love for what we do.Courage – We speak up, challenge the status quo, and are not afraid to try new things.Integrity – We do the right thing, act honestly, and build trust with each other.Family – We care for and support one another, creating a sense of belonging where everyone can thrive.

What We're Looking For

As a Data Analyst you will work across a wide range of domains from financial and operational data, to kitchen tech and stock, helping our teams make better decisions grounded in sound analysis. As a curious problem-solver, you will be able to move between the technical and the commercial; and be comfortable building data models as well as presenting findings to senior stakeholders.

In this role you’ll work independently across the full data stack, understanding the ‘why’ behind requests before jumping to the ‘what’, and contributing to the translation of business problems into well-defined, actionable work. You’ll be supported by a collaborative team and won’t be expected to deliver everything solo from day one, but you’ll be expected to grow into doing so.

You will…

Write and maintain SQL models (in Dataform) to transform and serve reliable data across our pipelinesSupport data engineers in the design, building and testing of data pipelines, able to contribute meaningfully, not just consume the outputBuild and iterate on cloud-based reports and dashboards in Looker (or similar BI tool), giving our support teams and restaurants clear, actionable insight into performanceTranslate business questions into well-scoped analysis and understand the problem and domain before reaching for the answerCommunicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, choosing the right medium for the audiencePeer review colleagues’ work and contribute to data quality standards and documentationIdentify opportunities to automate manual processes and data tasks, and take the initiative to implement them

Skills Required

You will have proven experience in the following:

Writing complex SQL to query, transform and model data across our cloud data platform (window functions, CTEs, complex datatypes)Building and maintaining data models in Dataform, or a similar data transformation tool such as Snowflake or DBT, with an understanding of how they fit into the broader pipelineBuilding reports and dashboards in Looker or a similar BI tool, serving reliable, self-serve data to the businessUsing Git as standard practice — branching, pull requests and code reviewContributing to the translation of business requests into clearly scoped, actionable work itemsApplying data quality techniques — writing tests, identifying issues proactively and communicating data limitations clearlyDocumenting data models, definitions and lineage to a production standardUnderstanding data governance principles and championing good data management practice within the teamApplying and understanding when to use relevant statistical methods to support analysisSupporting data engineers in designing, coding and testing data processing pipelinesUsing AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude) to improve the speed and quality of your work — critically, not blindly — with an awareness of responsible AI use and data governance implications

You will also display

Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain complex findings in plain language and tell the story behind the dataGenuine intellectual curiosity, actively exploring new tools and methods, including AI, and sharing what you learn with the teamComfort with ambiguity, able to define the right question and find the “so what” before jumping to answerA product mindset, understanding the business objective behind every piece of analysis, not just the request on the surfaceA proactive approach to improving processes, data quality and ways of working, with the initiative to make it happen, not just flag itA collaborative team attitude, peer reviewing others’ work, sharing knowledge and contributing to a stronger team

Inclusion

At Nando’s, everyone is welcome. Inspired by our Southern African heritage we know and value the richness that diversity brings to Nando’s. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful culture for all; including our existing and future Nandocas, partners and suppliers, customers and the communities we are a part of. We deliberately work hard to create an environment where every individual is valued, respected and can flourish regardless of who they are, their background or outlook on life.

We welcome applications from a diverse range of individuals and will consider any reasonable adjustments in order to enable candidates to perform as well as possible during the recruitment process.

rows.title: Senior Customer Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Welcome to KFC. Home of the real ones.We sell the world’s best chicken. Seriously. And we’ve done it since 1939, when the idea of crispy, original recipe chicken took Kentucky by storm. Now, we’re proud to serve 1000+ communities across the UK and Ireland, bringing the grit, pride and iconic reputation that we started with, all those years ago.
Across the Restaurant Support Centre (RSC), we come to work to be ourselves, and to make something of ourselves. We want to see our potential go that little bit further, as part of one of the world’s most iconic brands.
What’s the gig? Well, you support our restaurants - and we’ll support you every step of the way. Simple. Our doors are open - and they can take you anywhere.
All we ask is that you be you. Because that makes us, us. Sound good? Great. Let’s find out about that job.
THE TEAMOur Tech team is a 60+ strong team of curious minds, building the digital experiences that power KFC – from app to kiosk, delivery to checkout. We work cross-functionally, move fast, and stay focused on what matters: creating smart solutions that make things better for our customers and our teams.
ABOUT THE ROLEAt KFC, we have millions of customers choosing us every week, across restaurants, drive-thrus, kiosks, delivery and digital. That creates a lot of data. The exciting bit is what we do with it.We’re looking for a Data Analyst, Loyalty & CRM to help us better understand our customers, how they behave and what keeps them coming back for more.
Sitting within our Data & Analytics team and partnering closely with Loyalty, CRM and Marketing, you’ll dig into customer, transactional and marketing data to uncover insights that can genuinely influence what we do next.
You might be exploring why certain customers visit more frequently, identifying opportunities to increase loyalty and retention, understanding which campaigns actually changed behaviour, or spotting a commercial opportunity hidden within millions of transactions.
Yes, you’ll build brilliant reporting. But this role goes much further than telling us what happened. We want someone curious enough to ask why it happened, why it matters and what we should do about it.
If you love solving problems with data, understand customers and can turn complex analysis into a story that gets people to act, this could be for you.
WHAT YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME DOING
Customer Analytics & Insight
You’ll help us understand our customers better and turn that understanding into commercial opportunities.You’ll:Analyse customer, transactional, loyalty and marketing data to identify trends, behaviours, risks and opportunities.Measure how our Loyalty programme is performing and identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention and customer value.Build customer segmentation and behavioural analysis to support more relevant, personalised experiences.Understand customer acquisition, frequency, spend, retention and lifetime value.Evaluate campaigns, promotions and loyalty activity to understand what’s working and where we can improve.Turn complex datasets into simple, actionable recommendations.Proactively look for opportunities where insight can improve customer experience and commercial performance.
Reporting & Visualisation
Great decisions need data people can trust and understand.You’ll:Build, automate and maintain dashboards using Power BI and other reporting tools.Create clear reporting across customer behaviour, loyalty, campaign effectiveness and commercial performance.Establish consistent KPIs and reporting standards across Loyalty and Marketing analytics.Make sure reporting is accurate, scalable and easy to understand, whether the audience is technical or not.Continuously improve how we work through better automation, data quality and simpler reporting.
Business Partnering
This isn’t an analyst role where you disappear into the data and send someone a spreadsheet.You’ll:Partner closely with Loyalty, CRM and Marketing to understand the business problem before jumping into the analysis.Act as the dedicated Data & Analytics partner for Loyalty, helping turn questions and opportunities into clear analytical approaches.Work across Commercial Finance, Digital, Operations, Technology and the wider Data & Analytics team.Partner with Data Engineering to make sure the data you need is available, trusted and fit for purpose.Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders across the business.Help us build a culture where data and evidence genuinely influence the decisions we make.
WHAT WE’D LOVE FROM YOUWe’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical capability with real commercial curiosity.
You’ll ideally bring:Strong SQL skills and confidence interrogating large datasets independently.Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualisation tools.Experience working with customer, transactional or commercial data.Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a great eye for detail.An understanding of data quality, validation and governance.Strong Excel capability.Experience delivering analytics within Customer, Marketing, CRM, Loyalty or another commercially focused environment.Examples of using data and insight to influence a commercial or strategic decision.Confidence working cross-functionally and explaining analysis to people who don’t live and breathe data.
A degree in a relevant discipline is useful, but equivalent professional experience is just as valuable.Even better if you have...CRM, loyalty or customer engagement analytics experience.Customer segmentation or behavioural analytics experience.Experience measuring marketing and campaign effectiveness.GA4 or other digital analytics experience.Knowledge of customer lifetime value, attribution or incrementality.Experience with experimentation, A/B testing or statistical analysis.Exposure to platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Adobe Campaign.
 ABOUT YOUYou’re naturally curious. Finding the answer is great, but you’ll probably have another three questions once you get there.You’re commercially minded and want your analysis to lead somewhere, whether that’s a better customer experience, smarter campaign or stronger commercial result.You can take something complicated and make it simple.You’re comfortable challenging assumptions and following the data rather than looking for the answer someone wants to hear.You enjoy partnering with different teams and building relationships, rather than working in a silo.You’re proactive, organised and comfortable juggling priorities in a fast-moving environment.You’re always looking for a smarter, simpler way of doing things.And, of course... a true KFC believer.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:We offer benefits that make your life that little bit easier, because we know the juggle is real.From flexible, hybrid working to Fri-Yay early finishes and Live Well Days, we’ve created a package that supports the real you, in and out of work.
You’ll get:Hybrid working from our Woking RSC (just 24 mins from London). The tech team come into the office 2 days per week.Up to 11% company pension contributionsFri-Yay finishes at 1pm every Friday25 days’ holiday (plus bank hols) a5 Live Well Days a year, just for youBonus scheme linked to company & personal performancePrivate healthcare, Digital GP access & mental health coachingEnhanced parental leave and flexible return optionsStudy support, income protection, life cover & moreAnd yes—25% off the chicken
Because real ones deserve real rewards.
THE ROAD TO BECOMING A REAL ONE...Apply (Go on... do it) – send us your CV and answer a couple of app questions.Intro call with our Talent TeamVirtual call with Hiring Manager + another team memberVirtual call with Stakeholers F2F interview & Task at our HQ, Home of The Real Ones in Woking
KFC FOR EVERYONE:Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, KFC is a place where you can bring the real you to work.
Our promise is this: every person who applies to a role at KFC, regardless of age, background, ethnicity, gender, ability, religion or sexual orientation, will have an equal opportunity to work here. We don’t just welcome, we encourage applications from underrepresented groups from all industries.
If you’d like any additional support with your application, have a disability or condition that may affect your performance during the recruitment process, or have any other requirements - just let us know. We’ll be there to help you be the real you.
Ready?We hope so, if you’re ready to be part of our community, now’s the time to apply.
Worried you aren’t ticking all the boxes? Don’t - we’d still love to hear from you.
Beware of fake job postings using Yum! and/or our brand logos -- KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and Habit Burger & Grill -- on fraudulent sites. Yum! Brands only posts jobs on official careers pages and never asks for money during onboarding. Avoid unsolicited contacts via Telegram, WhatsApp or similar social apps.

About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

We are seeking a Business Operations Analyst to support and improve critical business operations across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, and Data teams. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Salesforce order and merchant data, supporting downstream billing processes, improving operational workflows, and driving scalable business process improvements. The role may also support broader business operations, governance, reporting, and priority initiatives across Visa Direct, as required.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in working with cross-functional teams to improve sales processes, pricing controls, data quality, and revenue operations. This individual will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and operational teams to ensure accurate order management, efficient processes, and strong alignment across systems. This role offers broad exposure across business operations, governance, reporting, analytics, process improvement, and priority initiatives within Visa Direct.

Key Responsibilities

Manage Salesforce order maintenance activities, ensuring that client merchant records, sales order items, pricing structures, and related data are accurate and complete for downstream billing and revenue processes.Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, Data, and other operational teams to validate deal structures, pricing accuracy, and system controls.Support the Global Visa Direct BPO Head and designated team members with the timely preparation of required materials, coordination of key deliverables, execution of assigned business priorities, follow-through on agreed actions and effective response to time-sensitive business requests. Maintain visibility into decisions, owners, milestones, risks, and dependencies and proactively raise issues that may impact delivery. Provide analytical, operational, reporting, co-ordination, and project support across evolving business priorities as required.Monitor sales and marketing data to identify trends, reporting gaps, process breakdowns, and data quality issues that may impact business performance or operational efficiency.Identify opportunities to improve existing business processes and partner with management to scope, prioritize, and execute operational improvement projects.Create, document, and drive adoption of new business and system processes that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual work, and enhance data integrity.Serve as a cross-functional liaison across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, operational teams and other business stakeholders to drive alignment and collaboration.Support the development and implementation of scalable controls across business systems to ensure pricing validity, order accuracy, and billing readiness.Analyze operational workflows and recommend forward-thinking solutions that improve sales processes, support accurate revenue recognition, and reduce operational risk.Partner with stakeholders to define business requirements, assess process impacts, and support change management for new tools, workflows, and system enhancements.Prepare insights, reporting, and recommendations for leadership to support business decisions and operational improvements.Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement through process simplification, automation, AI-enabled productivity, and reporting modernization.

Qualifications

Previous experience in business operations, sales operations, revenue operations, order management, billing operations, or a related analytical role.Hands-on experience working with Salesforce, particularly in order management, account records, sales order items, pricing, or opportunity/order workflows.Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, AI tools, including data analysis, reconciliation, structured reporting, and preparation of leadership-ready materials. A good understanding of sales operations processes, deal structures, pricing validation, and downstream billing or revenue recognition impacts.Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support implementation of scalable operational solutions.Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Billing, Data and other business or operational teams.Ability to translate business needs into concise and clear process requirements, controls, actionable recommendations and practical operational workflows.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new processes. Ability to explain complex business concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.
