parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Role Summary 

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients.  

   

All over the world, Pfizer colleagues work together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Our colleagues can grow and develop a career that offers both individual and company success; be part of an ownership culture that values diversity and where all colleagues are energized and engaged; and can impact the health and lives of millions of people. Pfizer, a global leader in the biopharmaceutical industry, is continuously seeking top talent who are inspired by our purpose to innovate to bring therapies to patients that significantly improve their lives.  

   

Pfizer has a deep heritage and leadership in cardiovascular disease, and we are committed to providing breakthroughs that change patients’ lives.  An integral part of Internal Medicine, the Cardiology (CARD) Team’s mission is to promote a breakthrough therapy for patients suffering from NVAF or VTE.   

   

The CARD Health & Science Professional (HSP) is responsible for increasing territory sales and relationship development with assigned customers and accounts by engaging in product promotion and determining the best strategies to manage their business.   

   

A CARD HSP should possess customer, market, and business acumen, analytical skills, and strong product and disease state knowledge; demonstrate ability to drive sales, promotional and strategic business development and management skills, and in-depth customer engagement expertise both in-person and virtually; demonstrate outstanding communication and teamwork skills; be adept in the operation of digital and virtual tools; and be effective at working remotely in collaboration with cross-functional internal teams to address customer needs and compliantly deliver on Pfizer business objectives.  

   

Role Responsibilities 

Drives sales in assigned territory   Engages with customers both face to face and virtually   Develops and implements effective business and territory call plans; effectively identifies and implements live/virtual engagement strategies with customer to maximize overall effectiveness and impact   Effectively builds rapport and relationships with customers in both live and virtual environments; uses judgment to maintain customer engagement by successfully utilizing existing and ever-changing digital tools effectively for successful customer engagement   Understands and leverages internal reports and analytics to assist with identifying, developing, and implementing strategic business opportunities   Compliantly leverages product and disease state knowledge to appropriately educate providers on unbranded and branded product value proposition for relevant patient populations and effectively and strategically utilizes approved clinically oriented disease state information and patient resources, as applicable   Demonstrates strong teamwork capabilities to collaborate effectively and compliantly across the organization to address customer inquiries and advance Pfizer objectives.   Completes all administrative expectations on time and compliantly.   

   

Basic Qualifications  

Bachelor’s Degree   Minimum 2 years of experience in one or more of the following OR an associate’s degree with 6+ years of experience; OR high school diploma (or equivalent) with 8+ years of relevant experience:   Professional Sales or Promotional Activity   Small Business Owner or other Entrepreneurial experience, Marketing, Customer Service and/or Account Management   Relevant Healthcare/Scientific roles (e.g., RN, Pharmacist, PT, OT, etc.)   Educator (e.g., Teacher, Principal)   Full Time Military experience   Must live within 25 miles of the border of the territory.   Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards.  Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired.  

Preferred Qualifications 

1 year of pharmaceutical, biotech, medical sales and/or medical related marketing.   Strong track record of sales or marketing success, strong territory management skills, outstanding communications skills, as well as demonstrated teamwork, leadership ability and accountability.   Experience with applicable disease states, therapeutic area, and products.    Knowledge of posted territory customers and markets (prescribers/HCPs/institutions/organizations).   Reside within the territory boundaries.   

Other Job Details

Territory Includes: Bay Ridge, Brooklyn Heights, Dumbo, Bensonhurt, Fort Hamilton, Dyker Beach, Park Slope, Sunset Park, Prospect Heights, Greenwood Heights, Mapleton, Vinegar Hill, Columbia WaterfrontLast Date to Apply: October 14, 2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $76,000 - $199,600. During initial new hire sales training, you will be classified as a salary non-exempt employee which entitles you to overtime pay. Upon your training certification, you will become an overtime exempt employee. In addition, this position offers an additional quarterly Sales Incentive bonus. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. rows.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Our Growth Marketing team pursues efficient growth through experimentation and customer insight. As Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy, execution and roadmap for deepening subscriber engagement, improving retention, and growing customer lifetime value.

You will turn customer behavior and business priorities into clear choices about which audiences, journeys, and experiments deserve investment. You will define success, align cross-functional partners, and translate results into the next set of growth decisions. Strong hands-on CRM fluency will help you guide execution, challenge assumptions, and bring high-impact ideas to market.

Responsibilities

Lifecycle strategy and priorities. Build a quarterly roadmap grounded in subscriber needs, cohort performance, and commercial opportunity. Prioritize initiatives by expected impact, effort, dependencies, and learning value; make clear recommendations about what to scale, change, or stop.Retention and customer value. Set goals with Growth leadership and Data for churn, order frequency, and LTV. Connect lifecycle performance to incremental revenue and sustainable customer behavior, and recommend where to invest for the strongest return.Customer and journey strategy. Shape segmentation and personalization using lifecycle stage, ordering patterns, engagement, and churn signals. Define how email, SMS, push, and in-app experiences work together to encourage repeat ordering and strengthen the subscriber relationship.Experimentation and offer strategy. Own a hypothesis-led learning agenda across messaging, journeys, offers, and contact frequency. Partner with Data on holdouts, incrementality, and sound test design; assess promotion costs and longer-term retention alongside near-term conversion.Cross-functional direction. Partner with Product, Data, Portfolio, Brand, and Engineering to address subscriber friction and unlock growth opportunities. Write clear briefs, align dependencies and resourcing needs, and influence shared priorities through evidence.Performance and decision making. Lead lifecycle performance reviews with a clear account of what changed, why it matters, and what to do next. Present trade-offs and recommendations to senior stakeholders, and turn successful tests into repeatable programs.Scalable delivery and AI adoption. Guide the standards for journey design, measurement, and execution quality. Prioritize AI-assisted workflows and automation that improve speed or effectiveness, evaluate their impact, and stay close enough to Braze and campaign delivery to coach, troubleshoot, and unblock work.

Qualifications

Relevant depth. 6+ years in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or retention for consumer businesses, with meaningful experience in a subscription or marketplace model and scaled customer audiences.Strategic ownership. A track record of setting lifecycle priorities and leading programs that measurably improve retention, repeat purchasing, or LTV. You can explain the business problem, your choices, and the incremental impact of your work.Analytical judgment. Confidence working with cohort analysis, segmentation, experimentation, and customer economics. You know how to distinguish correlation from causation and balance short-term conversion with durable customer value.Technical and channel fluency. Strong knowledge of email, SMS, push, and in-app CRM, plus hands-on experience with Braze or a comparable platform. You can translate a strategic idea into actionable journey, audience, data, and measurement requirements.Influence and communication. The ability to align cross-functional partners, communicate trade-offs clearly, and make a persuasive recommendation to senior stakeholders. You bring structure to ambiguous problems and move work forward without relying on formal authority.Ownership and adaptability. Strong prioritization and project leadership, a high bar for customer experience, and the ability to adjust direction as evidence and business needs change. You actively explore where AI and automation can improve the team’s work.

Preferred Requirements

Experience with Tableau, Mixpanel, SQL, or other analytics tools.Experience designing automated or AI-assisted marketing workflows.Mentoring teammates or leading complex cross-functional initiatives experience

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Awesome opportunity to join a company that is looking to change how we eat and how chefs work!

About CookUnity

CookUnity is the first Chef-Direct Subscription service—a chef-to-food lover marketplace connecting the country's most talented chefs with eaters (consumers). We’re changing meal delivery by bringing small-batch, restaurant-quality meals to eaters across the country. Every week, a diverse collective of all-star chefs craft their signature, ready-to-eat dishes for an elevated at-home dining experience. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. rows.title: Social Media Specialist

Great teams make the #Best8Hours of your day. At Seneca Resorts & Casinos, we work hard, celebrate often, and build a culture people actually want to be part of.

The Social Media Specialist acts as a key liaison between Seneca Resorts & Casinos and all of the social media touch points, including but not limited to, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Instagram, A large portion of this role requires an active presence at all Seneca Gaming Corporation properties to capture live coverage of promotions, entertainment, and events for real-time audience engagement. This self-motivating position requires incumbents to research, coordinate, schedule and follow-up with various parties in order to successfully determine and meet project deadlines while ensuring that brand and quality standards are met in accordance with current best practices of social media communication. All duties are to be performed within the guidelines of the Seneca Gaming Corporation’s policies and procedures, Internal Control Standards and objectives. In addition to handling social media marketing, this incumbent would also manage social media customer response to track and respond in a timely manner to all comments and questions that come in through each platform.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

 Execute a comprehensive social media strategy that raises visibility, revenue and traffic across all Seneca properties, including strategies for channel selection, influencers and engagement, target audience follower acquisition and content development. Recommend, execute and/or oversee the execution of all social media activities across platforms, including, but not limited to, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn. Maintain posting schedule and cadence across all social media platforms. Ideate and create content for SRC social media channels, including but not limited to: Promotion, entertainment, and events live coverage Reactive content based on trends, news, or guest interaction Memes and trends aligned with brand voice Sponsored and partnership content integration Community-focused content highlighting guest experiences and local partnerships Collaborate with and train content contributors and maintain cross-platform editorial calendars. Analyze published content and translate anecdotal or qualitative data into social media content that elicits response or action among target audiences. Analyze and report on campaign performance for impact and influence on pipeline/revenue generation. Monitor, moderate and engage with audiences and handle social media customer response. Help, organize and translate internal marketing goals across properties, divisions and events into a consistent and streamlined social media marketing plan. Communicate with all property departments and internal clients as needed for all marketing/advertising needs. Attend events as needed in order to push out content as it occurs for audience engagement. Attend marketing and internal client meetings for all properties to report on work status and obtain input for future projects. Work with key advertising department contacts to obtain information on necessary website updates from departments such as promotions, entertainment, food & beverage, slots/table games and any other website areas in need of updating. Maintain department and administrative records and files of jobs and campaigns. Provide exceptional customer service to all patrons and communicate in a pleasant, friendly and professional manner at all times. Maintain a professional work environment with supervisors, managers and staff. Meet the attendance guidelines of the job and adhere to regulatory, departmental and company policies. Must complete all required SGC Training programs within nine (9) months from commencement of employment. Duties, responsibilities, requirements and expectations pertaining to this job are subject to change as needed. Hours are determined by a 24-hour schedule.

Education/Experience

 Must be 18 years of age or older upon employment. High school diploma or its equivalency required. Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or other related field is required. Two (2) years in a social media position for a brand, agency or media organization required. Excellent written and verbal skills. Knowledge of content creation across platforms. Expert knowledge in social media best practices. Experience managing multiple social media channels. Experience with Adobe Photoshop and Premiere Pro preferred High level procedural and organizational skills. Familiarity with online moderating or has served as an online moderator. Knowledge of online advertising, email marketing, interactive technologies, and website development and experiences. Proven writing/journalistic and proofreading skills; some editorial experience helpful. Ability to use Microsoft Office products such as Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as other associated desktop publishing software or similar software expertise, with ability to work remotely using laptop. Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and be able to substantiate a safe driving record within the parameters acceptable to our liability insurance carrier.

Language Skills And Reasoning Ability

 Must be extremely detail oriented and possess excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must possess exceptional multi-tasking capabilities. Ability to write routine correspondence and to speak effectively to the public, employees and customers. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Must have the ability to deal effectively and interact well with the customers and employees. Must have the ability to resolve problems/conflicts in a diplomatic and tactful manner.

Physical Requirements And Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately loud.  Adequate manual dexterity to operate office equipment. Light lifting. Occasional travel. Must be able to effectively understand and communicate to candidates and employees. rows.title: Senior Analyst, Advisory

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Novata

Novata is a public benefit corporation created and funded by a unique consortium of foundations and private sector companies including the Ford Foundation, the Omidyar Network, S&P Global, and Hamilton Lane. We are a for-profit, mission-driven company with a goal of empowering the private markets to build a more inclusive and sustainable form of capitalism. By bringing together expertise in financial data, private equity, social justice, and responsible investing, we build the best technology and advisory services for private markets to collect, analyse, benchmark, and report ESG data. We are a certified B Corp and have an experienced, diverse team as ambitious about growing a successful company as about making an impact.

Novata is proud to have acquired Atlas Metrics to expand our global reach and expand our product innovation. Together, we make sustainability even simpler for private markets. Now, 400+ clients and over 13,000 companies worldwide count on Novata to make collecting, reporting, and acting on sustainability data easy.

About Novata Advisory

Backed by platform data and insights from more than 13,000 private companies, Novata Advisory enhances our market-leading technology solution with a suite of offerings that maximise the value of the Novata experience, partnering with private equity GPs and their portfolio companies to translate ESG data into decisions that drive measurable value. The Advisory team works across the full ESG spectrum, from carbon accounting and climate risk to governance, social, and impact reporting, delivering engagements that are directly integrated with Novata's technology platform.

Advisory is purpose-built to challenge the traditional consulting model: AI-led offerings and workflows, vibe coding, prototyping, custom solutions, and a tight feedback loop with Product mean that Advisory operates as both a client delivery function and an engine for innovation. The Advisory team is intentionally lean, tech-enabled, and strategically linked to Novata's product roadmap, enabling efficient client delivery, building custom AI solutions for clients, and setting a new standard for what ESG advisory can look like in private markets.

Job Summary

As a Senior Analyst, Advisory, you will support project delivery across the full breadth of Novata's ESG and sustainability offerings, spanning climate risk, carbon, ESG reporting, and regulatory workstreams. You will also play a core role in Novata's ESG due diligence work, supporting research and analysis for private markets diligence engagements. This role will engage directly with the clients and be responsible for preparing client-ready deliverables.

This is a generalist role suited to someone who is ready to build upon their existing experience and expand their expertise , or transitioning into this work from an adjacent field.

You will report directly to an Advisory Director and work closely with a small, high-performing, US-based team. This role is for a practitioner who is analytically rigorous, detail-oriented, and energized by the intersection of private markets, sustainability, data, and technology, while considering how new AI tools can drive greater efficiency and innovation. You should also have a strong ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and drive meaningful outcomes.

This role is based in the US - NYC preferred in a hybrid capacity.

What You'll Be Doing

Client Delivery

Support end-to-end delivery on ESG advisory engagements with client-ready deliverables across climate risk, carbon, and regulatory workstreams, including data quality checks, data analysis, reporting deliverables, materiality assessments, carbon accounting, and climate risk. This will include project management and require ownership over certain workstreams, with support from the Advisory team. Deliver portfolio-level ESG analysis and benchmarking using Novata's platform and proprietary datasets.Guide clients through data collection processes and iterative improvement of their ESG programs, including the use of AI tools, as directed by engagement leads.Support ESG due diligence engagements for investor transactions, including regulatory scans, risk identification, and drafting memos. Leverage AI tools and workflows for client delivery while maintaining rigorous QA standards. 

Subject Matter Development

Build working knowledge across core ESG and sustainability frameworks (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, EDCI, GRI, SASB) relevant to Novata's Advisory offerings.Monitor regulatory and market developments across the ESG landscape and flag implications for ongoing client work.Contribute to internal methodological resources, technical guidance documents, and training materials under the direction of senior team members.

Offering & Process Support

Provide input on the design and refinement of Novata's ESG advisory offerings based on client feedback and delivery experience.Support commercial activities as needed, including research for proposals, scoping materials, and pitch preparation.Collaborate with Product and Customer Success teams to relay client needs and support platform improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate across Novata teams on an ongoing basis to ensure high-quality outcomes, continuous platform improvement, and an excellent client experience. This is fundamental to how the Advisory team works with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing.Support the development of new product solutions based on delivery experience and user feedback.

About You

Experience & Background

At least 2 years of industry experience in a related field, e.g., ESG advisory, sustainability, private equity, or an ESG/carbon data and technology provider.Advanced degree in relevant field strongly preferred.Broad exposure to ESG topics preferred over deep specialization in a single area; candidates with backgrounds spanning environmental, social, governance, impact, or regulatory disclosure work are encouraged to apply.Demonstrated proficiency with core ESG frameworks and standards (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, GRI, SASB); comfortable interpreting and applying guidance across industries and levels of company maturity.Exposure to due diligence work (M&A, transaction support, or portfolio company risk assessment) is a plus but not essential.Experience working with or alongside technology platforms, AI solutions, SaaS products, or digital data solutions, either as a user or implementer, is required, as is comfort operating in a tech-enabled, data-driven environment.Prior experience working with or for private equity firms, institutional investors, or their portfolio companies is a plus but not essential.

Skills & Capabilities

Data fluency; comfortable identifying, pulling, and analysing datasets and translating insights into actions and stakeholder narratives.Adept at synthesising feedback from various stakeholders into actionable input for product and offering development.Strong analytical and writing abilities to help articulate ESG topics to novices and experts alike.Excellent Excel skills and/or other analytical software.Motivation and interest to undertake research across the ESG space, including regulatory and diligence research.Hands-on experience using AI tools in a professional context, for example, using LLMs for research synthesis, drafting, or analysis.Proactive, with the ability and confidence to use initiative.Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines.

Character & Working Style

Intellectually rigorous and detail-oriented; you take care with accuracy and are comfortable asking questions rather than guessing.Proactive and self-directed; comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving team.Adaptable and eager to build breadth across ESG topics rather than narrow specialisation, at least in the early stages of this role.Curious and technology-enabled; actively seeks out new tools, technologies, and AI capabilities to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of their work.Mission-driven; genuinely committed to making private markets more sustainable and solving complex problems.Client-focused; takes pride in producing high-quality, accurate work that supports the broader team's client relationships.

Important Notes

This role is based in New York, with hybrid working arrangements (2 days in office).Applicants must be located in and eligible to work in the US. Unfortunately, we are unable to support visa applications or relocation at this time.

Benefits

Competitive salary plus stock optionsGenerous PTO policy including public holidaysComprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage401(k) plan with employer matchPurpose-driven, inclusive cultureThe opportunity to be part of a growing team at the forefront of ESG and private markets innovation

Why Join Us?

Novata is a mission-first company built to enable the private markets to drive more impact. We are at the unique intersection of ESG, the private markets, and mission driven impact. We are well-funded, have a top tier executive leadership team. We have a highly aggressive growth plan to establish ourselves as the industry leader of ESG with immediate plans for product and international expansion.

Members of our leadership team have been globally recognized for their success as leaders of large public companies, founders of successful startups, leaders of established ESG organizations, and builders of robust tech platforms. We are passionate, highly motivated, and experienced individuals who embrace our diverse backgrounds. Together, we will become the platform of choice and a catalyst for a change in the way business is done.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

100,000 - 110,000 USD per year (New York, NY)

rows.descriptionText:
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

Return to Work Program – New York

At Morgan Stanley, we recognize the immense potential in experienced professionals who have taken a career break and are now eager to return to the workforce. We value the life skills and experiences you've gained outside of work and recognize the significant contributions you can bring to our organization.

You don’t have to have a background in financial services to have a career with us. We welcome highly motivated candidates from a diverse range of industries and skills. We strive to create a spirit of inclusion by bringing together dedicated professionals with diverse backgrounds, talents, perspectives, cultural identities, and experiences.

Our New York Return to Work program will run from January 18, 2027 through May 7, 2027 in our New York office. This 16-week paid program places participants in roles that align with their existing expertise while also broadening their horizons through comprehensive training, mentorship, and professional development.

Wealth Management Virtual Engagement Associate (VEA) Program

Position Overview

The VEA Program is designed to give you firsthand experience working with the top Financial Advisors (FAs) in the industry at a leading global financial institution. In the VEA Program there are several different roles that are designed to support Financial Advisors in areas of business development, including the Client Engagement Associate, Financial Planning Associate, Workplace Engagement Associate, and Wealth Solutions Associate. Upon hire, you will be placed in one of these roles based on your experience, education, credentials, and business needs. The goal of the program is to give you a strong foundation in several systems/tools, business areas, and skills.

The VEA Program is structured as a two-year and three-month commitment (including the licensing and training period) and is designed to build a strong foundation across Wealth Management and client engagement. The length of the program enables you to earn your licenses, be trained in the role, gain additional professional designations, network, and capture valuable experience working with different FAs to understand how they run their practice. The insight you will gain is unique, and if successful, will propel you into a fruitful career at Morgan Stanley. Many successful associates continue their journey beyond the initial program period by gaining experience in new areas, broadening their expertise, and pursuing additional opportunities within the VEA organization.

The VEA Program operates in-person, across six office locations: Alpharetta, GA | Chicago, IL | Dallas, TX | New York Metro | Tempe, AZ. This is not a remote position.

rows.descriptionText:
Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid) or New York City, NY (Remote)

About Limina

Limina is the contextual data intelligence platform built for the AI era. Evolved from Private AI, the world's most accurate PII and PHI de-identification engine, Limina governs sensitive data across the entire enterprise AI lifecycle: classification and redaction through agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and real-time data security. Every prompt is a data transaction, and Limina governs every one of them.

We deploy inside the customer's environment with no third-party data processing and produce audit-ready compliance outputs across HIPAA, GDPR, CPRA, PCI-DSS, and more. Trusted by enterprise leaders including Zurich Insurance, MUFG Bank, RBC, Intact Insurance, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Deloitte.

The Role

You'll join Limina's marketing team, reporting to the VP of Marketing. Your job is to bring more of the right people into our funnel. You'll plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that turn privacy, security, and data leaders into engaged prospects. That includes webinars, email programs, content promotion, events, and paid channels.

Our marketing function is young, so you'll get hands-on experience across every part of demand generation and see your work show up directly in the pipeline. You'll work closely with our Market Development Representative, who turns the engagement you create into conversations with sales.

What You'll Do

Execute integrated campaigns from brief to launch. Build emails, landing pages, and forms, and coordinate timelines across the team. Run our webinar program end to end: topics, speakers, promotion, registration, the live session, and follow-up. Promote content across owned, earned, and paid channels, including email, LinkedIn, content syndication, and partner co-marketing. Support paid media with audience building, ad copy, and performance tracking, working with any agencies or tools we use. Grow our database with the right buyers. Build and clean target lists, manage imports, and keep segmentation accurate. Coordinate event promotion, so prospects know we'll be there and book time with us before we arrive. Own the logistics of our case study program. You'll source willing customers through Customer Success and Sales, schedule interviews, manage approvals, and keep the customer experience smooth from first ask to final sign-off. Turn campaign content and case studies into assets reps can use in follow-up, adapting our existing messaging for new industries and use cases. Build target lists and campaign materials for our ABM pilot, in partnership with the MDR. Report on campaign performance: what's driving new leads, MQLs, and pipeline, and what isn't. Recommend where to shift effort. 

What We're Looking For

Experience: 0 to 2 years in B2B marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or a related role. Internships and campaign work count. Execution: You ship. You can take a campaign from idea to launch on a deadline and sweat the details along the way. Analytical mindset: You're comfortable with numbers. You look at results, figure out why something worked or didn't, and adjust. Writing: Clear, compelling copy for emails, landing pages, and ads, adapted for technical and compliance audiences. Tools: Familiarity with a marketing automation platform or CRM, such as HubSpot, is a plus. So is experience with LinkedIn ads. Relationship skills: You're comfortable working with customers and internal teams, and you make people feel their time is well spent. Technical curiosity: You're willing to learn a technical product and eager to understand data privacy, AI, and compliance. Low ego, high ownership: You see list cleanup, form testing, and UTM tracking as part of the craft. 

Growth Path

This role builds a strong foundation in B2B marketing, with paths into senior demand generation, ABM, marketing operations, or campaign leadership as the team grows.

How Success Is Measured

Net-new leads added to the database from target segmentsMQLs generated by campaignsWebinar registration and attendance ratesCampaign conversion rates and cost per leadPipeline sourced and influenced by marketing programsCase studies completed per quarterRep-ready assets shipped and used in deals

Why Limina

Category leadership: We're the most accurate contextual data intelligence engine on the market, trusted by regulated enterprises across financial services, insurance, healthcare, and technology. Perfect market timing: Every organization building AI is grappling with how to govern sensitive data inside it. Real impact early: You'll help build a marketing function from the ground up, and your campaigns will show up directly in pipeline. Competitive compensation: Base plus variable, equity participation, and comprehensive benefits. 

Compensation Range: CA$90K - CA$110K

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Capital One Personal Loan

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The Personal Loan Acquisition modeling team builds the machine learning models that help our customers access the right loan products at the best possible rates to achieve their financial goals. We do predictive TDR and non-TDR models for acquisition processes including list selection, campaign & channel optimization, underwriting, pricing and verification, etc. using tech stacks Python, Spark, and AWS.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)Experience working with AWSAt least 2 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or RAt least 2 years’ experience with machine learning marketing or risk modelingAt least 2 years’ experience with SQL

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Advisory

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Novata

Novata is a public benefit corporation created and funded by a unique consortium of foundations and private sector companies including the Ford Foundation, the Omidyar Network, S&P Global, and Hamilton Lane. We are a for-profit, mission-driven company with a goal of empowering the private markets to build a more inclusive and sustainable form of capitalism. By bringing together expertise in financial data, private equity, social justice, and responsible investing, we build the best technology and advisory services for private markets to collect, analyse, benchmark, and report ESG data. We are a certified B Corp and have an experienced, diverse team as ambitious about growing a successful company as about making an impact.

Novata is proud to have acquired Atlas Metrics to expand our global reach and expand our product innovation. Together, we make sustainability even simpler for private markets. Now, 400+ clients and over 13,000 companies worldwide count on Novata to make collecting, reporting, and acting on sustainability data easy.

About Novata Advisory

Backed by platform data and insights from more than 13,000 private companies, Novata Advisory enhances our market-leading technology solution with a suite of offerings that maximise the value of the Novata experience, partnering with private equity GPs and their portfolio companies to translate ESG data into decisions that drive measurable value. The Advisory team works across the full ESG spectrum, from carbon accounting and climate risk to governance, social, and impact reporting, delivering engagements that are directly integrated with Novata's technology platform.

Advisory is purpose-built to challenge the traditional consulting model: AI-led offerings and workflows, vibe coding, prototyping, custom solutions, and a tight feedback loop with Product mean that Advisory operates as both a client delivery function and an engine for innovation. The Advisory team is intentionally lean, tech-enabled, and strategically linked to Novata's product roadmap, enabling efficient client delivery, building custom AI solutions for clients, and setting a new standard for what ESG advisory can look like in private markets.

Job Summary

As a Senior Analyst, Advisory, you will support project delivery across the full breadth of Novata's ESG and sustainability offerings, spanning climate risk, carbon, ESG reporting, and regulatory workstreams. You will also play a core role in Novata's ESG due diligence work, supporting research and analysis for private markets diligence engagements. This role will engage directly with the clients and be responsible for preparing client-ready deliverables.

This is a generalist role suited to someone who is ready to build upon their existing experience and expand their expertise , or transitioning into this work from an adjacent field.

You will report directly to an Advisory Director and work closely with a small, high-performing, US-based team. This role is for a practitioner who is analytically rigorous, detail-oriented, and energized by the intersection of private markets, sustainability, data, and technology, while considering how new AI tools can drive greater efficiency and innovation. You should also have a strong ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and drive meaningful outcomes.

This role is based in the US - NYC preferred in a hybrid capacity.

What You'll Be Doing

Client Delivery

Support end-to-end delivery on ESG advisory engagements with client-ready deliverables across climate risk, carbon, and regulatory workstreams, including data quality checks, data analysis, reporting deliverables, materiality assessments, carbon accounting, and climate risk. This will include project management and require ownership over certain workstreams, with support from the Advisory team. Deliver portfolio-level ESG analysis and benchmarking using Novata's platform and proprietary datasets.Guide clients through data collection processes and iterative improvement of their ESG programs, including the use of AI tools, as directed by engagement leads.Support ESG due diligence engagements for investor transactions, including regulatory scans, risk identification, and drafting memos. Leverage AI tools and workflows for client delivery while maintaining rigorous QA standards. 

Subject Matter Development

Build working knowledge across core ESG and sustainability frameworks (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, EDCI, GRI, SASB) relevant to Novata's Advisory offerings.Monitor regulatory and market developments across the ESG landscape and flag implications for ongoing client work.Contribute to internal methodological resources, technical guidance documents, and training materials under the direction of senior team members.

Offering & Process Support

Provide input on the design and refinement of Novata's ESG advisory offerings based on client feedback and delivery experience.Support commercial activities as needed, including research for proposals, scoping materials, and pitch preparation.Collaborate with Product and Customer Success teams to relay client needs and support platform improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate across Novata teams on an ongoing basis to ensure high-quality outcomes, continuous platform improvement, and an excellent client experience. This is fundamental to how the Advisory team works with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing.Support the development of new product solutions based on delivery experience and user feedback.

About You

Experience & Background

At least 2 years of industry experience in a related field, e.g., ESG advisory, sustainability, private equity, or an ESG/carbon data and technology provider.Advanced degree in relevant field strongly preferred.Broad exposure to ESG topics preferred over deep specialization in a single area; candidates with backgrounds spanning environmental, social, governance, impact, or regulatory disclosure work are encouraged to apply.Demonstrated proficiency with core ESG frameworks and standards (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, GRI, SASB); comfortable interpreting and applying guidance across industries and levels of company maturity.Exposure to due diligence work (M&A, transaction support, or portfolio company risk assessment) is a plus but not essential.Experience working with or alongside technology platforms, AI solutions, SaaS products, or digital data solutions, either as a user or implementer, is required, as is comfort operating in a tech-enabled, data-driven environment.Prior experience working with or for private equity firms, institutional investors, or their portfolio companies is a plus but not essential.

Skills & Capabilities

Data fluency; comfortable identifying, pulling, and analysing datasets and translating insights into actions and stakeholder narratives.Adept at synthesising feedback from various stakeholders into actionable input for product and offering development.Strong analytical and writing abilities to help articulate ESG topics to novices and experts alike.Excellent Excel skills and/or other analytical software.Motivation and interest to undertake research across the ESG space, including regulatory and diligence research.Hands-on experience using AI tools in a professional context, for example, using LLMs for research synthesis, drafting, or analysis.Proactive, with the ability and confidence to use initiative.Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines.

Character & Working Style

Intellectually rigorous and detail-oriented; you take care with accuracy and are comfortable asking questions rather than guessing.Proactive and self-directed; comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving team.Adaptable and eager to build breadth across ESG topics rather than narrow specialisation, at least in the early stages of this role.Curious and technology-enabled; actively seeks out new tools, technologies, and AI capabilities to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of their work.Mission-driven; genuinely committed to making private markets more sustainable and solving complex problems.Client-focused; takes pride in producing high-quality, accurate work that supports the broader team's client relationships.

Important Notes

This role is based in New York, with hybrid working arrangements (2 days in office).Applicants must be located in and eligible to work in the US. Unfortunately, we are unable to support visa applications or relocation at this time.

Benefits

Competitive salary plus stock optionsGenerous PTO policy including public holidaysComprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage401(k) plan with employer matchPurpose-driven, inclusive cultureThe opportunity to be part of a growing team at the forefront of ESG and private markets innovation

Why Join Us?

Novata is a mission-first company built to enable the private markets to drive more impact. We are at the unique intersection of ESG, the private markets, and mission driven impact. We are well-funded, have a top tier executive leadership team. We have a highly aggressive growth plan to establish ourselves as the industry leader of ESG with immediate plans for product and international expansion.

Members of our leadership team have been globally recognized for their success as leaders of large public companies, founders of successful startups, leaders of established ESG organizations, and builders of robust tech platforms. We are passionate, highly motivated, and experienced individuals who embrace our diverse backgrounds. Together, we will become the platform of choice and a catalyst for a change in the way business is done.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

100,000 - 110,000 USD per year (New York, NY)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Background

Anchored in the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and in line with the priorities outlined in the UNDP Strategic Plan, the Regional Bureau for Arab States (RBAS) supports the Arab States region to achieve sustainable development by eradicating poverty in all its forms and dimensions, accelerating structural transformations for sustainable development, and building resilience to crises and shocks. Within this work, the Regional Bureau for Arab States responds to needs across development settings including Least Developed Countries, Middle Income Countries, Net Contributor Countries and countries affected by crisis, with a view to support the building of resilience, fight climate change, leverage the promise of innovation, and prioritize the advance of women, youth and vulnerable groups as part of its commitment to the principles of universality, equality and leaving no one behind in an increasing challenging regional context which has been further impacted by various crises.

RBAS supports partners in the region to develop integrated, transformative, and scalable solutions to tackle the interconnected challenges of poverty, vulnerability, inequality and exclusion, in ways that are economically, socially and environmentally sustainable. The team assists in enhancing prospects for inclusive growth, jobs and livelihoods at national and local levels, including through economic recovery and resilience-building in crisis and post crisis contexts, focusing on empowering women and youth, and advancing opportunities for the most vulnerable. It also supports research, policy, and program guidance around: macroeconomic stability, private and financial sectors, fiscal policy and public finance management, economic transformation, social protection, women economic empowerment, urban and digital economy, etc.

The intern will report to the Strategic Initiatives Advisor in RBAS New York and will support the work on policy and research, including the Arab Human Development Report (AHDR) and ongoing socio-economic analyses examining the implications of conflicts and other shocks for growth, employment, poverty, inequality and human development in the Arab States region.

Duties And Responsibilities

Research and analysis: Conducting data collection, desk reviews of existing research and literature on one or two of the areas that the inclusive growth team is currently working on (namely, macroeconomics, public finance management, social protection, informality, labor market, poverty and inequality, private sector development (including micro, small and medium enterprises), SDG financing).Policy Brief Development: Assist in the drafting and preparation of policy briefs, technical notes, and economic assessments tailored for regional stakeholders and decision-makers.Advanced Quantitative Analysis: Support the team by conducting quantitative data analysis using reliable sources and tools to identify and visualize regional economic trends.Event and Dialogue Support: Provide logistical and substantive support in organizing regional consultations, webinars, and other forums related to inclusive growth and economic development.Regional Monitoring: Regularly monitor and summarize macroeconomic indicators, ongoing socio-economic developments, and policy shifts across the Arab States region to inform the team's ongoing programmatic work.Knowledge Management: Assist in maintaining and updating internal databases, knowledge repositories, and community-of-practice platforms with the latest research and data findings.Assist in the development: of new or ongoing initiatives, including review of policy literature in respect to the subject to enhance UNDP programming in the relevant field within the Arab Region.Document good practices: Including cases studies, innovations and pilot models for wider dissemination and sharing.Concept notes: Prepare conceptual framework / concept notes on new areas of work or development challenges.


Competencies

Functional Competencies

Strong sense of collaborative work, excellent communication and interpersonal skills;Keen attention to detail;Proven record of interest and work in the development field;Excellent analytical and research skills using state of the art quantitative analytical tools such as STATA, R;Research experience;Interest in the Arab States region and possibly some background in researching the region;


Professionalism

Demonstrated problem-solving skills and judgment in applying technical expertise to resolve a wide range of complex issues/problems;Ability to negotiate and to influence others to reach agreement;Ability to work under pressure;Shows pride in work and in achievement;Demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter, especially economic development and resilience;Is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results;Is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns;Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges;Remains calm in stressful situations;Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work;Takes responsibility for incorporating the perspective of youth and ensuring the equal participation of young people as in all areas of work.


Communication

Speaks and writes clearly, concisely and effectively;Listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately;Asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication;Tailors language, tone, style and format to match audience;Demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed.


Teamwork

Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise;Is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda;Supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position;Shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.


Planning & Organizing

Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies;Identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required;Allocates appropriate amount of time and resource for completing work;Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning;Monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary;Uses time efficiently.


Accountability

Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honor commitments;Delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards;Operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules;Supports subordinates, provide oversight and take responsibility for delegated assignments;Takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.


Creativity

Actively seeks to improve program or services;Offers new and different options to solve problems or meet client needs;Promotes and persuades others to consider new ideas;Takes calculated risks on new and unusual ideas;Thinks “outside the box”;Takes an interest in new ideas and new ways of doing things;Not bound by current thinking or traditional approaches.


Technological Awareness

Keeps abreast of available technology;Understands applicability and limitation of technology to the work of the office;Actively seeks to apply technology to appropriate tasks;Shows willingness to learn new technology.


Education

Required Skills and Experience

Applicants to the UNDP internship programme must at the time of application meet one of the following requirements:

 Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as a master’s programme, or higher) in subjects relevant to the work of Inclusive Growth Team (economics, development studies, public policy, international development and related fields).  Be enrolled in the final academic year of a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in subjects mentioned under (1) above.  Have recently graduated with a university degree (as defined in (1) and (2) above) and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation.  Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional traineeship program and undertake the internship as part of this program. 


Experience

Experience with quantitative data analysis using software like R, Stata, or Python is a strong asset.Demonstrated ability to work well both independently and within a multicultural team.Good command of information and communication technology.


Languages

Fluency in English (both oral and written) is required. Arabic and French language skills would be an asset but not necessary for the assignment.


Stipend

Where an intern is not financially supported by any institution or programme, such as a university, government, foundation or scholarship programme, a stipend intended to help cover basic daily expenses related to the internship, such as meals and transportation at the duty station, must be paid by the receiving office.The monthly amount of the stipend will be determined for each duty station based on the stipend rates published yearly by the OHR Policy and Compensation Unit. The stipend will be paid on a monthly basis and part-time internship arrangements are prorated accordingly.Where an intern is financially supported by an institution, government or third party, UNDP will, subject to the rules of such institution, government or third party, pay the intern the difference, if any, between the external financial support provided and the applicable UNDP stipend.No other payments of any kind will be made to an intern by the office in connection with an internship agreement.

We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

****The salary range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role and may vary based on several factors, including experience, education, specific skill sets, tenure, and overall fit. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

Market Analyst, Research (ERCOT)

 Reports to:  US Research Lead

 Team:  Research

 Regions:  ERCOT

About The Role

Developers, traders, investors and utilities read Modo's research to understand what happened in the market and why. This role writes it.

The work runs from monthly benchmark articles and market explainers through to the outlook pieces clients plan around. You will own the coverage of one or more US markets, watching them closely enough to notice when something changes, then explaining it before anyone else does. Lead times are short. A good piece this week beats a perfect one next month.

What you will do

 Publish research. Write the benchmark articles, explainers and notes for the markets you cover.  Watch your markets. Follow prices, policy and asset behaviour closely enough to spot what matters early.  Do your own analysis. Pull the data, run the numbers, and build the charts that carry the argument.  Answer for your work. Stand behind what you publish with clients, on calls, and in public.  Work with other teams : Modeling - tell them what the market is doing and where the models do not yet reflect it.  Advisory - share the market read behind client work, and bring back the questions clients are asking.  Revenue - join technical sales and post-sales calls where clients want the analyst, not the pitch.  What you need

 Degree in engineering, economics, maths, or a related field 2+ years analysing power markets, in research, consulting, trading, or development  You have written analysis that someone outside your team read and used  You know how at least one US power market clears energy and ancillary services  You can pull and analyse your own data in SQL and Python  You can combine data and findings from several sources into one coherent argument  You write clearly, and you take editing well 

Nice to have

 Experience covering battery storage revenues or renewable build-out  Experience presenting to clients or at industry events  A public body of written work — articles, a newsletter, or a research blog

Compensation & Equal Opportunity

 Base salary range: $110,000–$170,000 per year, depending on experience  The salary range listed reflects industry benchmarks for this role. Modo Energy's policy is to pay top of personal market - if you're exceptional, we'll make it work  Equity 25 days PTO plus 10 paid Holidays annually 100% employer paid medical, dental and vision coverage 401(k) with matching  Modo Energy is an equal opportunity employer - employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, New York State, or New York City law  For assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, contact us at careers@modoenergy.com 

 What You Can Expect From Us 

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

Data is at the center of everything we do. Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

The US Card Data Science organization at Capital One leverages our massive wealth of customer data to drive business strategy and deliver world-class customer experiences. Our team builds and deploys sophisticated data science and machine learning models across the entire credit card lifecycle—including marketing, acquisitions, underwriting, and fraud prevention. In this role, you will turn complex insights into real-world impact, shaping financial products that serve and protect millions of cardholders daily.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Position Summary

Two Sigma is a financial sciences company, combining data analysis, invention, and rigorous inquiry to help solve the toughest challenges in investment management, insurance technology, securities, private equity, and venture capital.

Our team of scientists, technologists, and academics looks beyond traditional methods to develop creative solutions to some of the world’s most complex economic problems.

When you work with us, you tackle tough problems alongside other scientists and engineers. People who will challenge your ideas. Who you can really learn from, and collaborate with. And you’ll be doing work that matters to a lot of people, too. Our investors include some of the world’s largest retirement funds, research institutions, educational endowments, healthcare systems and foundations. We admire what they do, and we’re proud to serve these organizations.

You Will Take On The Following Responsibilities

Independently research and develop hypotheses based on diverse and unique real-world datasets.Conduct literature reviews to develop and apply cutting-edge methodologies for extracting meaningful signals from our vast data holdings. Partner with our engineers and business stakeholders to rigorously explore and test your theories.All the while, you’ll remain engaged in the academic community. Degree in a technical or quantitative discipline, like chemistry, computer science, economics, statistics, or quantitative social science with an applied empirical focus (all levels welcome, from bachelor’s to doctorate) Proficient in Python and SQL Performed an in-depth research project, examining real-world dataAre an independent thinker who can creatively approach data analysis and communicate complex ideas clearlyYou don’t need a background in finance.
