rows.descriptionText:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

Market Analyst, Research (ERCOT)

 Reports to:  US Research Lead

 Team:  Research

 Regions:  ERCOT

About The Role

Developers, traders, investors and utilities read Modo's research to understand what happened in the market and why. This role writes it.

The work runs from monthly benchmark articles and market explainers through to the outlook pieces clients plan around. You will own the coverage of one or more US markets, watching them closely enough to notice when something changes, then explaining it before anyone else does. Lead times are short. A good piece this week beats a perfect one next month.

What you will do

 Publish research. Write the benchmark articles, explainers and notes for the markets you cover.  Watch your markets. Follow prices, policy and asset behaviour closely enough to spot what matters early.  Do your own analysis. Pull the data, run the numbers, and build the charts that carry the argument.  Answer for your work. Stand behind what you publish with clients, on calls, and in public.  Work with other teams : Modeling - tell them what the market is doing and where the models do not yet reflect it.  Advisory - share the market read behind client work, and bring back the questions clients are asking.  Revenue - join technical sales and post-sales calls where clients want the analyst, not the pitch.  What you need

 Degree in engineering, economics, maths, or a related field 2+ years analysing power markets, in research, consulting, trading, or development  You have written analysis that someone outside your team read and used  You know how at least one US power market clears energy and ancillary services  You can pull and analyse your own data in SQL and Python  You can combine data and findings from several sources into one coherent argument  You write clearly, and you take editing well 

Nice to have

 Experience covering battery storage revenues or renewable build-out  Experience presenting to clients or at industry events  A public body of written work — articles, a newsletter, or a research blog

Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Capital One Personal Loan

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The Personal Loan Acquisition modeling team builds the machine learning models that help our customers access the right loan products at the best possible rates to achieve their financial goals. We do predictive TDR and non-TDR models for acquisition processes including list selection, campaign & channel optimization, underwriting, pricing and verification, etc. using tech stacks Python, Spark, and AWS.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Background

Anchored in the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and in line with the priorities outlined in the UNDP Strategic Plan, the Regional Bureau for Arab States (RBAS) supports the Arab States region to achieve sustainable development by eradicating poverty in all its forms and dimensions, accelerating structural transformations for sustainable development, and building resilience to crises and shocks. Within this work, the Regional Bureau for Arab States responds to needs across development settings including Least Developed Countries, Middle Income Countries, Net Contributor Countries and countries affected by crisis, with a view to support the building of resilience, fight climate change, leverage the promise of innovation, and prioritize the advance of women, youth and vulnerable groups as part of its commitment to the principles of universality, equality and leaving no one behind in an increasing challenging regional context which has been further impacted by various crises.

RBAS supports partners in the region to develop integrated, transformative, and scalable solutions to tackle the interconnected challenges of poverty, vulnerability, inequality and exclusion, in ways that are economically, socially and environmentally sustainable. The team assists in enhancing prospects for inclusive growth, jobs and livelihoods at national and local levels, including through economic recovery and resilience-building in crisis and post crisis contexts, focusing on empowering women and youth, and advancing opportunities for the most vulnerable. It also supports research, policy, and program guidance around: macroeconomic stability, private and financial sectors, fiscal policy and public finance management, economic transformation, social protection, women economic empowerment, urban and digital economy, etc.

The intern will report to the Strategic Initiatives Advisor in RBAS New York and will support the work on policy and research, including the Arab Human Development Report (AHDR) and ongoing socio-economic analyses examining the implications of conflicts and other shocks for growth, employment, poverty, inequality and human development in the Arab States region.

Duties And Responsibilities

Research and analysis: Conducting data collection, desk reviews of existing research and literature on one or two of the areas that the inclusive growth team is currently working on (namely, macroeconomics, public finance management, social protection, informality, labor market, poverty and inequality, private sector development (including micro, small and medium enterprises), SDG financing).Policy Brief Development: Assist in the drafting and preparation of policy briefs, technical notes, and economic assessments tailored for regional stakeholders and decision-makers.Advanced Quantitative Analysis: Support the team by conducting quantitative data analysis using reliable sources and tools to identify and visualize regional economic trends.Event and Dialogue Support: Provide logistical and substantive support in organizing regional consultations, webinars, and other forums related to inclusive growth and economic development.Regional Monitoring: Regularly monitor and summarize macroeconomic indicators, ongoing socio-economic developments, and policy shifts across the Arab States region to inform the team's ongoing programmatic work.Knowledge Management: Assist in maintaining and updating internal databases, knowledge repositories, and community-of-practice platforms with the latest research and data findings.Assist in the development: of new or ongoing initiatives, including review of policy literature in respect to the subject to enhance UNDP programming in the relevant field within the Arab Region.Document good practices: Including cases studies, innovations and pilot models for wider dissemination and sharing.Concept notes: Prepare conceptual framework / concept notes on new areas of work or development challenges.


Competencies

Functional Competencies

Strong sense of collaborative work, excellent communication and interpersonal skills;Keen attention to detail;Proven record of interest and work in the development field;Excellent analytical and research skills using state of the art quantitative analytical tools such as STATA, R;Research experience;Interest in the Arab States region and possibly some background in researching the region;


Professionalism

Demonstrated problem-solving skills and judgment in applying technical expertise to resolve a wide range of complex issues/problems;Ability to negotiate and to influence others to reach agreement;Ability to work under pressure;Shows pride in work and in achievement;Demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter, especially economic development and resilience;Is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results;Is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns;Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges;Remains calm in stressful situations;Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work;Takes responsibility for incorporating the perspective of youth and ensuring the equal participation of young people as in all areas of work.


Communication

rows.title: Inventory Control Specialist
rows.descriptionText: Position SummaryThe Inventory Control I position is a Finance role responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy through cycle counting and inventory verification processes. This position compiles and maintains records related to the quantity, type, and value of materials, merchandise, equipment, and supplies within the facility. The Inventory Control I Associate investigates inventory discrepancies, performs quality checks, and supports product recall activities when necessary.This role requires a highly detail-oriented individual who can work in multiple warehouse environments, including dry storage, cooler areas, freezer environments, and sub-zero ice cream storage areas. Successful candidates must be flexible, reliable, and comfortable working in changing temperature conditions throughout the week.Key Responsibilities· Perform daily cycle counts to ensure inventory accuracy across multiple warehouse zones.· Verify inventory quantities against system and physical records.· Compile and maintain records of inventory counts, stock levels, and inventory adjustments.· Investigate and research root causes of count discrepancies.· Complete empty slot location reports and identify misplaced inventory.· Communicate inventory variances and discrepancies to supervisors for resolution.· Perform inventory quality checks and support product recall processes as needed.· Work throughout dry, cooler, freezer, and sub-zero storage environments as assigned.· Follow established inventory control procedures and maintain accurate documentation.· Collaborate with supervisors and team members to support warehouse inventory accuracy and operational efficiency.Day-to-Day Activities· Review assigned account books and inventory count sheets.· Travel through warehouse aisles and bin locations to physically count inventory.· Compare physical inventory quantities to documented quantities.· Record discrepancies and submit findings to supervisors.· Identify inventory stored in incorrect slot locations and assist with inventory relocation processes.· Progress from manual counting methods to use of a handheld counting gun after successful training and demonstrated proficiency, typically within the first few weeks of employment.QualificationsRequired Education & Experience· High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent required.· Minimum of 2+ years of cycle counting or inventory control experience required.· Experience working in warehouse, distribution, inventory, or logistics environments preferred.Required Skills· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.· Ability to work independently while remaining a team player.· Reliable attendance and strong work ethic.· Flexibility to work in different warehouse areas and varying temperature conditions throughout the day.· Excellent listening skills to support effective two-way communication.· Ability to read, write, and speak English.· Basic mathematical skills including the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide using whole numbers, fractions, and decimals.· Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.Top Attributes for Success· Attention to detail· Accuracy and accountability· Flexibility and adaptability· Reliability and dependability· Team-oriented mindsetWork EnvironmentCandidates must be prepared to work in all warehouse temperature zones, including:· Dry Storage: Room temperature environment· Refrigerated storage zones· Freezer Areas: 32°F and below· Ice Cream Storage: Below-zero temperaturesEmployees may work in different environments throughout the same week, depending on inventory count assignments.Physical Requirements· Ability to lift up to 60 pounds without assistance.· Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, and reach throughout the workday.· Ability to work in cold and sub-zero temperature environments while wearing required PPE.Equipment Used· Inventory count sheets/account books· Handheld counting guns (after training period)Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)Required on Day 1· Steel-toe boots that fully cover the ankle

About Cape

Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.

Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected and have privacy.

We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.

Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.

The Team

At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.

The Role

Privacy is one of the defining fights of this decade, and most of the public conversation about it is still boring, jargon-heavy, or fear-based. We want to change that.

We're hiring a Social Media Associate to own and grow Cape's voice across social media channels. This person will be the driving force behind multiplying our following, sharpening our brand voice into something people actually want to engage with, and helping establish Cape as a credible, quotable voice in the broader public conversation about privacy, not just another company posting product updates.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who is a sharp, distinctive writer first, and who wants to grow social channels rather than just maintain existing ones. You'll have real input into how Cape shows up in the world, not just execute a content calendar someone else designed.

What You'll Work On

Content & voice: Own social copywriting, editing, and posting end-to-end. Develop and evolve Cape's brand voice across channels. Copy edit and upload blog posts. Write and edit email marketing copy; format and help build out email flows/sequences Proofread across all of the above - nothing goes out with typos or off-brand language.

Thought leadership & positioning: Help identify and shape opportunities for Cape to weigh in on public privacy conversations. Translate technical/product features into compelling narratives for social and video

Light operations: Order business cards, conference materials, etc. Reply to inbound email inquiries, which requires getting familiar enough with the product to represent it accurately

What We Value

Cape's social following and engagement grow meaningfully, with a voice that's recognizable and differentiated from typical security/privacy brand accountsOur content gets cited, shared, or referenced in broader privacy conversations. Reporters, researchers, and other players in the space start to see Cape as a credible source, not just a productEmail flows run smoothly with minimal oversight, and copy quality is consistently highYou've built systems (calendars, trackers, briefs) that make the function scale beyond just you

Experience

Excellent, distinctive writingStrong organizational skills: comfortable building and maintaining spreadsheet trackers to manage projects and content calendarsHigh attention to detailCreative instincts, not just execution: someone who pitches ideas, not just fills a calendar(Bonus Points) Video filming and editing experience (Plus) a portfolio of past work(Bonus Points) Interest in or familiarity with privacy, security, or tech policy conversations

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role in Arlington, VA or New York, NY is $75,000 - 110,000 depending on experience and interview performance.

Our benefits include:

401(k) match100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)Stipends forFamily-forming needsGender-affirming care
Our Culture & Values

We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning. We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology. We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge. We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Advisory

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Novata

Novata is a public benefit corporation created and funded by a unique consortium of foundations and private sector companies including the Ford Foundation, the Omidyar Network, S&P Global, and Hamilton Lane. We are a for-profit, mission-driven company with a goal of empowering the private markets to build a more inclusive and sustainable form of capitalism. By bringing together expertise in financial data, private equity, social justice, and responsible investing, we build the best technology and advisory services for private markets to collect, analyse, benchmark, and report ESG data. We are a certified B Corp and have an experienced, diverse team as ambitious about growing a successful company as about making an impact.

Novata is proud to have acquired Atlas Metrics to expand our global reach and expand our product innovation. Together, we make sustainability even simpler for private markets. Now, 400+ clients and over 13,000 companies worldwide count on Novata to make collecting, reporting, and acting on sustainability data easy.

About Novata Advisory

Backed by platform data and insights from more than 13,000 private companies, Novata Advisory enhances our market-leading technology solution with a suite of offerings that maximise the value of the Novata experience, partnering with private equity GPs and their portfolio companies to translate ESG data into decisions that drive measurable value. The Advisory team works across the full ESG spectrum, from carbon accounting and climate risk to governance, social, and impact reporting, delivering engagements that are directly integrated with Novata's technology platform.

Advisory is purpose-built to challenge the traditional consulting model: AI-led offerings and workflows, vibe coding, prototyping, custom solutions, and a tight feedback loop with Product mean that Advisory operates as both a client delivery function and an engine for innovation. The Advisory team is intentionally lean, tech-enabled, and strategically linked to Novata's product roadmap, enabling efficient client delivery, building custom AI solutions for clients, and setting a new standard for what ESG advisory can look like in private markets.

Job Summary

As a Senior Analyst, Advisory, you will support project delivery across the full breadth of Novata's ESG and sustainability offerings, spanning climate risk, carbon, ESG reporting, and regulatory workstreams. You will also play a core role in Novata's ESG due diligence work, supporting research and analysis for private markets diligence engagements. This role will engage directly with the clients and be responsible for preparing client-ready deliverables.

This is a generalist role suited to someone who is ready to build upon their existing experience and expand their expertise , or transitioning into this work from an adjacent field.

You will report directly to an Advisory Director and work closely with a small, high-performing, US-based team. This role is for a practitioner who is analytically rigorous, detail-oriented, and energized by the intersection of private markets, sustainability, data, and technology, while considering how new AI tools can drive greater efficiency and innovation. You should also have a strong ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and drive meaningful outcomes.

This role is based in the US - NYC preferred in a hybrid capacity.

What You'll Be Doing

Client Delivery

Support end-to-end delivery on ESG advisory engagements with client-ready deliverables across climate risk, carbon, and regulatory workstreams, including data quality checks, data analysis, reporting deliverables, materiality assessments, carbon accounting, and climate risk. This will include project management and require ownership over certain workstreams, with support from the Advisory team. Deliver portfolio-level ESG analysis and benchmarking using Novata's platform and proprietary datasets.Guide clients through data collection processes and iterative improvement of their ESG programs, including the use of AI tools, as directed by engagement leads.Support ESG due diligence engagements for investor transactions, including regulatory scans, risk identification, and drafting memos. Leverage AI tools and workflows for client delivery while maintaining rigorous QA standards. 

Subject Matter Development

Build working knowledge across core ESG and sustainability frameworks (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, EDCI, GRI, SASB) relevant to Novata's Advisory offerings.Monitor regulatory and market developments across the ESG landscape and flag implications for ongoing client work.Contribute to internal methodological resources, technical guidance documents, and training materials under the direction of senior team members.

Offering & Process Support

Provide input on the design and refinement of Novata's ESG advisory offerings based on client feedback and delivery experience.Support commercial activities as needed, including research for proposals, scoping materials, and pitch preparation.Collaborate with Product and Customer Success teams to relay client needs and support platform improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate across Novata teams on an ongoing basis to ensure high-quality outcomes, continuous platform improvement, and an excellent client experience. This is fundamental to how the Advisory team works with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing.Support the development of new product solutions based on delivery experience and user feedback.

About You

Experience & Background

At least 2 years of industry experience in a related field, e.g., ESG advisory, sustainability, private equity, or an ESG/carbon data and technology provider.Advanced degree in relevant field strongly preferred.Broad exposure to ESG topics preferred over deep specialization in a single area; candidates with backgrounds spanning environmental, social, governance, impact, or regulatory disclosure work are encouraged to apply.Demonstrated proficiency with core ESG frameworks and standards (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, GRI, SASB); comfortable interpreting and applying guidance across industries and levels of company maturity.Exposure to due diligence work (M&A, transaction support, or portfolio company risk assessment) is a plus but not essential.Experience working with or alongside technology platforms, AI solutions, SaaS products, or digital data solutions, either as a user or implementer, is required, as is comfort operating in a tech-enabled, data-driven environment.Prior experience working with or for private equity firms, institutional investors, or their portfolio companies is a plus but not essential.

Skills & Capabilities

Data fluency; comfortable identifying, pulling, and analysing datasets and translating insights into actions and stakeholder narratives.Adept at synthesising feedback from various stakeholders into actionable input for product and offering development.Strong analytical and writing abilities to help articulate ESG topics to novices and experts alike.Excellent Excel skills and/or other analytical software.Motivation and interest to undertake research across the ESG space, including regulatory and diligence research.Hands-on experience using AI tools in a professional context, for example, using LLMs for research synthesis, drafting, or analysis.Proactive, with the ability and confidence to use initiative.Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines.

Character & Working Style

Intellectually rigorous and detail-oriented; you take care with accuracy and are comfortable asking questions rather than guessing.Proactive and self-directed; comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving team.Adaptable and eager to build breadth across ESG topics rather than narrow specialisation, at least in the early stages of this role.Curious and technology-enabled; actively seeks out new tools, technologies, and AI capabilities to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of their work.Mission-driven; genuinely committed to making private markets more sustainable and solving complex problems.Client-focused; takes pride in producing high-quality, accurate work that supports the broader team's client relationships.

Important Notes

This role is based in New York, with hybrid working arrangements (2 days in office).Applicants must be located in and eligible to work in the US. Unfortunately, we are unable to support visa applications or relocation at this time.

Benefits

Competitive salary plus stock optionsGenerous PTO policy including public holidaysComprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage401(k) plan with employer matchPurpose-driven, inclusive cultureThe opportunity to be part of a growing team at the forefront of ESG and private markets innovation

Why Join Us?

Novata is a mission-first company built to enable the private markets to drive more impact. We are at the unique intersection of ESG, the private markets, and mission driven impact. We are well-funded, have a top tier executive leadership team. We have a highly aggressive growth plan to establish ourselves as the industry leader of ESG with immediate plans for product and international expansion.

Members of our leadership team have been globally recognized for their success as leaders of large public companies, founders of successful startups, leaders of established ESG organizations, and builders of robust tech platforms. We are passionate, highly motivated, and experienced individuals who embrace our diverse backgrounds. Together, we will become the platform of choice and a catalyst for a change in the way business is done.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

100,000 - 110,000 USD per year (New York, NY)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Background

Anchored in the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and in line with the priorities outlined in the UNDP Strategic Plan, the Regional Bureau for Arab States (RBAS) supports the Arab States region to achieve sustainable development by eradicating poverty in all its forms and dimensions, accelerating structural transformations for sustainable development, and building resilience to crises and shocks. Within this work, the Regional Bureau for Arab States responds to needs across development settings including Least Developed Countries, Middle Income Countries, Net Contributor Countries and countries affected by crisis, with a view to support the building of resilience, fight climate change, leverage the promise of innovation, and prioritize the advance of women, youth and vulnerable groups as part of its commitment to the principles of universality, equality and leaving no one behind in an increasing challenging regional context which has been further impacted by various crises.

RBAS supports partners in the region to develop integrated, transformative, and scalable solutions to tackle the interconnected challenges of poverty, vulnerability, inequality and exclusion, in ways that are economically, socially and environmentally sustainable. The team assists in enhancing prospects for inclusive growth, jobs and livelihoods at national and local levels, including through economic recovery and resilience-building in crisis and post crisis contexts, focusing on empowering women and youth, and advancing opportunities for the most vulnerable. It also supports research, policy, and program guidance around: macroeconomic stability, private and financial sectors, fiscal policy and public finance management, economic transformation, social protection, women economic empowerment, urban and digital economy, etc.

The intern will report to the Strategic Initiatives Advisor in RBAS New York and will support the work on policy and research, including the Arab Human Development Report (AHDR) and ongoing socio-economic analyses examining the implications of conflicts and other shocks for growth, employment, poverty, inequality and human development in the Arab States region.

Duties And Responsibilities

Research and analysis: Conducting data collection, desk reviews of existing research and literature on one or two of the areas that the inclusive growth team is currently working on (namely, macroeconomics, public finance management, social protection, informality, labor market, poverty and inequality, private sector development (including micro, small and medium enterprises), SDG financing).Policy Brief Development: Assist in the drafting and preparation of policy briefs, technical notes, and economic assessments tailored for regional stakeholders and decision-makers.Advanced Quantitative Analysis: Support the team by conducting quantitative data analysis using reliable sources and tools to identify and visualize regional economic trends.Event and Dialogue Support: Provide logistical and substantive support in organizing regional consultations, webinars, and other forums related to inclusive growth and economic development.Regional Monitoring: Regularly monitor and summarize macroeconomic indicators, ongoing socio-economic developments, and policy shifts across the Arab States region to inform the team's ongoing programmatic work.Knowledge Management: Assist in maintaining and updating internal databases, knowledge repositories, and community-of-practice platforms with the latest research and data findings.Assist in the development: of new or ongoing initiatives, including review of policy literature in respect to the subject to enhance UNDP programming in the relevant field within the Arab Region.Document good practices: Including cases studies, innovations and pilot models for wider dissemination and sharing.Concept notes: Prepare conceptual framework / concept notes on new areas of work or development challenges.


Competencies

Functional Competencies

Strong sense of collaborative work, excellent communication and interpersonal skills;Keen attention to detail;Proven record of interest and work in the development field;Excellent analytical and research skills using state of the art quantitative analytical tools such as STATA, R;Research experience;Interest in the Arab States region and possibly some background in researching the region;


Professionalism

Demonstrated problem-solving skills and judgment in applying technical expertise to resolve a wide range of complex issues/problems;Ability to negotiate and to influence others to reach agreement;Ability to work under pressure;Shows pride in work and in achievement;Demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter, especially economic development and resilience;Is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results;Is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns;Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges;Remains calm in stressful situations;Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work;Takes responsibility for incorporating the perspective of youth and ensuring the equal participation of young people as in all areas of work.


Communication

Speaks and writes clearly, concisely and effectively;Listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately;Asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication;Tailors language, tone, style and format to match audience;Demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed.


Teamwork

Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise;Is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda;Supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position;Shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.


Planning & Organizing

Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies;Identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required;Allocates appropriate amount of time and resource for completing work;Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning;Monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary;Uses time efficiently.


Accountability

Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honor commitments;Delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards;Operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules;Supports subordinates, provide oversight and take responsibility for delegated assignments;Takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.


Creativity

Actively seeks to improve program or services;Offers new and different options to solve problems or meet client needs;Promotes and persuades others to consider new ideas;Takes calculated risks on new and unusual ideas;Thinks “outside the box”;Takes an interest in new ideas and new ways of doing things;Not bound by current thinking or traditional approaches.


Technological Awareness

Keeps abreast of available technology;Understands applicability and limitation of technology to the work of the office;Actively seeks to apply technology to appropriate tasks;Shows willingness to learn new technology.


Education

Required Skills and Experience

Applicants to the UNDP internship programme must at the time of application meet one of the following requirements:

 Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as a master’s programme, or higher) in subjects relevant to the work of Inclusive Growth Team (economics, development studies, public policy, international development and related fields).  Be enrolled in the final academic year of a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in subjects mentioned under (1) above.  Have recently graduated with a university degree (as defined in (1) and (2) above) and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation.  Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional traineeship program and undertake the internship as part of this program. 


Experience

Experience with quantitative data analysis using software like R, Stata, or Python is a strong asset.Demonstrated ability to work well both independently and within a multicultural team.Good command of information and communication technology.


Languages

Fluency in English (both oral and written) is required. Arabic and French language skills would be an asset but not necessary for the assignment.


Stipend

Where an intern is not financially supported by any institution or programme, such as a university, government, foundation or scholarship programme, a stipend intended to help cover basic daily expenses related to the internship, such as meals and transportation at the duty station, must be paid by the receiving office.The monthly amount of the stipend will be determined for each duty station based on the stipend rates published yearly by the OHR Policy and Compensation Unit. The stipend will be paid on a monthly basis and part-time internship arrangements are prorated accordingly.Where an intern is financially supported by an institution, government or third party, UNDP will, subject to the rules of such institution, government or third party, pay the intern the difference, if any, between the external financial support provided and the applicable UNDP stipend.No other payments of any kind will be made to an intern by the office in connection with an internship agreement.


Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

Data Privacy

Please click here to view UNDP Data Privacy Statement

About Novata

Novata is a public benefit corporation created and funded by a unique consortium of foundations and private sector companies including the Ford Foundation, the Omidyar Network, S&P Global, and Hamilton Lane. We are a for-profit, mission-driven company with a goal of empowering the private markets to build a more inclusive and sustainable form of capitalism. By bringing together expertise in financial data, private equity, social justice, and responsible investing, we build the best technology and advisory services for private markets to collect, analyse, benchmark, and report ESG data. We are a certified B Corp and have an experienced, diverse team as ambitious about growing a successful company as about making an impact.

Novata is proud to have acquired Atlas Metrics to expand our global reach and expand our product innovation. Together, we make sustainability even simpler for private markets. Now, 400+ clients and over 13,000 companies worldwide count on Novata to make collecting, reporting, and acting on sustainability data easy.

About Novata Advisory

Backed by platform data and insights from more than 13,000 private companies, Novata Advisory enhances our market-leading technology solution with a suite of offerings that maximise the value of the Novata experience, partnering with private equity GPs and their portfolio companies to translate ESG data into decisions that drive measurable value. The Advisory team works across the full ESG spectrum, from carbon accounting and climate risk to governance, social, and impact reporting, delivering engagements that are directly integrated with Novata's technology platform.

Advisory is purpose-built to challenge the traditional consulting model: AI-led offerings and workflows, vibe coding, prototyping, custom solutions, and a tight feedback loop with Product mean that Advisory operates as both a client delivery function and an engine for innovation. The Advisory team is intentionally lean, tech-enabled, and strategically linked to Novata's product roadmap, enabling efficient client delivery, building custom AI solutions for clients, and setting a new standard for what ESG advisory can look like in private markets.

Job Summary

As a Senior Analyst, Advisory, you will support project delivery across the full breadth of Novata's ESG and sustainability offerings, spanning climate risk, carbon, ESG reporting, and regulatory workstreams. You will also play a core role in Novata's ESG due diligence work, supporting research and analysis for private markets diligence engagements. This role will engage directly with the clients and be responsible for preparing client-ready deliverables.

This is a generalist role suited to someone who is ready to build upon their existing experience and expand their expertise , or transitioning into this work from an adjacent field.

You will report directly to an Advisory Director and work closely with a small, high-performing, US-based team. This role is for a practitioner who is analytically rigorous, detail-oriented, and energized by the intersection of private markets, sustainability, data, and technology, while considering how new AI tools can drive greater efficiency and innovation. You should also have a strong ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and drive meaningful outcomes.

This role is based in the US - NYC preferred in a hybrid capacity.

What You'll Be Doing

Client Delivery

Support end-to-end delivery on ESG advisory engagements with client-ready deliverables across climate risk, carbon, and regulatory workstreams, including data quality checks, data analysis, reporting deliverables, materiality assessments, carbon accounting, and climate risk. This will include project management and require ownership over certain workstreams, with support from the Advisory team. Deliver portfolio-level ESG analysis and benchmarking using Novata's platform and proprietary datasets.Guide clients through data collection processes and iterative improvement of their ESG programs, including the use of AI tools, as directed by engagement leads.Support ESG due diligence engagements for investor transactions, including regulatory scans, risk identification, and drafting memos. Leverage AI tools and workflows for client delivery while maintaining rigorous QA standards. 

Subject Matter Development

Build working knowledge across core ESG and sustainability frameworks (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, EDCI, GRI, SASB) relevant to Novata's Advisory offerings.Monitor regulatory and market developments across the ESG landscape and flag implications for ongoing client work.Contribute to internal methodological resources, technical guidance documents, and training materials under the direction of senior team members.

Offering & Process Support

Provide input on the design and refinement of Novata's ESG advisory offerings based on client feedback and delivery experience.Support commercial activities as needed, including research for proposals, scoping materials, and pitch preparation.Collaborate with Product and Customer Success teams to relay client needs and support platform improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate across Novata teams on an ongoing basis to ensure high-quality outcomes, continuous platform improvement, and an excellent client experience. This is fundamental to how the Advisory team works with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing.Support the development of new product solutions based on delivery experience and user feedback.

About You

Experience & Background

At least 2 years of industry experience in a related field, e.g., ESG advisory, sustainability, private equity, or an ESG/carbon data and technology provider.Advanced degree in relevant field strongly preferred.Broad exposure to ESG topics preferred over deep specialization in a single area; candidates with backgrounds spanning environmental, social, governance, impact, or regulatory disclosure work are encouraged to apply.Demonstrated proficiency with core ESG frameworks and standards (e.g., GHG Protocol, TCFD, SFDR, PRI, GRI, SASB); comfortable interpreting and applying guidance across industries and levels of company maturity.Exposure to due diligence work (M&A, transaction support, or portfolio company risk assessment) is a plus but not essential.Experience working with or alongside technology platforms, AI solutions, SaaS products, or digital data solutions, either as a user or implementer, is required, as is comfort operating in a tech-enabled, data-driven environment.Prior experience working with or for private equity firms, institutional investors, or their portfolio companies is a plus but not essential.

Skills & Capabilities

Data fluency; comfortable identifying, pulling, and analysing datasets and translating insights into actions and stakeholder narratives.Adept at synthesising feedback from various stakeholders into actionable input for product and offering development.Strong analytical and writing abilities to help articulate ESG topics to novices and experts alike.Excellent Excel skills and/or other analytical software.Motivation and interest to undertake research across the ESG space, including regulatory and diligence research.Hands-on experience using AI tools in a professional context, for example, using LLMs for research synthesis, drafting, or analysis.Proactive, with the ability and confidence to use initiative.Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines.

Character & Working Style

Intellectually rigorous and detail-oriented; you take care with accuracy and are comfortable asking questions rather than guessing.Proactive and self-directed; comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving team.Adaptable and eager to build breadth across ESG topics rather than narrow specialisation, at least in the early stages of this role.Curious and technology-enabled; actively seeks out new tools, technologies, and AI capabilities to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of their work.Mission-driven; genuinely committed to making private markets more sustainable and solving complex problems.Client-focused; takes pride in producing high-quality, accurate work that supports the broader team's client relationships.

Important Notes

Benefits

Competitive salary plus stock optionsGenerous PTO policy including public holidaysComprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage401(k) plan with employer matchPurpose-driven, inclusive cultureThe opportunity to be part of a growing team at the forefront of ESG and private markets innovation

Why Join Us?

Novata is a mission-first company built to enable the private markets to drive more impact. We are at the unique intersection of ESG, the private markets, and mission driven impact. Why Patients Need You

Pfizer’s purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Research and Development is at the heart of fulfilling Pfizer’s purpose as we work to translate advanced science and technologies into the therapies and vaccines that matter most. Whether you are in the discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy or supporting clinical trials, you will apply cutting edge design and process development capabilities to accelerate and bring the best-in-class medicines to patients around the world.

Role Summary

As a Senior Associate Scientist in the Early Bioprocess Development within Pfizer Vaccine Research and Development, you will be at the center of our operations and you’ll find that everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to quality. You will join a large team of Scientists focused on conjugation process development for manufacturing carbohydrate-based conjugate vaccines. Primary duties include supporting the development and optimization of conjugation methods, purification, and analysis of intermediates and glycoconjugates using chemical and chromatographic methods. The individual will become a key contributor towards supporting the early development and scale up of glycoconjugate vaccines. Careful documentation of work and presentation of data is required. All work is to be done in a compliant manner according to SOP guidelines and cGMP/GLP regulations, where applicable.

Role Responsibilities

Job Description

Background

Anchored in the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and in line with the priorities outlined in the UNDP Strategic Plan, the Regional Bureau for Arab States (RBAS) supports the Arab States region to achieve sustainable development by eradicating poverty in all its forms and dimensions, accelerating structural transformations for sustainable development, and building resilience to crises and shocks. Within this work, the Regional Bureau for Arab States responds to needs across development settings including Least Developed Countries, Middle Income Countries, Net Contributor Countries and countries affected by crisis, with a view to support the building of resilience, fight climate change, leverage the promise of innovation, and prioritize the advance of women, youth and vulnerable groups as part of its commitment to the principles of universality, equality and leaving no one behind in an increasing challenging regional context which has been further impacted by various crises.

RBAS supports partners in the region to develop integrated, transformative, and scalable solutions to tackle the interconnected challenges of poverty, vulnerability, inequality and exclusion, in ways that are economically, socially and environmentally sustainable. The team assists in enhancing prospects for inclusive growth, jobs and livelihoods at national and local levels, including through economic recovery and resilience-building in crisis and post crisis contexts, focusing on empowering women and youth, and advancing opportunities for the most vulnerable. It also supports research, policy, and program guidance around: macroeconomic stability, private and financial sectors, fiscal policy and public finance management, economic transformation, social protection, women economic empowerment, urban and digital economy, etc.

The intern will report to the Strategic Initiatives Advisor in RBAS New York and will support the work on policy and research, including the Arab Human Development Report (AHDR) and ongoing socio-economic analyses examining the implications of conflicts and other shocks for growth, employment, poverty, inequality and human development in the Arab States region.

Duties And Responsibilities

Research and analysis: Conducting data collection, desk reviews of existing research and literature on one or two of the areas that the inclusive growth team is currently working on (namely, macroeconomics, public finance management, social protection, informality, labor market, poverty and inequality, private sector development (including micro, small and medium enterprises), SDG financing).Policy Brief Development: Assist in the drafting and preparation of policy briefs, technical notes, and economic assessments tailored for regional stakeholders and decision-makers.Advanced Quantitative Analysis: Support the team by conducting quantitative data analysis using reliable sources and tools to identify and visualize regional economic trends.Event and Dialogue Support: Provide logistical and substantive support in organizing regional consultations, webinars, and other forums related to inclusive growth and economic development.Regional Monitoring: Regularly monitor and summarize macroeconomic indicators, ongoing socio-economic developments, and policy shifts across the Arab States region to inform the team's ongoing programmatic work.Knowledge Management: Assist in maintaining and updating internal databases, knowledge repositories, and community-of-practice platforms with the latest research and data findings.Assist in the development: of new or ongoing initiatives, including review of policy literature in respect to the subject to enhance UNDP programming in the relevant field within the Arab Region.Document good practices: Including cases studies, innovations and pilot models for wider dissemination and sharing.Concept notes: Prepare conceptual framework / concept notes on new areas of work or development challenges.

Functional Competencies

Strong sense of collaborative work, excellent communication and interpersonal skills;Keen attention to detail;Proven record of interest and work in the development field;Excellent analytical and research skills using state of the art quantitative analytical tools such as STATA, R;Research experience;Interest in the Arab States region and possibly some background in researching the region;

Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies;Identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required;Allocates appropriate amount of time and resource for completing work;Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning;Monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary;Uses time efficiently.

Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honor commitments;Delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards;Operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules;Supports subordinates, provide oversight and take responsibility for delegated assignments;Takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.


Creativity

Actively seeks to improve program or services;Offers new and different options to solve problems or meet client needs;Promotes and persuades others to consider new ideas;Takes calculated risks on new and unusual ideas;Thinks “outside the box”;Takes an interest in new ideas and new ways of doing things;Not bound by current thinking or traditional approaches.


Technological Awareness

Keeps abreast of available technology;Understands applicability and limitation of technology to the work of the office;Actively seeks to apply technology to appropriate tasks;Shows willingness to learn new technology.


Education

Required Skills and Experience

Applicants to the UNDP internship programme must at the time of application meet one of the following requirements:

 Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as a master’s programme, or higher) in subjects relevant to the work of Inclusive Growth Team (economics, development studies, public policy, international development and related fields).  Be enrolled in the final academic year of a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in subjects mentioned under (1) above. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional traineeship program and undertake the internship as part of this program. 


Experience

Experience with quantitative data analysis using software like R, Stata, or Python is a strong asset.Demonstrated ability to work well both independently and within a multicultural team.Good command of information and communication technology.


Languages

Fluency in English (both oral and written) is required. Arabic and French language skills would be an asset but not necessary for the assignment.


Stipend

Where an intern is not financially supported by any institution or programme, such as a university, government, foundation or scholarship programme, a stipend intended to help cover basic daily expenses related to the internship, such as meals and transportation at the duty station, must be paid by the receiving office.The monthly amount of the stipend will be determined for each duty station based on the stipend rates published yearly by the OHR Policy and Compensation Unit. Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

rows.title: Deduction Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Glimpse

Glimpse is the leading AI platform for CPG brands. We automate critical back-office workflows like deductions management, revenue recovery, and cash application. Since launching in April 2024, we have grown from zero to over 200 customers and raised $52M from investors including a16z, 8VC, and Y Combinator.

Our AI agents retrieve deduction data, validate charges, automate cash application, and dispute invalid claims. This is work that would typically take a full-time employee years to complete. For a $1B CPG brand, a single Glimpse agent reviewed 17,000 deductions in under 24 hours and identified over $10M in recoverable revenue.

We are building the next-generation suite of services for consumer brands and are looking for exceptional people to help us scale.

About The Role

As a Deductions Analyst at Glimpse, you will be the expert behind our AI-powered deductions platform. You will help leading CPG brands recover millions of dollars in lost revenue by investigating retailer deductions, determining whether claims are valid, and driving disputes through to resolution.

You will investigate retailer chargebacks, analyze supporting documentation, identify invalid claims, and recover revenue through retailer dispute processes. Rather than managing deductions for a single manufacturer, you will work across a portfolio of leading CPG brands, partnering with AI to deliver accurate, high-quality outcomes at scale.

Our platform handles the repetitive work of retrieving documentation, organizing deduction data, and surfacing recommendations. This allows you to apply your expertise to evaluate complex claims, make judgment calls, and maximize revenue recovery for our customers. As we continue to scale, you will also help shape the operational processes and best practices that power both our team and our AI.

What You'll Do

Act as the critical human in the loop: Investigate and validate retailer chargebacks (promotions, shortages, pricing, etc.) by leveraging AI agents to surface data while you handle edge cases and complex resolutions. Train the AI: Determine claim validity by evaluating supporting documentation (invoices, proof of delivery) and use your final decisions to actively train our AI models on complex deduction scenarios. Shape the Product: Partner directly with our Engineering and Product teams to continuously improve the existing platform and translate your deduction workflows into new automated features. Manage Disputes: Prepare, submit, and manage deduction disputes through retailer portals while actively working to automate tracking, recovery monitoring, and follow-up processes. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Customer Success and Operations to understand customer-specific trade programs, identify recurring root causes, and help customers reduce future revenue leakage. Build the Foundation: Maintain accurate records, document best practices, and help build the operational foundation behind the industry's most automated deductions management platform. 

MUST HAVES

2+ years of experience managing retailer deductions, trade deductions, accounts receivable, chargebacks, or deductions resolution within a CPG company. Strong understanding of retailer deduction types, including promotions, shortages, pricing discrepancies, freight, compliance, returns, damaged goods, and other customer claims. Experience researching deductions using supporting documentation and determining whether claims are valid. Experience preparing, submitting, and following deduction disputes through resolution. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment. Ability to manage a high volume of cases while maintaining accuracy, organization, and timely follow-up. Comfortable working cross-functionally and communicating clearly with internal teams and customers. Experience working with ERP systems (SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.) and Microsoft Excel. 

NICE TO HAVES

(Preferred) Experience in or selling into CPG, food & beverage, health, or beauty industries. (Preferred) Familiarity with deductions, trade finance, or retail supply chain workflows. Experience working with retailer portals (e.g. Walmart, Target, Kroger, Costco, Amazon, or similar). Experience working alongside automation or AI-enabled operational tools. Comfortable in a fast-paced, in-person startup environment

Traits that do well here

High ownership: You go beyond advising and drive the work to completion. Systems thinking: You can reason about messy workflows and design scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes. Customer empathy and backbone: You listen deeply, then confidently set boundaries and call out tradeoffs. Curiosity: You enjoy digging into complex retailer claims and figuring out what actually happened. Fast learner: You ramp into new domains and tools quickly. 

WHY JOIN GLIMPSE

You will join a company that has found genuine product-market fit and is scaling fast, backed by the infrastructure, capital, and team to match. Your work will directly recover revenue for hundreds of CPG brands while helping define how AI transforms finance and operations across the industry.

This is not a traditional deductions role. You will combine your expertise with cutting-edge AI, helping shape both the workflows our customers rely on today and the intelligent systems they will rely on tomorrow.

Competitive salary with meaningful equityIn-person team in NYC with high ownership and fast feedback loopsDirect impact on a company growing at an exceptional paceA front-row seat to building the operating system for CPG brands

Location:

Prime Midtown location - Penn Station, Madison Square Garden, and the city's best transit connections right at your door. *Moving to a new location in August

GLIMPSE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. GLIMPSE will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

This role is ideal for entry-level candidates interested in learning clinical research operations, contributing to study execution, and developing foundational skills in patient interaction, data management, and regulatory compliance.

The Clinical Research Assistant (RA) provides foundational support in the conduct of clinical trials at the site level. Working under the direct supervision of a CRC II, CRC III, or Site Manager, the RA assists with operational, administrative, and participant-facing tasks to ensure studies run smoothly and in accordance with ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and protocol guidelines. This role is an ideal entry point for individuals seeking to gain hands-on experience in clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

 Support study start-up activities, including supply inventory, document preparation, and site initiation readiness.  Assist with participant screening workflows as delegated, including scheduling screening visits and collecting basic information such as demographics, medical history, and other study-relevant details to support eligibility assessment.  Schedule and prepare for participant visits, including source prep, lab kits, and CRFs.  Serve as a participant liaison—confirm appointments, coordinate transportation, and maintain ongoing communication.  Escort and assist participants during on-site visits; perform vital signs, ECGs, and specimen collection/processing as trained.  Complete accurate, ALCOA+-compliant source documentation for delegated procedures.  Perform data entry into EDC systems and assist with query resolution.  Maintain study binders, charts, and logs; support supply management.  Ensure accurate capture and upload of paper source documents into eSource systems in accordance with site processes and regulatory requirements, supporting long-term retention and audit readiness.  Obtain, track, and manage medical releases, as well as medical and pharmacy records from external providers as needed, in accordance with site SOPs and protocol requirements.  Support CRCs during monitoring visits and assist with preparing documentation and materials to ensure audit and inspection readiness.  Assist with investigational product (IP) accountability tasks as needed and where applicable, gaining exposure to IP handling, tracking, and documentation under the direct supervision of CRC staff, while ensuring adherence to protocol and site SOPs.  Develop proficiency in site SOPs, institutional policies, and GCP requirements to build foundational knowledge in compliant research practices.  Assist in collecting and entering study data into trackers, logs, and EDC systems, focusing on accurate and timely data collection.  Support CRCs in maintaining accurate records and updating study metrics. 

Qualifications

Basic understanding of clinical research principles is a plus.  Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
