rows.descriptionText:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be an Applied AI Engineer supporting a dedicated national security mission program. You will be the customer's trusted technical advisor, working closely with their engineering and mission teams as they build and ship new capabilities powered by Claude: advising on architecture design decisions, developing evaluation frameworks, and guiding them through the most cutting-edge implementation patterns for LLMs.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide the customer from technical discovery through successful deployment, much of it on-site in secure environments. You'll combine deep engineering expertise and cyber domain knowledge with customer-facing skills to help the customer unlock the full potential of Claude and move their mission capabilities closer to the frontier, while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Responsibilities

Serve as a specialist technical advisor for one or more national security mission programs, from discovery and evaluation through deployment and adoption, coordinating internally across multiple teams to drive customer success Support the customer as they build with Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude for Enterprise Partner with account executives and Applied AI Architects to translate mission requirements into technical solutions Influence technical architecture decisions and integration into the customer's existing stack by developing customized pilots, prototypes, and evaluation suites Help develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for mission-specific use cases Lead hands-on technical workshops and code reviews with customer engineering teams Identify common design patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams Create and deliver technical content, from engineering deep dives to executive briefings Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks Work primarily on-site with the customer's engineering and mission teams in secure government facilities, while maintaining close internal coordination and feedback with Anthropic's Applied AI and Engineering teams 

Minimum Qualifications 

Active TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph Prior experience working within US intelligence community agencies as a government civilian or cleared contractor 4+ years of experience in technical roles such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Product Engineer, Software Engineer, or Technical Product Manager, with a desire to work closely with customers Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python or TypeScript and experience building production applications Hands-on expertise in one or more of the following domains:Offensive or defensive cyber operations (including vulnerability research, reverse engineering, and ICS/OT security) Cryptography and cryptanalysis Intelligence analysis and ISR (all-source, SIGINT, GEOINT) Mission and weapons systems (command and control, space, electronic warfare, autonomy) CBRN and nonproliferation Accreditation of classified systems (RMF, ATO, cross-domain solutions) Exceptional communication skills to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, from engineers to executives, while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach 
Preferred Qualifications

Production experience with LLMs, including advanced prompt engineering, agent development and frameworks, evaluation frameworks, transcript analysis, MCP, and deployment at scale Experience deploying and operating software in air-gapped or classified environments Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Background in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or data science Ability to navigate ambiguity and execute across domains with intellectual openness, finding simple solutions to complex problems High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications 

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$280,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Job Number #176539 - Surrey, England, United Kingdom

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Location: Woking, UK

Reporting to: Director, Customer Development

£59400 - £66000

Why Work For Colgate-Palmolive:

Continuous Growth & Learning: Elevate your commercial mindset and digital capabilities through immersive, cross-functional collaboration. Impact & Autonomy: Operate in a fast-paced, agile environment with direct accountability for driving market-leading Personal Care performance. Global Exposure: Shape the trajectory of world-class brands while accessing diverse international career pathways. Our Purpose-Driven Culture: We live our values every day—We are Caring, We are Inclusive, and We are Courageous. 

Job Purpose

As an Omni Category Manager, you will serve as the trusted category growth consultant for the Tesco account, working in close partnership with the Customer Development team and Retail Marketing Managers to unlock total category growth and maximize brand value at the Point of Purchase. To accelerate sustainable category sales, market share, and margin growth, you will execute Colgate-Palmolive’s EDGE (Every Day Great Execution) framework and leverage internal AI tools and digital analytics to transform complex data into actionable 7P recommendations. Summit – New Jersey (USA) for internal hire only

São José dos Campos - São Paulo (BR) for internal or external hire.

Our Purpose

The Deliver Finance team is dedicated to optimizing the movement of our products from factories to customers. We leverage financial analytics to measure and protect value within the logistics network. Our goal is to provide deep business insights into transportation, warehousing, and customer service costs, driving efficiency and support Kenvue’s journey toward automated and faster reporting capabilities.

Position Overview

The Financial Analyst for North America Deliver Finance is a key partner in managing the financial health of the regional logistics network. This role focuses on the Planning, Forecasting, and Reporting of Deliver costs (Freight, Distribution, and Logistics services). You will be responsible for providing actionable analytics to the North America Deliver Operations team, ensuring that logistics spend is transparent, optimized, and aligned with strategic goals. Serve as a key finance partner to Deliver Operations leadership, providing financial guidance, operational insights, and strategic support to drive cost efficiency, service performance, and sustainable growth across the logistics network.

Deliver Cost Management: Lead financial oversight and reporting for North America Deliver expenses, including 3PL Distribution Center operations, warehouse volume-based costs, and Customer Service headcount. Ensure accurate tracking, consolidation, and visibility of logistics spending across the network. Logistics Variance Analysis (BVA): Perform detailed analysis of Actuals vs. Forecast/BP for Deliver costs, identifying key cost drivers such as volume fluctuations, warehouse productivity, transportation impacts, reverse logistics, inventory destruction, and workforce-related expenses. Provide actionable insights to support decision-making and cost optimization.3PL Distribution Center Financial Support: Partner with Distribution Center operations and third-party logistics providers to monitor spending, evaluate operational performance, validate billings, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and control costs. Cost-to-Serve Analytics: Partner with Operations to analyze "Cost-to-Serve" metrics, helping to identify opportunities for network optimization and efficiency. Savings & CIP Tracking: Monitor and validate Cost Improvement Projects (CIP) within the Deliver space, ensuring savings are accurately reflected in the financial results.Forecast Cycle: Manage the Deliver Warehouse and Distribution submissions, ensuring North America logistics inputs are consolidated for the Business Plan and forecast cycles. Consolidate assumptions, challenge cost estimates, and ensure alignment with operational plans and volume expectations.Digital Transformation: Drive continuous improvement through automation and digital reporting solutions, enhancing data visibility, reducing manual processes, and improving forecast accuracy and analytical capabilities.Compliance & Internal Controls: Ensure logistics accounting, accruals, and financial processes comply with company policies, internal controls, and accounting standards. Support audits and maintain strong governance across Deliver-related financial activities. 

Qualifications

Education: A minimum of a bachelor’s degree is required in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or Business Management. MBA, or advanced Finance certifications (CPA, CMA) is highly preferred. 

Experience And Skills

Language: Fluent in English communication skills (written and verbal) Eperience in Finance or Accounting; Specific Experience: Previous experience in Logistics/Deliver Finance, Supply Chain Finance, or Manufacturing Finance is highly desirable;Technical: Strong proficiency in Excel and SAP is required. Knowledge of OneStream and data visualization tools (Power BI) is a plus;Soft Skills: Ability to translate complex logistics data into financial insights and communicate effectively with non-finance stakeholders.

rows.title: IT&DATA Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About The Job

We are seeking a Product Analyst to drive the data, technology, and process solutions that enable Sales, Order Entry and Sales ecosystem interfaces. In this role, you will translate commercial needs into actionable product requirements, manage a value-driven backlog, and lead delivery using agile and product management for best practices. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver reliable, high-impact Sales, Operations and Finance capabilities.

You will help define the requirements and facilitate delivering solutions to grow the business through the Sales tools. You will partner closely with the business to understand the day-to-day issues of our business partners and identify ways to improve their experience and improve the Customer Value Journey. You will work closely with Product Owner and Senior Product Owner, supporting them by making the product vision a reality and maximizing value for the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Contributes to the vision of the product, its definition, and the associated value. Makes recommendations to build and sustain the backlog, arbitrating among different needs and priorities. Evaluate solution options and manage the product cost model to maximize business value. Lead end-to-end product delivery using agile methodologies. Defines, analyzes, and validates key metrics to inform decision-making and measure product success from a business and user perspective. Identifies opportunities to improve customer adoptability of customer services tools, delivering and maintaining the valuable features on Sales platforms. Partner with technology vendors and internal technical teams to deliver scalable solutions. Work alongside business leaders to drive impact and value to Danone business objectives. Recommend technology unlocks and opportunities. 

This role is considered a “hybrid” position that allows for flexible work, meaning it is a role where collaboration with key stakeholders in Danone Hubs (White Plains, NY or Louisville, CO) occurs. While you may have the option to work from home on a schedule as agreed to with your supervisor, you are also expected to regularly report to your assigned office location at least 3 days per week.

The base compensation range for this position is $93,000 - $133,000 commensurate with experience. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment with opportunities to work both remotely and in office when desired.

About You

5+ years of experience in IT for Sales Tools, Operations and SAP SDBachelor's Degree within a Business IT or Computer Science related discipline or equivalent combination of education, training and experience is required. High technical skills to build functional/integration diagrams in L0,L1,L2 levels. Leadership skills to work with developers and external partners. Business Partnering Be a business translator! Ability to assemble, analyze, and evaluate data and to be able to make appropriate and well-reasoned recommendations and decisions to the Business stakeholders and the Project / Development TeamsCuriosity, adaptability, and the ability to operate in a fast‑moving environment. Strong functional knowledge of Sales tools, SAP Sales & Distribution. Knowledge and experience with Jira (Atlassian) a plusExperience applying product management, agile delivery, and user/product centric design practices. Ability to synthesize to write user stories / User Experience / Design Thinking / Data integration. Test user stories to ensure acceptance and validation to meet product goalsStrong analytical, communication, and cross‑functional collaboration skills. Experience with automation, machine learning, or advanced analytics is a plus 

About us

Life at Danone

With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., our vibrant culture and endless growth opportunities are just a couple of the reasons our employees call themselves “Proud Danoners.”

Learn more about Life at Danone

Our Brands

When you join us, you’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world, including Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®.

Our Purpose

We’re committed to making a positive impact on our world. Rooted in our mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible, we’re proud to be the world’s largest B Corp.

Learn more about our mission.

Our commitment to making the world healthier starts with our employees.

Physical Wellbeing We pay for the majority of your medical benefits – which include medical, dental and vision – with our competitive 80%/20% cost-sharing modelMental Wellbeing Danoners receive fitness discounts, unlimited flexible time off and hybrid work schedules. We also have a range of programs that support mental health and substance abuse. Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary: 

We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Data Engineer to join our Digital Tech & Data team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the data pipelines that support our digital ecosystem — from ingesting raw data across multiple digital touchpoints to delivering clean, robust data that business teams can trust and act on.

You will bring engineering rigour to data — treating pipelines, models, and infrastructure as production-grade software — while staying closely connected to the digital business context your work enables.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain production-grade data pipelines in Airflow that ingest data from digital touchpoints into Snowflake. Develop modular, tested, and well-documented dbt models that transform raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets — owning the full lifecycle from source definition to exposure. Provision and manage cloud data infrastructure (Snowflake objects, Airflow environments, supporting GCP resources) through Terraform, with everything version-controlled and peer-reviewed. Implement and uphold data quality, observability, and testing standards across pipelinesTune Snowflake performance and manage warehouse cost — clustering, query profiling, resource monitors and treat cost as a first-class engineering concern. Implement pipelines to platform standards — branching strategy, CI/CD for dbt and Airflow, code review norms, documentation, naming conventions 

Required Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline. 

Experience:

2–3 years of hands-on experience in a data engineering or analytics engineering role, ideally within a digital or e-commerce environment. 

Preferred Qualifications:

Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines using Apache Airflow. Strong working knowledge of Snowflake, including data modelling, performance tuning, clustering, and warehouse cost management. Demonstrated experience developing dbt projects — writing modular, tested, and well-documented transformation logic. Practical experience using Terraform to provision and manage cloud data infrastructure in a repeatable, version-controlled manner. Proficiency in Python for writing data pipelines, custom operators, and utility tooling. Strong SQL skills with the ability to write and optimise complex queries across large datasets. Fluency in driving an AI coding tool across pipeline codebase: scoping changes, providing the right files as context.

Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

The Senior Director establishes a forward-thinking consumer care vision that functions as an insights engine, collecting consumer feedback data from various channels and leveraging AI and data analytics to deliver actionable consumer intelligence directly to internal stakeholders. Measure and optimize impact from proactive insights and resolutions. Global Compliance & Strategic Risk Mitigation: Champion regulatory compliance across global and regional frameworks while deploying data analytics as a proactive Quality tool. Institutionalize key product and regulatory data collection to eliminate liability, mitigate product recalls, and partner with IT to source and scale modern compliance platforms. Omnichannel Agility & Consumer Experience Excellence: Architect consumer strategies across all digital and voice touchpoints, including social media, SMS, live chat, and email. Advance channel engagement using data analytics, AI and intelligent automation, ensuring seamless and efficient consumer experiences. Consumer Advocacy & Voice of the Consumer (VOC) Insights: Amplify the voice of the consumer across the enterprise by driving optimized usage of first-party data and capabilities translating consumer feedback into actionable intelligence for Marketing, R&D product development and packaging innovation. Situational and Reputation Risk Management: Formulate proactive identification matrices for potential reputational risks and establish communication frameworks. Transform company policies into clear messaging. Talent Transformation: Develop and implement strategy to evolve contact center Representatives into omnichannel consumer advocates. Progressive leadership experience within global, highly regulated Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) organizations or pharmaceutical industry10+ years of senior leadership experience managing large, globally distributed, and matrixed teams (both direct and dotted-line reporting). Proficiency in regulatory (e.g FDA) and data privacy compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) within the consumer care ecosystem. Experience and ability to develop Consumer Affairs data strategy that leverages deep consumer interactivity and drives optimized actions enterprise-wide.

Job Location

Job Description

Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

This internship is specifically designed for individuals working towards a PhD who are developing proficiency in their field. As an intern or co-op in management, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in a supportive environment. This is a 12-week paid internship, designed to provide you with a solid foundation for future career growth. The internship will take place from May (potentially early June) to August of 2027. The Opportunity:

Procter & Gamble is looking for a PhD student Intern to advance imaging technologies for research and product evaluation. You will design, prototype, and test imaging hardware and capture workflows that improve image quality, measurement repeatability, and quantitative assessment. Preferred Qualifications:

Experience designing, integrating, calibrating, or testing imaging systems.Experience with optics, illumination, camera systems, automated positioning or motion-control hardware, and different imaging techniques.Experience developing computer-vision methods for image registration, object detection, quality assessment, and quantitative measurement.Experience developing and applying deep-learning workflows using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.Record of scientific contributions through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or patents in quantitative bioimaging, computer vision, or a related field.

rows.title: Project Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Reporting into the Data Analytics Manager in FHB Supply Chain & Logistics, this role is responsible for driving the planning, prioritisation and delivery of strategic data, analytics and transformation initiatives across the business.

The role combines delivery leadership, portfolio management and business transformation, overseeing a complex backlog of projects while maintaining visibility of priorities, dependencies, risks and resource requirements. Through strong stakeholder engagement, it supports informed decision-making and ensures alignment between business demand, team capacity and delivery commitments.

A key aspect of the role is leading end-to-end programmes that improve processes. This includes translating business challenges into actionable delivery plans and identifying opportunities to unlock efficiencies and value across the organisation.

Due to high interest, this role may close earlier than advertised. We recommend applying as soon as possible.,

All the details

What You’ll Do

Your key accountabilities will include

Own and maintain the Data & Reporting Analytics backlog, ensuring effective prioritisation, resource allocation and delivery sequencing.Assess, challenge and shape new requirements, ensuring requests are aligned to strategic objectives, and appropriate team capacity exists before commitment.Support workload planning and capacity management for FHB analytics teams, balancing incoming demand against team capability and strategic priorities. Establish and maintain a structured governance and reporting cadence with key business stakeholders, providing transparency of progress, priorities, dependencies and risks.Define, document, agree and maintain detailed project plans, aligning to high level roadmaps and supporting the implementation of projects. 


Who You Are

Your skills and experience will include

Experience working in a commercial or fashion environment, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable, data-driven insights and decision-making.Previous experience of delivering projects with technical dependencies and working with technical leads.Proven experience of creating / agreeing good quality, well-crafted E2E plans and management of delivery roadmaps across the lifecycle.Excellent communication, influencing and relationship-building skills, with the ability to build strong partnerships across multiple functions, and the technical understanding needed to translate requirements, overcome blockers and keep delivery moving at pace.Proven experience of working within and being comfortable driving transformation in a fluid environment.


What's In It For You

Being a part of M&S is exactly that – playing your part to bring the magic of M&S to our customers every day. We’re an inclusive, dynamic, exciting, and ever evolving business built on doing the right thing and bringing exceptional quality, value, service to every customer, whenever, wherever and however they want to shop with us.

Here are some of the benefits we offer that make working for M&S just that little bit more special…

After completing your probationary period, you’ll receive 20% colleague discount across all M&S products and many of our third-party brands for you and a member of your household.Competitive holiday entitlement with the potential to buy extra holiday days!Discretionary bonus schemes awarded based on how you achieve your personal objectives and our performance as a business.A generous Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and Life Assurance.A dedicated welcome to our teams with a tailored induction and a wide range of training programmes to develop your skills.Amazing perks and discounts via our M&S Choices portal to maximise your financial and personal wellbeing.Industry-leading parental, adoption and neonatal policies, providing support and flexibility for your family.Access to a fantastic range of wellbeing support for all colleagues including access to our 24/7 Virtual GP and PAM Assist to support you and your family.A charity volunteer day to support a charity or cause you're passionate about through a dedicated day away from work.


Everyone's welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.

We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together.

rows.title: Manager, Paid Search (6 month Limited Time Duration)
rows.descriptionText:
PURPOSE

Excellence in paid search is one of the pillars of our overall Digital Marketing strategy and is of vital importance for our site traffic generation. The Paid Search Manager is a key member of the eCommerce Digital Marketing team, responsible for driving and optimizing our paid search activities. This position will create and execute the adidas NAM Paid Search strategy, in partnership with the Global Performance Marketing team, and will work with varied stakeholders to ensure its successful implementation.

You will fully support the channel objectives to drive high quality traffic to US online stores to accelerate revenue growth. With a primary focus on eCommerce profitability, you will also connect with Digital Activation, App, and DTC Retail Team colleagues to fully exploit all paid search opportunities in the North American market. You will play a key role within the adidas US Digital Marketing team and collaborate closely with the broader US eCommerce and Global Digital Brand Commerce teams to help create a best-in-class US based program.

Key Responsibilities

Devise and implement the Shopping/PLA and Feed based strategy, while contributing to the overall NAM Paid Search strategy, for adidas NAM eCommerce campaigns ensuring alignment with NAM Brand and Retail Marketing initiatives, as well as Global SEM standardsDrive and execute on the day-to-day paid search operations with KPI and goal accountability (traffic, margin, and revenue) by monitoring and reporting performance to Senior ManagementWork collaboratively cross-functionally with the US Digital Activation team, Merchandising, Buyers, Web Analytics, Global Performance Marketing Team and Marketing Activation to consistently stay apprised of inventory levels and product lifecycles that will better inform our paid search strategy across categoriesResponsible for overseeing overall US Shopping paid search budget, evaluating performance of different areas within paid search and PLAs, and reallocating accordingly based on performance. Responsible for top and bottom-line growth to achieve sales, ROI, and contribution goals.Aspire to be an industry leader at the forefront of innovation. Stay abreast of developments within the industry and possess the curiosity and desire to innovate paid search in new ways. Report on and present industry developments, trends, and case study results to leadership.Act as a key NAM paid search expert driving best practice definition, execution and documentation, including training internal stakeholders for your categories of responsibilityManage all operational aspects of paid search campaigns from start to finish in line with budget expectations and desired KPIs, analyze results, and present to Senior ManagementManage any associated direct vendor or platform relationships to improve overall performanceDrive testing, reporting, case studies, analysis and optimization on performance to identify key levers and opportunities for improvement

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Hands-on experience managing and optimizing shopping feeds, including Merchant Center management, feed structure and data quality governance, feed enhancement and optimization, troubleshooting feed and product disapprovals, and leveraging feed-driven strategies to improve Shopping campaign performance, scalability, and ROASProven retail eCommerce paid search skills, optimization, and bid management techniques; experience managing high volume growth targets for complex paid search campaignsExperience managing large media budgets and hitting monthly, quarterly, and annual goals for spend, revenue, ROAS, and other KPIs as determined by the businessAbility to produce regular reporting, collaborative strategic planning, and performance management that aligns with and accomplishes business goalsEmbraces and thrives in an international working environment as a result of understanding the complexities of a large, global organizationAbility to balance pure SEM goals with overall business goals and brand prioritiesExtremely analytical, data driven and a clear, independent thinker, able to efficiently distill complex information into strategic actionable recommendationsFamiliarity with the broader online marketing context (i.e. organic search, display, paid social, affiliates, marketplaces, product feeds). Knowledge of digital attribution modelling is beneficial. Strong ad copy writing skills, testing process, knowledge and adherence to best practicesAmbitious, profit driven and interested in the broader business context. A desire to grow this channel with a strong work ethic and diligenceStrong attention to detail, flawless execution, time management, planning & organizational skillsAbility to work well under pressure and within tight deadlinesAbility to manage and influence others directly and indirectly; previous experience managing people is a plusStrong communication and interpersonal skills, team player, and able to build strong relationships quicklyAn interest in exploiting technology (feeds, scripts, etc.) to automate and scale key processesIndependent learner, self-starter, curious and passionate about eCommerce and paid search, with an excitement to develop and enhance paid search skills and experience

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree preferred; marketing, business, or computer science focus a plus3-5 years hands-on paid search experience (ideally both agency and client side) managing all aspects of paid search including campaigns across multiple engines and devices, bidding strategies, PLAs, RSAs, DSAs, etc. and writing ad copy that is highly relevant and targeted to the businessProficiency with some or all of these SEM tools or platforms: DataFeedWatch, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Search Ads, Adobe and Google Analytics. Campaign management platforms: Search Ads 360, Kenshoo, Marin, Adobe, or other similar platformsAdvanced computer skills with proven Excel experience; Google Ads certified preferred

adidas celebrates diversity, supports inclusiveness and encourages individual expression in our workplace. We actively encourage individuals with disabilities to apply and will provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. We do not tolerate the harassment or discrimination toward any of our applicants or employees. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

adidas offers robust and progressive medical, including HSA (Health Savings Account) with employer funding or FSA (Flexible Spending Account) options, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, adoption, with surrogate and fertility support, short and long-term disability, and basic life and AD&D insurance. Employees are able to enroll in adidas’ 401k plan and Stock Purchase Plan with employer match (eligible after one year and 1,000 hours of service). Full-time employees are eligible for generous Leave policies including 14 weeks of paid parental leave.

Employees accrue prorated flexible time off at the rate of one hour per every thirty hours worked up to a maximum of eighty hours per year, and are eligible to take eleven paid company holidays throughout the calendar year.

Though our teammates hail from all corners of the world, our working language is English.

At adidas we offer a Hybrid work policy which requires attendance in the office Monday through Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday each week. For work requiring a high degree of collaboration or an in-person presentation, in-office attendance is required even on Friday. The working location of this position is Portland, Oregon

This role will work on strategic initiatives that improve how cross-functional teams work together to deliver exceptional fan experiences. Rather than owning a single project, you'll help bring structure to complex problems by organizing information, facilitating collaboration, and synthesizing insights from across the organization into actionable recommendations.

rows.title: Client Specialist, Operations - Client Service for UK
rows.descriptionText:
What will you be doing? 

Based in the UK, this Client Service representative will be responsible for addressing all inquiries on data elements raised by internal or external clients. This may include fielding, investigating, and resolving data issues, and/or collaboration with other groups to drive to resolution. Client Service grows and maintains direct relationships with external clients to facilitate effective two-way communication and serves as needed as an internal interface to Operations.

Job Responsibilities

External Role:

Build strong, trusted, on-going relationships with clients as their main point of contact for data inquiries, operational activity, methodology, and category enhancements. Address, troubleshoot, resolve, and communicate data quality issues/resolutions alone or in collaboration with other groups. Clearly articulate Circana processes and decision making as it relates to data inquiries. Prepare written and verbal communications which clearly convey issues, findings, resolutions and impacts to external audiences. Proactively provide clients with an overview of data changes due to upgrades or launches prior to data release. Maintain an understanding of Industry key categories to support client interaction. Gather suggestions and represent need for enhancements from clients for internal discussion. Attend client meetings as necessary. 

Internal role:

Develop trusted relationships with Practice leads, Commercial teams, Operations, and Product. Effectively liaise with other Client Service team members, Operations, Commercial, Product, Research Science, and other support groups to ensure ultimate resolution and communication of inquiries. Monitor and identify patterns in client inquiries that could influence changes in our processes. Maintain detailed and effective communication with Commercial team related to client interaction, both reactive and proactive. Master an understanding of Circana processes to support investigation and articulation of inquiries. Assist senior management team with setting strategies and direction to the department. 

Requirements

Extensive experience in retailer and consumer data. Bachelor’s degree required. Strong capabilities to work daily in English (spoken and written, C1 level). Experience in communication with clients at all levels, advanced verbal and written communication skills. Strong technical skills in market research data. Ability to partner with internal teams, monitor workflow, and assure follow-through. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and to coordinate multi-disciplinary teams. Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, v-look up and basic calculations). Advanced Excel skills strongly preferred. Able to travel domestic and internationally. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): UK

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

rows.title: Strategy and Informatics
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Company Description

Epsilon is seeking a Strategy and Informatics Intern to help develop data-informed strategies and marketing experiences that improve customer and business outcomes. You’ll work alongside cross-functional teams and gain exposure to areas such as campaign strategy, audience insights, messaging, content development, digital media, go-to-market planning, and performance measurement.

In this role, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that help Epsilon and its clients better understand audiences, personalize experiences, and activate campaigns across channels. Depending on team needs, your work may include supporting audience segmentation, campaign planning, competitive research, creative development, website content, sales materials, media activation, reporting, or optimization.

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of two days per week in the office.

Responsibilities

Epsilon’s Internship Program

As an intern, you’ll participate in Epsilon’s formal 11-week summer Internship Program, designed to create a meaningful early-career experience for university students. The program offers professional development, hands-on training, networking opportunities, business projects, and social events, along with consideration for full-time employment.

What You’ll Achieve

Support the development and execution of marketing and customer engagement strategies aligned with business and client goals.Conduct market, audience, customer, and competitive research to identify trends and opportunities.Translate data and insights into clear, actionable recommendations.Assist with audience definition, segmentation, personalization, messaging, and campaign planning.Contribute to the creation of marketing materials such as presentations, sales collateral, case studies, website content, campaign briefs, and performance reports.Collaborate with Marketing, Strategy, Product, Sales, Creative, Analytics, and other cross-functional partners.Help coordinate campaign execution across owned, paid, and earned channels.Monitor campaign or program performance and assist with reporting, analysis, and optimization.Help maintain consistent messaging across communications, promotions, campaigns, and events.Present ideas, findings, and recommendations to team members and project stakeholders.

These responsibilities reflect the source roles’ shared emphasis on cross-functional collaboration, messaging, audience strategy, campaign execution, research, reporting, and results analysis.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring With You

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Advertising, Psychology, Analytics, or a related field.Interest in marketing, strategy, customer behavior, digital media, or data-driven decision-making.Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills.Curiosity and an ability to translate research or data into clear ideas and recommendations.Strong organization, time-management, and prioritization skills.Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.A collaborative approach and an ability to build effective cross-functional relationships.Initiative, creativity, resourcefulness, and a willingness to learn.Comfort working at both strategic and tactical levels.A desire to develop professionally and make a meaningful contribution to the team.

Why You Might Stand Out

Previous internship, project, coursework, or leadership experience related to marketing, strategy, advertising, customer insights, or digital media.Experience conducting research, analyzing information, or developing presentations and recommendations.Familiarity with digital marketing channels, campaign measurement, audience segmentation, CRM, or paid media.Experience working with marketing, analytics, research, design, or presentation tools.A portfolio, case study, or class project demonstrating strategic thinking, research, marketing, or problem-solving skills.

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.

Additional Information

When You Join Us, We’ll Create Something EPIC Together

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.

Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.

People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.Flexibility: We’ve created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.

Act with integrityWork together to win togetherInnovate with purposeRespect all voicesEmpower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.

Because You Matter

Benefits

As an Epsilon employee, you deserve perks and benefits that put you, your family and your finances first. Our benefits encompass a wide range of offerings, including but not limited to the following:

Time to Recharge: Flexible time off (FTO), 15 paid holidaysTime to Recover: Paid sick time Family Well-Being: Parental/new child leave, childcare & elder care assistance, adoption assistance Extra Perks: Comprehensive health coverage, 401(k), tuition assistance, commuter benefits, professional development, employee recognition, charitable donation matching, health coaching and counseling 

Epsilon benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms.

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Epsilon’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on actual or perceived race, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, mental or physical disability, religion, creed, color, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. Epsilon also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. Epsilon will provide accommodations to applicants needing accommodations to complete the application process. Please reach out to LeaveofAbsence@epsilon.com to request an accommodation.

For San Francisco Bay and Los Angeles Areas: Epsilon will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and San Francisco Police Code Sections 4901-4919, commonly referred to as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Applicants with criminal histories are welcome to apply.

Compensation Range: USD $25.00 - USD $25.00/Hourly. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 10/15/2026.

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Our team is composed of media and analytics professionals who are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and measurable value to our clients. You will find success on this team by leveraging your analytical problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills to deliver actionable insights, drive client adoption of Circana's solutions, and support long-term client success.

We’re hiring a Senior Account Manager to support client relationships with our advertiser clients in the Wellness, Home Care and Beauty Industries. The Senior Account Manager will partner with Client Leads to develop and deliver actionable media execution recommendations for audiences and measurement solutions that are aligned with client strategy and research objectives. In addition to working on challenging projects with a collaborative team, the Account Management organization represents the voice of the client within Circana to drive product quality and innovation within this fast-paced industry.

Job Responsibilities

Own day to day client relationship and management of sold in business across Circana’s Media Products, including alignment to client learning objectives. This includes owning kick off calls & docs, project status updates, curating the final story, and communicating product updates/ expanded capabilities. Identify opportunities to expand adoption of Circana Media Products. Analyze data and measurement results in partnership with Delivery to develop insights and inform client on key learnings, recommendations, and actionable takeaways. Support cross-functional account partners with context from Media Solutions to build a complete understanding of the business. Ensure quality and data integrity of sold in work. Act as a client-facing product and marketing solutions expert for projects. Know how our measurement capabilities work in detail. Lead audience workshops across mid and top clients, responsible for cross-selling proactive recommendations to client partners. Translate client needs into growth initiatives demonstrating critical thinking and problem solving and commitment to quality and excellent client service. Engage cross-functionally with other internal teams to deliver solutions to clients and/or proactively resolve client issues. 

Requirements

Required Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics or a related quantitative or marketing field. Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive in task-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communications skills, with ability to tailor messages to a variety of internal and external stakeholders. Ability to thrive in a constantly evolving, agile environment. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint. Preferred 3-5 years experience in the Media ecosystem (including CPG, Retail, Agencies, Research and/or Sales); experience with insights and analytics in an account management role. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone

Location: Remote, USA. Chicago, IL or New York, NY preferred.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $70,000.00 to $80,000.00 USD.

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.

Overview

How You’ll Make an Impact 

As the Vice President of Campaign Management, you will own the product strategy and execution for Epsilon’s campaign management pod, leading the transformation of how campaigns are planned, launched, orchestrated, and optimized across Epsilon’s activation environments. Reporting to the SVP of Product, this newly created role will lead the delivery of a next-generation campaign management suite that serves as the operating system for campaign execution, bringing together automation, intuitive operator experiences, embedded workflows, and forecasting integrated directly into planning and execution. You will bring a clear point of view on how to simplify complexity, improve speed, and build product experiences that make Epsilon easier to use, more scalable to operate, and better positioned to support evolving campaign execution needs.

This role will play a key part in shaping the future of Epsilon’s campaign execution capabilities. Success will require translating the needs of operators, agencies, and platform partners into a clear product strategy that improves workflow speed, usability, orchestration, and execution quality across campaign lifecycles. You will define vision, align stakeholders, and lead the development of products that improve execution consistency, increase adoption, and drive measurable operational and business impact.

This is a highly strategic role that requires a resourceful leader with strong judgment, organizational savvy, interpersonal skills, self-motivation, and excellent communication. You will have a proven track record of leading product transformation through both strong product vision and disciplined execution, with the ability to move confidently between long-term strategy and the day-to-day realities of building products teams rely on.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Achieve

Develop the vision and set the strategic direction for Epsilon’s campaign management capabilities across planning, launch, optimization, reporting, and forecasting.Own the end-to-end campaign execution system, ensuring planning, launch, optimization, and reporting workflows operate as a unified, scalable control plane for operators.Lead the transformation of campaign operations from fragmented, ticket-driven workflows into a more unified, scalable, and intuitive product experience.Deliver a next-generation campaign management suite with automation, operator-first experiences, embedded workflows, and intelligent product capabilities.Enable consistent campaign execution across Epsilon Digital, retail media, and embedded activation environments through a unified orchestration model that improves speed, transparency, and control.Integrate forecasting directly into campaign workflows and planning tools so teams can make faster, more informed decisions and improve execution predictability.Own and drive the product lifecycle from strategy, design, and launch through continuous improvement, working closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Design, Operations, and Commercial teams.Define product requirements and roadmaps, including feasibility, effort, financial impact, and strategic value, with clear sequencing to improve speed, usability, and operational leverage.Ensure the Marketing team is aligned with Product strategy on market positioning, product realization, training programs, and product management work products.Serve as a critical partner to Product, Marketing, agency, and operations stakeholders, connecting the dots across workflow transformation, orchestration, and execution strategy.Research and offer recommendations to keep the Product organization on a path of continuous improvement while defining and managing KPIs across campaign speed, workflow efficiency, platform adoption, and user satisfaction.

Qualifications

Who You Are

Ability to comfortably span business management, client and commercial engagement, product design and development, and the technical details underpinning it all. Must be able to lead product vision and roadmap while also driving the day-to-day work required to deliver products that teams rely on.Deep industry knowledge of digital advertising, campaign execution, and the operational realities of planning, launch, optimization, and reporting.A minimum of 10 years in a Product role focused on advertising, campaign management, workflow-driven platforms, or related AdTech and MarTech products, with exposure to orchestration, automation, or forecasting considered a strong advantage.Experience building and scaling complex, workflow-driven products that support end-to-end operational processes and improve both efficiency and user experience.Proven ability to transform manual or service-heavy operating models into scalable, productized systems through strong strategy, disciplined execution, and close cross-functional partnership.Strong collaboration skills and commitment to interdisciplinary thinking – ability to work across teams focused on strategy, technology, data, operations, and design in service to new product solutions.Experience applying automation, AI-assisted workflows, or decision-support approaches to improve operational efficiency, execution quality, and usability.Solid planning, priority setting, and project management skills.Proven experience influencing business or marketing strategy through the application and management of competitive information, market awareness, and product positioning.Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across diverse teams including technical, operational, analytical, and marketing resources.Highly motivated, collaborative, and innovative.BA/BS degree. Advanced degree and/or MBA desirable.

Additional Information

When you join Epsilon, we’ll create something EPIC together. We’re a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

Check out a few of these resources to learn more about what makes Epsilon so EPIC:

Our Culture: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/our-culture-epsilon

Life at Epsilon: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/epic-blog

Epsilon Has Five Values That Define Our Culture And Guide Us As We Create Value For Our Clients, Our People And Consumers. We Seek Candidates Who Align With Our Company Values, Demonstrate Them And Make Them Meaningful In Their Day-to-day Work

The Customer Onboarding Manager is a critical position within the Customer Team. This individual owns the first phase of the customer journey, ensuring customer expectations are met and key success milestones are achieved. The Customer Onboarding Manager partners closely with customers and internal stakeholders to drive adoption, build user confidence, and accelerate time-to-value through effective onboarding, training, and enablement.

This role leverages data, technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency, personalize customer experiences, and scale best practices while maintaining a high-touch, customer-centric approach.

What You'll Do

Lead customer onboarding engagements, ensuring timely implementation and achievement of onboarding milestones. Partner with Account Team members to build and execute onboarding plans aligned to customer goals and business outcomes. Conduct customer training sessions and enablement activities that help users confidently adopt and maximize the value of Numerator solutions. Develop and maintain onboarding materials, learning resources, project documentation, and customer communications. Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance the customer experience while maintaining high standards of quality and judgment. Confirm and refine customer use cases to help customers expand platform adoption and realize measurable business impact. Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and serve as a strategic partner during the onboarding journey. Analyze onboarding progress, customer feedback, and adoption metrics to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement. Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, including AI capabilities, and recommend practical applications that improve team effectiveness and customer outcomes. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Bachelor's or Master's degree with at least 3 years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation, customer success, project management, training, or a related field. Experience in research and survey design is strongly preferred. Familiarity with consumer panel data and/or the CPG/retail industry is a plus. Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to educate and influence diverse audiences. Proven ability to build trusted relationships and guide customers through change and adoption. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple onboarding engagements simultaneously. Analytical mindset with the ability to identify customer needs, interpret data, derive insights, and develop action plans. Experience using AI-enabled productivity, analytics, or workflow tools in a professional environment, or demonstrated ability to learn and adopt emerging technologies quickly. Ability to use AI tools responsibly to improve efficiency, generate ideas, create documentation, and enhance customer experiences while applying sound business judgment. Working knowledge of enterprise software applications and services designed for the retail and consumer goods industries is highly valued (e.g., Nielsen, IRI, NPD, Dunnhumby). Expertise with one or more of Numerator's products is advantageous. Client travel may be required, typically one to two trips per quarter, though frequency may vary based on business needs.

As a Principal Survey Consultant on Numerator’s Research team, you’ll play a critical role in the successful project management, client management, and delivery of insights for our most advanced and strategic engagements (e.g. segmentations, trackers). As a coach/player role, this person will be the project lead, collaborating with clients, methodology and statistical experts, and the client account team. The Principal Survey Consultant will manage complex conversations regarding project design, analysis, interpretation, adoption, timelines, and challenges with the client.

What You'll Do

Lead and provide senior-level guidance and executive-level consulting to the client and project team to drive the successful implementation of Numerator’s advanced strategic research projects (e.g. segmentations, trackers) and ensure excellence throughout the project experience Accountable for overall project outcomes, including final ownership of output quality and delivery of strategic activation workshopsHands-on project responsibilities include: leading key client calls and directing client communications; driving direction and strategy of questionnaire; leading deliverable creation process / story / design; driving project management with client and internally; giving final presentation and leading any workshops; delegating work to the appropriate level within the project teamUnderstand client’s strategic business and research needs; ensure project success by working toward an optimal outcome for both the client and NumeratorDemonstrate and provide consultation on research design and delivery best practices across multiple forms of advanced research analytics both within the team and with clients directlyCollaborate with clients and our methodology experts/statisticians and direct the dedicated account team to enable project success, with a goal of continued Numerator-Client partnershipMaintain knowledge of Numerator’s Insights panel data and platform functionality, in order to partner for successful integration with panel data or transition of a project to the panel consulting team

rows.title: Regional Director, News (MENA)
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

JOB BAND: Senior Leader

CONTRACT TYPE: Permanent, Full-time

DEPARTMENT: BBC News

LOCATION: London

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

BBC News is the world’s most trusted news provider, committed to delivering independent and impartial news in an increasingly polarized world. We are embarking on a transformative journey to enhance our global reach, and develop our organisational structure to engage more with regional audiences.

WHY JOIN THE TEAM

As Regional Director, you will be responsible for editorial accountability and oversight for the Middle East and North Africa region and multiple language services. You will be empowered to develop and deliver the regional contribution to BBC News' strategic priorities. This is a critical role responsible for leading BBC News for an audience of 65m people weekly through Arabic, Persian, and Turkish language services and English on various platforms, including via emergency radio programming to reach audiences in Gaza, Yemen and Sudan.

Your Key Responsibilities

Act as BBC News Representative: Represent BBC News as the most senior representative in your region, engaging with regulatory regional stakeholders and broadcast and digital partners.Provide Leadership: Offer creative, inspirational leadership and editorial vision to enhance the quality of output in line with BBC News' strategic priorities. Work collaboratively with areas of Global Directorate and BBC News to reduce duplication and share skills and support where appropriateDevelop a Regional Growth Plan: Set the editorial strategy and delivery plan for your region.Direct Journalism Production: Oversee the resources, commissioning, production and output of all journalism in your region, including all relevant language services, to enhance reputation and reach and provide value for money.Manage Regional Budget: Oversee the allocated regional budget, ensuring effective strategic spend and ongoing cost efficiencies.Contribute to Governance: Participate in divisional and wider BBC Senior Leader governance, influencing the strategic direction of BBC News. 

Essential Criteria

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Skills

To succeed in this role you will need to be a senior level editorial and business leader with the following knowledge, skills, training & experience:

Regional Knowledge - clear understanding of local markets and ideally some, if not all, of the languages serviced.Editorial Leadership - strong editorial and journalistic skills through understanding of how editorial outputs are commissioned, financed, produced, and regulated. Able to prioritise and oversee the management of multiple high-risk stories in a newsroom environment including breaking news and deployments.Global Mindset - able to adjust to different environments and cultures internationally.

DESIRABLE CRITERIA

Language skills - speaking Arabic fluently would be preferable

JOB IMPACT

Determine how the region will deliver the regional growth plan and drive strategic priorities in a critical market where media freedom is under pressure. Undertake a wide range of activities requiring complex analytics and decision-making.Lead the development of innovative solutions to facilitate BBC News' expansion into new directions or audience bases.Manage local language editorial teams and regional operational teams.Hold accountability for all editorial output for local audiences, operational performance, safety, and compliance.Build targeted regional partnerships and develop regionalized commercial strategies.Apply local insight and sector knowledge to understand the strengths and weaknesses of BBC News' services.Provide significant input to World Service Group and News & Current Affairs strategy.Develop clear editorial growth strategies for diverse and complex regions.Serve as the most senior role in the region and face-to-market for all key regional stakeholders, inclusive of government. 

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths- including language skills - we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply.

Disclaimer

This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job, with its principal accountabilities, incorporating a note of the skills, knowledge and experience required for a satisfactory level of performance. This is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved.

Please note: If you were to be offered this role, the BBC will conduct Employment screening checks which include Reference checks; Eligibility to work checks; and if applicable to the role, Safeguarding and Adverse media/Social media checks. Any offer made is conditional on these checks being satisfactory.

Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Recruitment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

For any general queries, please contact: bbchr@bbc.co.uk

We are unable to accept applications via CV and only applications made online will be considered. Please click on the APPLY NOW button to proceed with your application.
