Description

Why DAZN?
DAZN brings live sport to millions of fans around the world the biggest leagues in football, boxing, motorsport, NFL, hundreds of competitions, every week. Our Product team plays a central role in deciding what we build, why, and in what order from a fan's first visit, through signing up and paying, to watching on match day and staying connected to their sport in between.

We're making DAZN the Home of Sports. A product that works flawlessly and gets to know each fan better every time they use it. We're doing it fast, and you'll help shape it for millions of people.


The role
As a Senior Product Manager you'll own a significant part of the DAZN experience and the outcomes that come with it. You'll be given a goal a customer pain point, a commercial target, a KPI to move and you'll find the opportunities and decide which ones matter. From there you'll work with Engineering and Design to build the solution, launch it, and use data to show whether it worked.

You'll work quickly and with a bias for action, alongside Engineering, Design and Commercial teams, bringing local customer needs together with DAZN's global product strategy. You'll also be a senior voice in the product team mentoring other PMs, setting the standard for how we work, and helping build the culture we want. You'll report to the lead of one of our outcome-led verticals.

What You'll Be Doing:

Owning an outcome, not just a feature: the discovery, definition and delivery of a wider area of the product, and the KPIs that tell us whether it's working.Identifying opportunities before anyone asks from data, customer research, commercial conversations and what's happening in the market and building the case for the ones worth doing.Turning goals into clear problems, and problems into requirements, prototypes and success measures your engineers and designers can act on.Using data, experiments, A/B tests and customer feedback to decide what to build and to prove what it delivered.Understanding the commercial side of your decisions subscribers, revenue, cost and explaining the trade-offs plainly to leadership.Keeping the whole customer journey in view, not just your area. A change in one place shows up somewhere else, and the fan only sees one DAZN.Working daily with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, Legal, Customer Service and Operations, and representing the customer in those conversations.Building AI and personalisation into the product you own recommendations, content, journeys where it makes the experience better for the fan.Using AI in how you do the job, and showing other PMs how: prototyping before you write a ticket, analysing data, drafting specs and updates, testing assumptions faster. This is expected of every PM here, not a specialist AI role.


What You'll Bring:

Around 5 years in product management, ideally in streaming, consumer technology, media or e-commerce at scale.A track record of owning an area of a product and the outcomes behind it, not just delivering features.Experience finding and shaping opportunities yourself you don't need a problem handed to you.Comfortable with analytics, A/B testing and customer research you can find your own answers in the data.Already using AI tools day to day to prototype, analyse, write and test ideas and able to show us examples.Structured thinking and good judgement about priorities when everything looks important..Able to build working relationships quickly you'll work with a range of engineering and design teams, and getting the best out of each one is part of the job.Customer-focused and commercially minded, with the appetite to take ownership and help others do the same.Interest in sport helps, but caring about the customer matters more.


Benefits

Benefits include access to DAZN, 25 days’ annual leave (increasing by 3 days after 3 years), private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions up to 5%, family friendly community including enhanced parental leave, electric vehicle benefit option, learning and development resources, opportunity for flexible working, and access to our internal speaker series and events.

rows.title: Accounts Payable Ledger Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Business Area: Finance and AccountingContract Type: Fixed Term Full TimeSalary: £28,000 - £32,000Workplace: MediaCity, Manchester + Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)Closing Date: 21st October 2026
The team..The Accounts Payable team operates at the heart of our Finance Operations hub, taking responsibility for managing our supplier payment obligations and maintaining clean, accurate ledgers. We are a data-driven, continuous-improvement-focused function dedicated to driving payment-on-time performance and building strong relationships with our third-party vendors. Working collaboratively with Purchasing Support, Master Data, Payments, and our Global Process Owner, we take pride in eliminating recurring errors, ensuring robust compliance, and maintaining seamless end-to-end P2P processes.
The role..We’re looking for an Accounts Payable Ledger Specialist to join our team on a fixed term contract basis until November 2027. Reporting directly to the Accounts Payable Manager, you will be responsible for managing the company's accounts payable ledger to ensure invoices are accurately processed, payments are made on time, and vendor accounts are properly maintained.
In this analytical and collaborative role, you will reconcile large volumes of data, resolve discrepancies, and act as the primary point of contact for complex supplier inquiries. Beyond ledger maintenance, you will be a root-cause investigator—detecting payment errors, managing GRNI open balances, analysing trend data, and partnering with internal teams and suppliers to drive continuous improvements that enhance right-first-time processing.
Some of your key day to day responsibilities will include:Serving as the primary contact for supplier and internal business invoice inquiries, delivering fast and definitive resolutions.Reconciling supplier statements and investigating payment delays or discrepancies with a focus on stopping recurring errors.Reviewing GRNI open balances, requesting missing invoices, processing correction transactions, and requesting payment refunds when required.Detecting and recording payment errors (e.g., failed or duplicate payments), taking remediation action, and providing root-cause feedback to Processing and Master Data teams.Generating payable reports, ageing schedules, and outstanding balance analyses to actively drive down overdue invoice volumes and close month-end ledgers on time.Assisting with internal and external audits by providing requested documentation, data analytics, and reporting.Partnering with the Global Process Owner to identify, design, and implement continuous process improvements.Providing factual trend analysis data to AP and Compliance teams to highlight knowledge gaps and drive Purchase Order (PO) compliance.Maintaining team Standard Operating Process (SOP) notes and supporting the onboarding and training of new team members.
Skills you’ll need (minimum criteria)Significant experience working within an Accounts Payable team, backed by a strong understanding of core accounting principles and end-to-end AP workflows.Essential working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables are essential) alongside experience with accounting software like Oracle or SAP.Proven evidence of analysing, manipulating, presenting, and improving data for management and operational business teams.Demonstrated strong competency in root-cause problem solving with a continuous improvement mindset.Preferred experience working within a Shared Service Center (SSC) or Global Business Services (GBS) environment.
Other things we’re looking for (key criteria)Experience working with Finance ERP systems, with Oracle Fusion being a distinct advantage.Excellent proficiency across Google Workspace / Microsoft Office tools (Word/Docs, Spreadsheets/Sheets, Slides).Proven ability to adapt flexibly as required, navigate complex processes, and hit stretched targets.Excellent communication skills to explain root-cause findings, highlight trends, and present process improvement recommendations clearly.Strong organisational skills, high attention to detail, and sound awareness of risk and fraud controls.
Potential ChallengesMinimum of two office days per week required on Wednesday and Thursday, with occasional increases depending on meetings, training, or ad-hoc operational needs.

Please note, on occasion we may receive a very large volume of applications which means applications for a role may close earlier than the referenced closing date. We’d encourage you to apply as soon as possible if interested.

rows.title: Journalist - Southampton - EXTEND
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

JOB BAND: C

CONTRACT TYPE: Fixed-term Contract, Full-time unitl 1 August 2027

DEPARTMENT: BBC Nations, BBC South

LOCATION: Southampton

PROPOSED SALARY RANGE: £28,000 - £34,000 depending on relevant skills, knowledge and experience. The expected salary range for this role reflects internal benchmarking and external market insights.

We're happy to discuss flexible working. If you'd like to, please indicate your preference in the application – though there's no obligation to do so now. Flexible working will be part of the discussion at offer stage.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

BBC South is looking for a journalist to help develop its social media and digital video content for across our whole patch: Hampshire, Dorset, Oxfordshire and Berkshire. We already have some highly successful social media platforms in BBC Local; they’re vital to reach and interact with people who don’t get their local news from broadcast media. We know our social media and digital video strategy is working, and we’re looking for someone to continue to create even more engaging content that people expect on social media, and as digital video on the BBC website.

WHY JOIN THE TEAM

Discovering stories from social media is a key part of this job. Using social listening tools to find the issues that matter most to local audiences - and have the creative vision needed to turn them into content audiences love to read, watch and share.

The content you produce will go on our online and social platforms, with the scope to be picked up by TV and radio and BBC News’s social platforms too.

You’ll know how to make great original digital content for online and socials and turn daily radio and TV content into engaging social formats.

Please contact social media lead Jessica Banham at Jessica.Banham@bbc.co.uk for more information on the role.

Your Key Responsibilities And Impact

Using social listening tools to find the issues that matter most to local audiences and a nose for identifying which stories have the potential to translate to digital audiencesFilm and edit engaging high-impact content across multiple platformsYou’ll be confident at pitching new ideas and creative treatments and be able to come up with a constant stream of original storiesYou’ll also be happy assisting other reporters in the newsroom on how to produce scripts and video edits for social media audiencesBe able to work under pressure in a busy newsroom where you may be expected to rapidly turn around material without much notice

Essential Criteria

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Demonstrable experience identifying, sourcing and developing stories through social media and social listening, with a strong understanding of local audience interests and platform trends.Strong knowledge of social media consumption habits and audience expectations across different platforms, with the ability to identify stories that will resonate and perform well.Experience using audience analytics and performance data to inform content decisions, measure impact and continually improve output.Proven ability to film and edit compelling short-form video content using a range of equipment (including Mojo kits, Osmo cameras or similar) and editing software such as Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent.Experience working in a fast-paced news environment, collaborating effectively within a team to deliver high-quality content to tight deadlines, while maintaining a strong understanding of media law and BBC Editorial Guidelines.

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply.

Disclaimer

This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job, with its principal accountabilities, incorporating a note of the skills, knowledge and experience required for a satisfactory level of performance. This is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved.

Please note: If you were to be offered this role, the BBC will conduct Employment screening checks which include Reference checks; Eligibility to work checks; and if applicable to the role, Safeguarding and Adverse media/Social media checks. Any offer made is conditional on these checks being satisfactory.

Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Recruitment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

For any general queries, please contact: bbchr@bbc.co.uk

We are unable to accept applications via CV and only applications made online will be considered. Please click on the APPLY NOW button to proceed with your application.

Redeployment

The BBC is committed to redeploying employees seeking suitable alternative employment within the BBC and they will be given priority consideration ahead of other applicants. Priority consideration means for those employees seeking redeployment their application will be considered alongside anyone else at risk of redundancy, prior to any individuals being considered who are not at risk.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer, Audible AI Voice Production
rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Software Engineer it’s up to you to research, define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll be essential in ensuring the team can reach their potential; working closely with them, reviewing their work, mentoring, and supporting them to develop. Together, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice.

About You

You are a curious, innovative and entrepreneurial software engineer who loves to tinker and stay on top of tools, trends, technologies and best practices. You equally enjoy working on fast-paced projects that require doing a little bit of homework. You embrace ambiguity and aren’t afraid of changing directions if something isn’t working out. You love challenges and don’t give up easily. You celebrate failure, learn and move on. You are hungry to learn more about how Audible operates across cross-functional teams outside of engineering. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others to grow, whether giving tech talks and/or writing technical articles and documentation. Others often come to you for ideas or technical guidance.

You feel pride in every step forward, however big, or small; to you, each challenge represents a well-executed venture to support our listeners. If you’re looking to build on your skills and grow into a leader, this is your next step. We look for people who take responsibility, set their standards high and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. You’re looking for an environment where you can thrive. With opportunities to challenge yourself and a talented team by your side, you’ll find what you’re looking for at Audible.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will...

 Independently lead complex technical initiatives within your team Mentor and lead developers by cultivating curiosity and deep technical understanding Explore technical needs and bring solutions to the table Set the technical strategy for your team Collaborate with stakeholders to imagine, design, develop, test, and launch scalable and maintainable software that impacts our customers and inspires your peers Independently clarify technical requirements, assessing development estimates and apply a broad range of design approaches Drive continuous improvement of software quality, customer experience, and maintainability of products/features Stay on top of technology trends, tools, and approaches

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 4+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience 4+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. rows.title: Senior Business Development Manager
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  About the TeamThe Roku TV & Licensing team is looking for a Senior Business Development Manager with a deep understanding and experience in the TV industry to work closely with our Roku TV partners (factories, brand licensees, OEM/ODM) and Roku's cross-functional teams to analyze and make recommendations for engagement with new partners to integrate Roku's Operating System. This person will support the Roku TV teams by helping to manage new and ongoing programs at these partners.  About the Role We are looking for a motivated individual to utilize your experience & skillset to understand and present the Roku OS and reference designs to key partners to drive adoption. Your partner management experience will help you identify and communicate program and business requirements to partners and field product features requests back into Roku. In this role you will be required to review and contribute to global business planning and product requirement documents which align & support Roku initiatives and our partners’ goals, objectives and timelines. The work we do can be challenging but impactful and that's why we enjoy it so much. The ideal candidate isn't a bystander. They are curious and engaged, willing to jump in to solve problems and make data-driven decisions even when things feel very ambiguous. Our industry changes quickly, so we expect a great candidate to be comfortable responding quickly to changing business needs, knowing that their own success comes when the company and larger team succeeds. What you'll be doing Manage business relationships with partners that are located throughout the Americas including Central America and BrazilFacilitate discussions between Roku's teams and current and potential new partners & factoriesWork with partners to establish short term programs and long-term relationships to embed Roku's OS in their productsCollect, analyze and present the partner's requirements to Roku's cross functional teams and work to create legal agreementsCoordinate with Roku's cross functional teams on new partnership engagementsSupport program kick-off meetings and development efforts with partners & factoriesWork with factories to ensure programs are running as plannedWork with partners on timely reporting and tracking of products with the Roku OS embeddedOrganize and lead quarterly business and technical reviewsAdvocate product issues on behalf of the partners within Roku and influence internal teams to resolve the issues in a timely mannerConduct market & product research to determine industry requirements & opportunitiesResearch, analyze and report current market conditions for strategic considerationProvide industry analysis. Identify competitive threats and create actionable reporting We're excited if you have Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or related discipline required Business development &/or partner management background with clear understanding of Consumer Electronics (CE) products and industry experience focused on TV, Audio, streaming devicesUnderstand Operating Systems, SW architecture and HW reference designsExcellent knowledge of TV and Audio industry and supporting technologiesOutstanding partner management skills, leveraging your strong business acumen and technical backgroundExperience working with ODM/OEMs and using data analytics & reporting to drive business decisions10+ years working with CE partners, focused on Latin American marketsExcellent verbal, presentation, and written communication skills in English required Fluency in Spanish & Portuguese preferredAbility and willingness to travel as needed     What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

rows.title: Lead Customer Journey Manager - Data & AI Transformation
rows.descriptionText:
End Date

Wednesday 07 October 2026

Salary Range

£0 - £0

We support flexible working – click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Flexibility in when hours are worked, Hybrid Working, Job Share

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Job Title: Lead Customer Journey Manager – Data & AI Transformation

Location: Bristol

Hours: Full time

Working Pattern: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of your time, at our Bristol office.

About This Opportunity

We're on a mission to transform how we use data across our Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) division. As part of our CIB Data Labs team, you'll work in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment that brings together architecture, engineering and business communities. You'll play a key role in driving innovation and delivering impactful solutions that make a real difference to our customers.

As a Lead Customer Journey Manager, you'll play a critical role in product development, working with Product Owners and multidisciplinary teams to understand, measure and orchestrate end-to-end client and colleague journeys. You'll combine strong customer journey expertise with an understanding of processes, systems, data flows and integration points to translate customer, business and regulatory needs into data and technology-enabled solutions. You'll find opportunities to simplify processes, remove inefficiencies and improve outcomes through the effective use of Data, Analytics and AI.

Working across Product, CTO, CDAIO, Commercial Architecture, Data and Operations, you'll ensure journey intent, process design, data requirements and AI solutions remain aligned. Acting as the bridge between business and technology, you'll shape prioritisation decisions, orchestrate delivery across functional boundaries and ensure design choices deliver scalable, efficient, compliant and measurable outcomes.

You'll also promote effective data stewardship, ensuring the data required to support journeys and Data & AI use cases is clearly defined, understood, governed and connected to authoritative sources and strategic data products.

This is your chance to lead the migration of our data capabilities to the cloud, build trusted data foundations and unlock the potential of AI across our business.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead the definition and optimisation of end-to-end client and colleague journeys, identifying where Data, Analytics and AI can improve decision-making, customer outcomes, operational efficiency and business performance.Translate business, customer and regulatory requirements into Data, Analytics and AI use cases, ensuring priorities are aligned to strategic business outcomes and measurable value.Define and maintain journey, process, data and integration maps, creating a single view of business processes, data flows, systems, controls and dependencies required to enable transformation.Partner with Product, CTO, CDAIO and Operations teams to understand shared Data & AI capabilities, data flows and dependencies, ensuring solutions are scalable, achievable and aligned to customer needs.Shape functional and non-functional data requirements, identifying critical business entities, attributes, metrics and data products required to support customer journeys, reporting, analytics and AI capabilities.Embed effective data stewardship practices, ensuring data ownership, definitions, quality standards, lineage, controls and regulatory obligations are understood, governed and consistently applied across journeys and products.Partner with Platform Leads, Data Product Owners, Engineers, Architects and AI specialists to ensure business needs and data requirements are translated into scalable, compliant and technology-enabled solutions.Use customer, operational and data insights to identify improvement opportunities, risks and actions, driving prioritisation decisions and continuous enhancement of Data, Analytics and AI capabilities.Orchestrate cross-functional delivery across business, operations, technology, risk and data teams, ensuring strategic Data & AI initiatives are aligned, dependencies are managed and intended customer and business outcomes are realised.

What You'll Need

You'll be able to demonstrate experience across the following areas:

Customer Journey, Data & AI Transformation

Significant experience leading complex, end-to-end client or colleague journey transformation, using Data, Analytics and AI to deliver measurable improvements in customer outcomes, operational performance and business value.Proven ability to translate customer, business and regulatory needs into prioritised use cases and technology-enabled solutions, influencing product strategy, roadmaps and investment decisions.

Data Stewardship & Data Products

Strong data stewardship expertise, including the definition and application of data ownership, business terminology, critical data elements, quality standards, lineage, controls and regulatory obligations.Experience connecting journey and business requirements to authoritative data sources and strategic data products, ensuring data is trusted, reusable and fit for operational, analytical and AI-enabled use.

Analysis, Insight & Prioritisation

Strong strategic and analytical judgement, integrating customer insight, operational performance and data evidence to identify root causes, assess opportunities and shape outcome-led priorities.Ability to evaluate the feasibility, value and end-to-end impact of Data & AI propositions, balancing customer benefit, commercial value, control requirements and delivery viability.

Product & Technology Collaboration

Extensive experience working with Product Owners and multidisciplinary teams to shape propositions, influence backlogs and ensure journey, process, data and technology decisions deliver the intended outcomes.Strong understanding of business processes, system capabilities, data flows and integration points, translating complexity into clear requirements, design choices and delivery implications.

Stakeholder Leadership & Orchestration

Communication & Continuous Improvement

rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Principal Engineer - AI Productivity Lab 
 Salary: £84624- £105,780 depending on location and experience 
Location: Bristol, Edinburgh, Leeds or Manchester 
Working Pattern: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of our time, at our office location.  About this Opportunity 
 We are looking for Principal Engineers to join our new AI Productivity Lab. The purpose of the Lab is to accelerate internal AI-driven employee productivity and process automation using the latest agentic co-working technologies. 
 You will provide hands-on technical leadership for building domain-specific agents and tooling, and for developing internal knowledge and skills repositories that enable safe, repeatable automation aligned to business area operating procedures. 

Working with the Head of the Lab, you will execute agentic coworking initiatives with targeted business areas, partnering with line-of-business champions to embed agents into team processes, SOPs and tooling and to realise and measure benefits. 
 You will be working within the Data & AI Team of the Chief Technology Office (CTO), where we define and lead the Group's Data and AI technology strategy, serve as the Group's design authority for Data and AI, and inspire, develop and incubate new AI-driven products, capabilities and ways of working through applied research and product discovery.  Day to day, you will: Lead the engineering of coworking solutions (agents, tools and automations) for priority business areas, taking designs from prototype to operational MVP.Design and build reusable capabilities for the Lab's coworking platform and repository (skills, tools and operating procedure assets) with a clear path to adoption.Apply hands-on experience of agentic coding and/or coworking tools and the open-source ecosystem to evaluate options, recommend approaches and accelerate delivery.Partner with business stakeholders and line-of-business champions to shape use cases, embed solutions into SOPs and measure outcomes. Coach and mentor engineers through technical leadership, code review and constructive feedback, and engage senior stakeholders on technical direction. Why Lloyds Banking Group 
 If you think all banks are the same, you'd be wrong. We're an innovative, fast-changing business that's shaping finance as a force for good. A bank that's empowering its people to innovate, explore possibilities and grow with purpose.  What you'll need Proven experience leading the delivery of technology solutions to business areas in complex production environments, with ownership of business outcomes. Extensive knowledge and hands-on experience of solutions architecture, software engineering and business process automation. Strong hands-on experience with agentic coding and/or coworking technology and ecosystem (e.g. Claude Code and/or Cowork, OpenClaw, GitHub Copilot).Strong understanding of operational processes and risk management (Financial Services preferred).Ability to influence stakeholders and guide teams through ambiguity, translating productivity opportunities into clear technical direction and MVPs.
 Desirable: Expertise in knowledge management, enterprise ontology and knowledge graph technology.Business process optimisation experience (e.g. Business Process Modelling, Lean Six Sigma).Experience with applied research / experimentation.Advanced degree (MSc, PhD) in computer science, artificial intelligence or a related subject. About working for us 
 Our focus is to ensure we're inclusive every day, building an organisation that reflects modern society and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We want our people to feel that they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity or culture.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package and a dedicated Working with Cancer initiative. And it's why we especially welcome applications from under-represented groups. We're disability confident. So if you'd like reasonable adjustments to be made to our recruitment processes, just let us know. 
 We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes: A generous pension contribution of up to 15% An annual performance-related bonus Share schemes including free shares Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping 30 days' holiday, with bank holidays on top A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies Ready for a career where you can have a positive impact as you learn, grow and thrive? Apply today and find out more.

rows.title: Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

This role is for Angstrom Sports, a proprietary sports pricing and product provider, building intricate, simulation driven pricing and risk systems to support the success of key sports brands across the Entain group.

Founded in 2018 and having established itself as a pioneer in player-level, play-by-play simulations and forecasting, Angstrom was acquired by Entain in 2023. Today, we are responsible for delivering the group’s most advanced pricing and risk capabilities with a focus on the US market. We’re committed to building the next generation of sports betting products - sports-first, recreationally-focused, and designed to make betting more engaging, more intelligent, and more fun.

We’re proud to be a high-performing, low-ego team where brilliant people are empowered and people work to become brilliant. While we’re ambitious and delivery-driven, we take real pride in how we operate and the health of our independent culture, underpinned by mutual trust and respect.

Job Description

The purpose of the Data Engineer is to implement and maintain data infrastructure that facilitates data-driven decision making, innovation and operational efficiency while ensuring that the data pipeline is secure, reliable, and scalable. The role holder will build and maintain high-performance data systems that are foundational to driving business growth and success.

The Key Responsibilities Will Include

Designing and implementing scalable data architectures and systems Developing and maintaining ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines. Managing data storage, backup, and recovery mechanisms Writing SQL queries to extract data for analysis.  Developing and implementing data security and privacy Interfacing with clients and end users to receive guidance on projects and deliverables.

Qualifications

Essential:

Proficient in writing clean, efficient, and maintainable SQL and Python code, particularly for data transformation and analytics use cases Understanding of data modelling concepts and be able to design data models that are optimised for different user cases. Familiarity with SQL and experience (2+ year) working with and designing relational databases. Experience (1+ year) implementing data pipelines that run on Kafka or equivalent distributed event store and stream processing platforms. Ability to debug and optimize failing or slow data pipelines and queries. Systems integration experience (1+ years): networking, data migrations, API integration and design. Enthusiasm for clean systems, including documentation, logging, and reproducibility. Experience (2+ year) working with AWS S3, Athena, ECS, Cloud Formation, Lambdas & Cloudwatch. Excellent presentation, documentation, time management, communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively and autonomously. Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic and analytical outlook.

Desirable

Familiar with analytics tools such as Power BI, Apache Superset, or similar for building interactive and impactful visualizations Familiarity with distributed systems (e.g., Spark, Kafka) and how they support scalable analytics solutions Passion for TDD A love of sports Able to troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the Data Engineering process and be able to find effective solutions. Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and be able to work effectively with cross functional teams. A side project that illustrates the individual has thought about solution architecture from start to finish

Additional Information

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

rows.title: Account Representative, Uber Eats, UK - South Asian Restaurant Specialist (Tamil Speaker)
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

As a South Asian Restaurant Specialist Account Executive for Uber Eats, you will drive marketplace growth by acquiring independent South Asian restaurant partners onto the platform. You will use your language skills, understanding of the restaurant market and relationship-building skills to build trust with merchants over the phone, managing the full outbound sales cycle from prospecting through to closed partnership.

This is a specialist inside sales role within a fast-paced SMB sales team. You will succeed by mastering your pipeline, leveraging data to drive territory growth, and using your language capability to reach and engage merchants who are harder to acquire through traditional sales channels.

What You'll Do

Specialist Outbound Activity: Drive a high volume of daily cold calling, using your target language where relevant to build trust and engage merchants, while consistently progressing deals through every stage of the sales cycle.Territory Ownership: Execute a structured operational plan to hit acquisition quotas. Map market data and local business intelligence to identify high-value targets within South Asian cuisine categories.Rigorous Data and Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain accurate data in CRM with diligent follow-ups, detailed meeting notes, and clear next steps. Monitor dashboards to ensure consistent engagement, preventing deals from becoming inactive.Account Management and Partner Optimisation: Act as a strategic partner to merchants during and post-onboarding; evaluate business impact, manage initial partner health, and use upsell frameworks to introduce additional Uber products that maximise mutual value.Forecasting and Reporting: Partner with leadership to review pipeline health, deliver accurate performance forecasting, and maintain complete business visibility.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with internal teams to streamline the merchant launch experience. Share insights on objection patterns, merchant needs and what works to help shape our approach to underserved cuisine categories.

Basic Qualifications 

Language Capability: Fluency in English & TamilExperience and Track Record: Sales or business development experience in an outbound or target-driven environment with a track record of hitting or exceeding targets.Sales Cycle Capability: Proven ability to manage the full end-to-end cycle, from proactive prospecting to identifying needs, negotiating commercial structures, and transitioning relationships into early-stage account management.Soft Skills and Drive: Excellent communication, active listening, and presentation skills. Must be a resourceful problem-solver who can overcome objections with creative perseverance in a fast-paced environment.Product Expertise: Confidently handle routine product questions and platform objections by demonstrating deep marketplace expertise.Deal Structuring: Propose basic commercial deal structures and follow existing upsell frameworks to maximise the mutual value of the partnership from day one.Relationship Building: Ability to build trust quickly with independent business owners and adapt your communication style to different merchants.

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience in the food delivery, hospitality, or e-commerce marketplace industries.Extraordinary listening and communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style to a wide variety of audiences.A resourceful and persistent attitude, with a relentless drive to achieve goals and overcome objections.Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.Proven track record of meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. rows.title: Head of Architecture
rows.descriptionText:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

Location: London (Hybrid) 

Reporting to: Group Engineering Director

The role

As Head of Architecture at Rightmove, you'll shape our technology strategy and help turn our mission, "to give everyone the belief they can make their move", into a well-designed, scalable technology estate.

You'll guide how we evolve a broad set of systems, from in-house software to third-party solutions, within a modern, containerised, event-driven architecture. You will be at the forefront of Rightmove’s journey into AI as it transforms not just the software we build but the way we build it. It's a chance to influence the technical direction of the UK's leading property portal, with real impact on millions of home movers.

Key responsibilities

In Your First Year, You'll Focus On

Setting architecture strategy - Build and drive a company-wide architecture strategy that supports our broader business goals. Enabling engineering teams - Work closely with the software engineering community so the strategy is understood and all 40+ teams can make good architectural decisions quickly, without unnecessary process or delay. Leading the architecture team - Manage and develop a team of seven architects who influence and advise on design across the organisation. Partnering with data - Support the data and analytics department so our data platform architecture aligns with the wider platform architecture. 

Ongoing Responsibilities Also Include

Overseeing a varied technology landscape of in-house software and third-party applications to create a cohesive ecosystem. Work with technology and product leaders to connect architecture decisions to business objectives. Influencing TCO by aligning architectural decisions with business outcomes in the most efficient and cost-effective way. 

What You'll Need

Experience leading architecture at scale (team or organisation size can vary; we care about the complexity and impact of what you've led) A solid grasp of modern distributed architectures; containerisation, event-driven systems, and the trade-offs between availability and consistency. Ability to set clear architectural direction across a high-traffic, high-change environment as it adjusts to an AI-enabled future. Experience managing and developing an architecture or engineering team.Strong communication skills, with a track record of working across engineering, product, and senior leadership to align technical and business priorities.A track record of building inclusive, collaborative engineering cultures through mentoring, team design and influence. 

Nice to have

An understanding of how to drive architectural change in a DevOps environment that makes over a thousand production changes a month. Experience in property, marketplaces, e-commerce, or other high-traffic consumer platforms. 

Life at Rightmove

Despite Our Growth, We’ve Remained a Friendly, Supportive Place To Work, With Employee #1 Still Working Here! We’ve Done This By Placing The Rightmove Hows At The Heart Of Everything We Do. These Are The Essential Values That Reflect Our Culture, And Include

We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.



We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right!

Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.Contributory stakeholder pension.Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.Competitive compensation package.Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. 

At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.

By applying, you confirm that you are aged at least 18 or over and that you’ve read and understood our Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle and protect your personal information during the recruitment process.

rows.title: Group Data Management Strategy & Transformation Senior Analyst

You will work closely with senior stakeholders across business, technology, risk and change teams, using data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making, solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes.

We’re looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded individual who can combine strategic thinking with practical delivery. You’ll be confident working with complex data, navigating ambiguity, managing stakeholders and translating insight into clear actions that support business priorities.

To be successful as a Group Data Management Strategy & Transformation Senior Analyst, you must have the following essential skills:

Experience working with data management platforms, data governance or data strategy.Exposure to financial services, risk, controls or regulatory environments.

This role has the option to work from either Glasgow or Knutsford.

To develop, implement, and maintain effective governance frameworks for all data and records across the bank's global operations.

Accountabilities

To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
As a Senior AI Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and implementing intelligent software solutions that drive innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver measurable business value. You will work closely with AI Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Product teams, and Engineering colleagues to build scalable, secure, and production-ready AI systems and applications.

You will have strong knowledge of Generative AI, AI-assisted code generation, automated testing, code review acceleration, agentic workflows, and development process optimisation. This role involves providing technical leadership, engineering expertise, and tooling oversight across the software delivery lifecycle, helping teams apply AI responsibly to modernise platforms, improve code quality, streamline delivery, and enhance developer experience across cloud platforms and technology products.

To be successful as a Senior AI Software Engineer, you should possess:

rows.title: Assistant Sales Manager, GTS Energy & Materials
rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Assistant Sales Manager, GTS Energy & Materials.

You will be reporting to the Regional Head of Energy & Materials (E&M), GTS and supporting other Sales Managers in the team. You’ll have regular client engagement and communication with internal stakeholders to make sure client requests are dealt with in an appropriate fashion. You will be involved in the preparation of numerous documents, both internal (e.g. credit applications, annual reviews, client plannings, etc.) and external (e.g. client pitches, term sheets, responses to RFP’s).

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In This Role You’ll

 Provide support and assistance to Senior Sales Managers with day-to-day client engagement, profitability calculation, call reports and other ad hoc tasks  Draft credit memos or annual reviews in relation to structured transactions  Join client calls along with the opportunity to lead some calls as when ready under the supervision of the Senior Sales Manager  Engage with Middle-Office, Client Services and Operations teams to ensure client queries and service delivery are actioned efficiently  Engage with internal stakeholders such as relationship bankers, portfolio management, credit, legal, compliance, tax etc.  Review legal documentations in relation to financings (vanilla as well as structured finance transactions)  Develop expertise to help Senior Sales Managers drive and deliver as per HSBC’s strategies and growth initiatives  Conduct sales performance analytics - using CRM systems such as CME and income reporting tools such as Omnia to understand the revenue stream of the business and identify trends. This includes the identification of missing fees/charges and the coordination of action to rectify 

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:

 Knowledge of global trade finance products and market solutions  Knowledge of broader commodity markets and participants  Strong interpersonal, communication, analytical, presentation and decision making skills  Good organisational skills with an ability to effectively prioritise and meet deadlines  Strong commercial orientation combined with a customer driven approach  Ability to work independently as and when required  Ability to interact with senior executives 

London office relocation: Between January and April 2027, many office-based HSBC employees in London will move from either 8 Canada Square or Queen Victoria Street to one of our new sites at St. Paul’s or Canary Wharf. Depending on when they join, successful candidates may start at an existing office before moving or join directly at a new location. The specific location cannot be confirmed at advert stage and will be discussed during the recruitment process. This does not apply to branch-based or HSBC Innovation Bank roles.

Opening up a world of opportunity.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com .

rows.title: IB Financial Crimes Investigations - AVP (Markets)
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as an IB Financial Crimes Investigations -AVP (Markets), where you’ll conduct in-depth reviews of trading activity and financial crime referrals across investment and correspondent banking. You’ll investigate potential fraud, misconduct, or unethical behavior that could harm the firm’s reputation. This role requires a strong understanding of AML, stock market operations, and regulatory risk. Your findings help protect the firm and ensure compliance with legal and regulatory standards.

To be successful as an IB Financial Crimes Investigations -AVP (Markets), you should have experience with:


Trade Surveillance and financial crime investigationsKnowledge of market activity, equities, bonds, and trading patternsAbility to conduct front-to-back transaction reviews


Other Highly Valued Skills Include


Skilled in drafting SARs for market-related referralsComfortable managing tight deadlines under pressureFamiliarity with AI systems


You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in Whippany, NJ.

Minimum Salary: $110,000

Maximum Salary: $135,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above includes only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

This position is eligible for an incentive award.

Purpose of the role

To conduct investigations into various aspects of the bank’s operations and/or conduct of individuals to identify and address potential instances of non-compliance, fraud, misconduct, or other unethical behaviour, that harms or is likely to harm the reputation or financial well-being of the firm or may lead to legal and/or regulatory censure.

Accountabilities

About The Team

The Deliverability team sits at the core of Uber's delivery marketplace as part of Merchant Optimization. Our mission is to transform mature, product-specific deliverability logic into a high-performance, highly scalable, and unified platform.

Serving as the critical gating layer for every Uber Eats transaction, our systems answer the fundamental real-time question: "Can this merchant deliver to this eater right now?" We evaluate this continuously across storefront browsing, checkout, and order creation globally.

We optimize merchant delivery zones to maximize platform selection while balancing reliability and profitability. The real-time decisions made by our Tier 1 backend services directly shape the selection breadth for key downstream platforms, including Search, Feed, and Ads.

Role & Responsibilities

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Deliverability team, you will:

 Architect Extensible APIs: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of core platform services.  Orchestrate High-Throughput Systems: Solve complex architecture challenges by designing robust workflow orchestration across deep, multi-tiered downstream service dependencies.  Drive Low-Latency Performance: Design and implement multi-layered, distributed caching strategies to minimize latency and optimize load across high-concurrency microservices.  Champion Observability & Reliability: Define key metrics and operational telemetry using dashboards (such as Grafana), and multi-tiered alerting to ensure mission-critical service availability across millions of daily orders.  Lead Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with product managers and engineering teams across Marketplace to establish technical standards, align on API contracts, and deliver high-impact technical roadmaps. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 3+ years of professional full-time software engineering experience building scalable backend platforms.  Strong proficiency in modern backend languages, preferably Go, Java, C++, or Python.  Deep understanding of high-throughput, low-latency microservice architectures, RESTful APIs, and gRPC/Protobuf protocols.  Hands-on expertise with advanced caching mechanisms, concurrency control, and distributed state management. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience designing workflow orchestration engines or managing intricate multi-service dependencies.  Familiarity with geospatial indexing systems, mapping, or geofencing libraries (e.g., H3, S2Cell).  Demonstrated expertise in telemetry, distributed tracing, performance monitoring, and managing high-concurrency production incidents.  Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives and deliver multi-phase engineering projects.  Exposure to large-scale data engineering pipelines or foundational machine learning concepts.

Our purpose – Opening up a world of opportunity – explains why we exist. Here at HSBC, we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth, and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers.  Ready to shape daily investment decisions across global high yield portfolios? 

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This role sits within HSBC Global Asset Management’s High Yield Portfolio Management team, supporting the day-to-day management of global, US high yield and high-income strategies. You’ll help translate strategy and credit-specific ideas into portfolios as part of the investment process, working closely with senior portfolio managers. The role spans execution, portfolio monitoring and coordination across trading, credit research, product specialists, and operations to keep accounts running smoothly. You’ll also take ownership of key data and documentation that supports investment decision-making and governance. Success looks like reliable execution, clear portfolio insights and well-supported decisions across high yield and income accounts.

 Execute and trade daily flows and manage cash in conjunction with the trading team  Monitor portfolio exposures and positioning against intended credit and macro views and adjust when needed  Implement strategy and credit-specific ideas into portfolios  Partner with credit research analysts on relative value, credit and sector positioning, and industry topics  Support Senior Portfolio Managers across high yield and income accounts and strategies  Manage regularly scheduled client reporting and respond to ad-hoc requests from internal stakeholders  Maintain dialogue with operations, performance, and other support teams to ensure smooth running of accounts 

What We're Looking For

 Bring proven experience supporting portfolio management for high yield and high-income fixed income strategies  Demonstrate hands-on capability executing trades, managing flows, and overseeing cash management in portfolios  Apply established understanding of global fixed income investment processes and related compliance requirements  Interpret portfolio exposures, positioning, and risk in the context of credit and macro views  Partner effectively with trading, credit research, product specialists, middle office operations, and other global teams  Own the organization, analysis and maintenance of investment data used in meetings and decision-making tools  Produce accurate client reporting and respond to time-sensitive stakeholder requests  Use Bloomberg and analytics tooling to strengthen workflow efficiency and investment decision support 

Strengthening High Yield Outcomes

If you want to help turn investment views into real portfolio positions at scale this role offers a front-row seat to the day-to-day running of global and US high yield strategies. You’ll work across portfolio management, trading and research while building a detailed understanding of how portfolios are governed and managed. The work is practical, hands-on, and closely connected to client outcomes through accurate reporting and reliable execution. Apply to help improve processes, enhance analytical capability, and support investment recommendations across the high yield platform.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

About The Team

The Applied AI team collaborates with product teams across Uber to deliver innovative AI solutions for core business problems. We work closely with engineering, product and data science teams to understand core business problems and the potential for AI solutions, then deliver those AI solutions end-to-end. Key areas of expertise include Personalization, Generative AI, Computer Vision, ML Optimization, Geospatial AI.

About The Role

We are building AI-native discovery experiences across Mobility and Delivery. Search, recommendations, and conversational AI are central to how millions of users discover rides, restaurants, grocery items, and retail products every day. We are hiring a Senior Staff ML Engineer to define the multi-year technical vision and architecture for foundation models powering these experiences.

The Uber Foundation Model would serve as the common semantic backbone that enables Uber to understand users, places, merchants, items, and behavioral patterns in a unified way. By building a shared representation layer and continuously improving it with cross-LOB signals, Uber ensures that intelligence compounds rather than fragments. This foundation powers personalization, search, agents, automation, and decision systems across Mobility, Delivery, and future surfaces.

At this level, you will set the long-term technical direction for the organization, drive alignment on product and engineering strategy at the executive level, and deliver step-change measurable impact at global scale.

 Define and champion the multi-year technical vision and architecture for foundation models across Search, Recommendations, and Conversational AI.  Masters degree or Ph.D in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics  12+ years of ML experience, including significant work on large-scale deep learning systems. rows.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Performance Market Experimentation
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity:

Chewy is looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Performance Marketing Experimentation to join our team in Seattle, WA or Boston, MA, reporting to the Associate Director, Performance Marketing.

As a Senior Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and operating approach for testing new ways to capture demand and acquire customers through performance marketing. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will identify the platforms, partners, and customer opportunities that are most important for Chewy to explore, develop a roadmap for experimentation, and turn promising ideas into measurable programs. The initial focus will include display and retargeting, as well as emerging advertising environments such as agentic commerce, but the scope will extend to other opportunities as the market and customer behavior evolve.

Customers are changing how they discover and choose products, and the advertising industry is changing with them. Many of the opportunities in this space do not yet have established audiences, measurement approaches, operating models, or playbooks. You will need to develop a point of view on where performance marketing is going, decide which platforms and partners are worth pursuing, and design experiments that help Chewy learn quickly without losing financial discipline. You will work across Marketing, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Creative, Merchandising, Finance, and external partners to shape solutions and determine what should be scaled.

What You’ll Do

Own the roadmap for performance marketing experimentation, identifying opportunities across display, retargeting, emerging advertising environments, and other customer acquisition channelsDevelop a point of view on changes in customer behavior, advertising technology, and the competitive landscape, and translate that perspective into clear recommendations about where Chewy should invest time and resourcesLead experiments from hypothesis through decision, including the business case, audience strategy, creative and customer experience, measurement approach, financial guardrails, and scale criteriaDevelop and test display and retargeting opportunities that can expand Chewy’s ability to reach and convert high-intent customersLead exploration of emerging advertising environments, including agentic commerce, by ensuring platform readiness, defining use cases, and establishing a clear path from pilot to scalePartner with Creative, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Merchandising, Finance, and other Marketing teams to develop solutions that account for customer needs, technical requirements, and business prioritiesEstablish senior relationships with third-party platforms, publishers, and technology partners, influencing how they design advertising products, measurement solutions, data access, and integrations for ChewyDefine the testing standards and decision frameworks used to evaluate new opportunities, including incrementality, customer acquisition efficiency, reach, frequency, and downstream business impactMake recommendations about which opportunities to scale, refine, or stop, based on evidence and a clear understanding of both immediate results and longer-term potentialBuild repeatable operating models and playbooks that allow successful experiments to be adopted across the broader performance marketing programCommunicate strategy, progress, findings, and recommendations to senior leadership and partners across the company

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, economics, business, computer science, or a related discipline7+ years of experience in performance marketing, ecommerce, growth marketing, digital advertising, product management, or a related fieldExperience developing and scaling new marketing programs, channels, partnerships, or customer acquisition capabilitiesStrong understanding of performance marketing, experimentation, customer acquisition, and measurement, including incrementality testingThe ability to evaluate emerging platforms and advertising opportunities, develop a clear point of view, and make thoughtful investment recommendationsExperience working with Creative, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Merchandising, Finance, and external partners to bring ambiguous ideas from concept to executionThe ability to define test plans, success criteria, financial guardrails, and scale decisions when there is limited precedent or incomplete informationStrong business acumen and analytical skills, including the ability to assess large datasets and translate findings into clear recommendationsStrong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain complex ideas in clear business termsExperience building senior relationships with third-party companies and influencing the design of solutions, products, or partnershipsA tenacious attitude for learning and taking on new challenges, and an entrepreneurial mentality

The base salary range for this role is $110,500 - $176,000.00.

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic.
